meta.plot: Les aventures d'Amanda, une femme mondaine installée à New York dans le Upper East Side. Elle va s'enfuir de son mariage, quelques heures avant, lorsqu'elle découvre que son futur mari la trompe. Dans sa fuite, en rase campagne, elle se retrouve sans téléphone ou moyen de regagner son domicile. Elle ne va pas tarder à faire la une de la presse à scandale...

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E01 - Leo Nardo Stands Alone
1.plot: The Ninja Turtles are on the run and... alone. Leonardo is a leader who is without anyone to lead. Leo now has to stop Bishop and her Mechazoids while trying to save his brothers.

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E02 - Mikey Does the Right Thing
1.plot: To save his brothers, Mikey needs the help of Bishop's intern, Rod. But Rod wants something in return... to be turned into a MUTANT! To save the day, Mikey has to become... RESPONSIBLE.

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E03 - Raphael Thinks It Through
1.plot: Raph's strength won't save him when he's caught between the Mechazoids and the notorious street gang known as Purple Dragons! Raph's going to have to use his head to het out of this one.

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E04 - Donnie Hangs Tough
1.plot: It's a battle of the wits between Donnie and Bishop as he races through NYC's subway system to stop her evil 4/5/24 August 2, 2024 Mechazoids. But how do you beat an AI that counters your every move?

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E05 - Bishop Makes Her Move
1.plot: The origin of the woman called BISHOP! Why does she hate mutants? What is the secret of the Mechazoids? And exactly what happened the night the Turtles fell into Bishop's trap?

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E06 - Night of the Mechazoids
1.plot: The Turtles take the fight to Bishop but she's ready for them... get ready for MECHA-BISHOP! But when the Mechazoids go out of control, can the Turtles save humanity?

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E07 - Raph vs. Water
1.plot: The Turtles and Mutanimals are caught in the Storm of the Century! But when a new group of SEA MUTANTS threaten the city... Raph will be forced to use his WORDS to save the day.

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E08 - Mikey Takes Charge
1.plot: Mikey and Genghis Frog are sent into the storm on a supply run to the local market when they encounter the electrifying LEE THE EEL! Now Mikey has to step up and be a LEADER!

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E09 - Splinter and April Fight a Goldfish
1.plot: When the Lair floods, April goes to save Splinter... but he won't leave the sewer! To make matters worse, the mutant called GOLDFIN comes with a warning... stay out of his way, or else!

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E10 - Donnie Goes Deep
1.plot: Donnie and Wingnut go to restore power to the Lair but get trapped by the East River 3! The water is rising and they're not alone... there's a monster down there with them!

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E11 - Leonardo Saddles Up
1.plot: The mutant seahorse called MUSTANG SALLY is going to flood the city... and the only thing standing in his way are LEO and Pigeon Pete. Being the leader isn't all it's cracked up to be.

1.title: FR - Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Légendes des Tortues Ninja - S01E12 - The Pearl
1.plot: The East River 3 are on the verge on victory! The Turtles and Mutanimals must team up to stop them, but not everything is as it seems... what is the PEARL and why does Goldfin want it?

meta.plot: Les tortues, Leo, Raph, Donnie et Mikey, font cavalier seul pour la première fois et sont confrontées à de nouvelles menaces tout en gérant les pressions liées à l'entrée au lycée de New York.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E01 - The Spaniard
1.plot: Antonio gets arrested in Colombia so he can track his daughter's kidnapper. But Angelita, his public defender, tries to get him extradited to Spain.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E02 - A man with foresight
1.plot: Antonio tries to get close to Cruz, the kidnapper, but he's pummeled every time. His mother and Inma, his ex-wife, try to decipher his disappearance.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E03 - Teo
1.plot: Once, Angelita struggled to save a pregnant client, only to wind up adopting her baby after she died by suicide. Back in prison, Antonio gets good news.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E04 - Reunions
1.plot: Antonio makes contact with Cruz, who gives him new info about Soledad, his kidnapped daughter. Inma shows up at his hearing, then stays to investigate.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E05 - Traitor
1.plot: Cruz's sister, La Grilla, kidnaps Inma. Angelita dives deeper into darkness. And at La Brecha, war ensues, with Antonio in the crosshairs.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E06 - Details matter
1.plot: Inma hides with Sebastián, the cop who investigated Soledad's disappearance, and they figure out Quitombo's weak link. Antonio tries to flee La Brecha.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E07 - Breakout
1.plot: After the prison riot, Antonio goes missing. Meanwhile, Soledad continues her investigation into her past and finds a startling new clue.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E08 - Dead man walking
1.plot: Inma manages to get on a call with Milena, which prompts her to pressure Quitombo. In turn, he puts the screws on Angelita. Soledad plots her escape.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E09 - Ibagué
1.plot: The prison riot puts both Antonio and Cruz at risk. Quitombo's birthday party goes off the rails when Soledad makes her move and Inma ends up helping.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E10 - Wheeling and dealing
1.plot: Inma begins to tell Soledad all about her past when they’re cut short by La Grilla, who wants to use them to free Cruz, now in the hands of the police.

1.title: FR - La disparition de Soledad - S01E11 - Father
1.plot: Antonio searches desperately for Inma and Soledad, who are hiding with Ignacio. Angelita lays a trap for Quitombo, who has been abandoned by Milena.

meta.plot: Pour retrouver sa fille enlevée, Antonio se fait volontairement emprisonner en Colombie, déclenchant une série d'événements bouleversants pour de nombreuses personnes.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E01 - The Shorter Way
1.plot: Vic, a young New Englander, discovers her supernatural abilities as the immortal Charlie Manx lures a child into a mysterious Rolls Royce Wraith.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E02 - The Graveyard of What Might Be
1.plot: Vic meets Maggie, a medium with more questions than answers. Manx visits Haverhill to seek The Shorter Way and finds Bing, who is eager to help.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E03 - The Gas Mask Man
1.plot: Vic strives to live a normal life despite Maggie's warning. Charlie Manx puts Bing Partridge to work.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E04 - The House of Sleep
1.plot: Vic seeks the Wraith and learns she must trust her gift. A body surfaces in Haverhill.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E05 - The Wraith
1.plot: Vic is questioned by the police and cannot fill the holes in her story. Manx lays out his plan for Vic, but things go awry.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E06 - The Dark Tunnels
1.plot: Vic meets another strong creative who gives her some advice. Manx receives an unexpected visitor.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E07 - Scissors for the Drifter
1.plot: Vic finds herself trapped. Manx runs into trouble and calls Bing for help.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E08 - Parnassus
1.plot: Vic finds herself in danger after an argument with Linda. Manx seeks advice from an old friend.

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E09 - Sleigh House
1.plot: Despite Maggie's warning, Vic strives to rescue a loved one. Manx learns something new about Vic

1.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S01E10 - Gunbarrel
1.plot: Vic enlists a local biker to help her try to stop Charlie Manx. Manx makes a pitstop on his way to Christmasland.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E01 - Bad Mother
2.plot: Eight years on, Vic McQueen receives shocking news about Charlie Manx. Maggie consults her tiles at great risk. Bing hunts down the Wraith, but hits a roadblock. Millie Manx discovers a new aspect of Christmasland.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E02 - Good Father
2.plot: Charlie Manx fights for his life. Millie Manx determines to never let the lights go out in Christmasland again. Bing receives a long awaited call. Wayne McQueen, attempting to understand his mother, walks headlong into danger.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E03 - The Night Road
2.plot: Vic McQueen takes the Shorter Way to Haverhill. Lou and Wayne face a terrible threat in her absence. Charlie Manx engages an old friend for a mysterious favor. Millie Manx confronts the past.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E04 - The Lake House
2.plot: With Charlie Manx on the hunt, Vic and her family go into hiding with Maggie. Wayne suffers mysterious nightmares while Tabitha chases a lead on Bing.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E05 - Bruce Wayne McQueen
2.plot: Vic McQueen returns to the Lakehouse only to ride straight into a deadly trap; Charlie Manx cashes in his favor; the Hourglass Man, a powerful strong creative, appears.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E06 - The Hourglass
2.plot: Maggie puts herself in danger attempting to take a dark strong creative off the board; Vic and Lou work to repair Vic's knife; Linda and Chris grapple with Vic's gift; Wayne makes a mysterious friend.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E07 - Cripple Creek
2.plot: Bing Partridge has some questions for Charlie Manx. Manx revisits his difficult childhood. Millie meets an old friend. Wayne is put to a choice.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E08 - Chris McQueen
2.plot: Vic and Chris take the Shorter Way to a junkyard. Chris loses his temper. Bing leverages a secret to seek forgiveness. Vic, Lou, Maggie and Chris hatch a plan. Tabitha impresses her boss.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E09 - Welcome to Christmasland
2.plot: Vic and Maggie embark on a dangerous journey. Charlie Manx confronts his deepest fears. As her world falls apart, Millie must choose between freedom and her father.

2.title: FR - NOS4A2 - S02E10 - Bats
2.plot: Vic McQueen makes her final stand against Charlie Manx. Lou and Tabitha solve a Christmasland riddle. Millie Manx wrestles with regret.

meta.plot: Vic McQueen se découvre le précieux don de retrouver les choses perdues. Celui-ci va se révéler très utile pour traquer le diabolique et immortel Charlie Manx, un serial-killer enlevant des enfants pour les emmener dans le monde fantastique de Christmasland.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E01 - Friday - The Father
1.plot: After Sam, a London family man in crisis, rescues a troubled young girl in the woods, he brings her home to the ominous Osea Island, where inhabitants are preparing for a curious annual festival involving the island's history. As he meets Osea's secretive locals, Sam grows increasingly desperate to return to the mainland to make an important call - but the island proves difficult to escape.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E02 - Saturday - The Son
1.plot: Plagued by a disturbing dream, Sam awakes to find himself in a compromising situation and, having missed the morning crossing to return to the mainland, spends the day trying to learn more about the islanders’ beliefs. After a series of confusing and terrifying events leaves him shaken, Sam quickly plots a way off Osea with Jess, but is convinced to stay put as the islanders prepare for a dry run of their big event.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E03 - Sunday - The Ghost
1.plot: Sam is shocked to learn the truth about his connection to Osea and the islanders’ intentions for his future. Later, in a fight for his life, Sam tries desperately to escape their clutches and make it back to the mainland in one piece.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E04 - Monday - The Mother
1.plot: Winter. Helen surprises her two daughters, Tallulah and Ellie, with a trip to Osea Island for Ellie's birthday. After finding that the cottage she booked is suspiciously no longer available, Helen scours the island for a place to stay, but finds resistance at every turn.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E05 - Tuesday - The Daughter
1.plot: As the islanders prepare for a fateful birth, Helen reveals her true intentions in coming to Osea and, after joining a search party, is pressed on her past. A peculiar girl befriends Ellie and offers to take her to a mysterious place closed off to outsiders.

1.title: FR - The Third Day - S01E06 - Last Day - The Dark
1.plot: Helen protects her family as tensions come to a dramatic conclusion.

meta.plot: A unique story told over two distinct halves, "Summer" follows Sam, a man drawn to a mysterious island off the British coast where he encounters a group of islanders set on preserving their traditions at any cost. "Winter" follows Helen, a strong-willed outsider who comes to the island seeking answers, but whose arrival precipitates a fractious battle to decide its fate.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E01 - Episode One
1.plot: After paranoid schizophrenic Thomas Birdsey has a violent public breakdown, Dominick Birdsey finds himself stepping up to defend his identical twin brother in unexpected ways. As he navigates the fallout, Dominick reflects on their childhood growing up under the tyrannical rule of their volatile stepfather, Ray, and their desire to know the identity of their biological father.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E02 - Episode Two
1.plot: Tensions rise between Dominick and his live-in girlfriend, Joy, as the media begins to take an interest in Thomas' case. In his attempt to have Thomas released from the Hatch forensic institute for the criminally insane, Dominick finds a potential ally in social worker Lisa Sheffer, but learns that helping his brother may be more difficult than he thought.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E03 - Episode Three
1.plot: Sheffer preps Dominick for a pivotal hearing with Hatch’s review board that could decide Thomas’ fate. A chance encounter with an old classmate brings painful childhood memories to the surface. Dominick reflects on his and Thomas’ time together at college, during which he met Dessa and the signs of his brother’s illness first began to manifest. Joy attempts to remedy the problems in her and Dominick’s relationship.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E04 - Episode Four
1.plot: Despite the protestations of those closest to him, Dominick returns to work before fully recovering from his accident. Heavily medicated, Dominick recalls the disturbing incident that lead to Thomas’ first hospitalization while counting down the hours to Thomas’ hearing with the Hatch review board.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E05 - Episode Five
1.plot: Upon learning the details of his Sicilian grandfather's arrival in the early 1900s to Three Rivers, Dominick becomes convinced his family is cursed. A startling update on Thomas from an unlikely source prompts Dominick to take drastic action.

1.title: FR - La Puissance des Vaincus - S01E06 - Episode Six
1.plot: A lifetime of animosity between Dominick and Ray spills over in public at an inopportune time. After an unexpected tragedy, Dominick seeks reconciliation with those he has hurt. Series finale.

meta.plot: Le destin de deux frères jumeaux, Dominick et Thomas Birdsey, dans l'Amérique de la seconde moitié du XXème siècle.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Former thief Cat Chambers returns home to the Pacific island paradise known as The Reef as she finds herself in the center of a kidnapping, when the daughter of the island’s most prominent resident goes missing.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E02 - Lost and Found
1.plot: When modern-day pirates hijack a yacht and steal a laptop containing information that could take down the governor, Cat Chambers jumps into action and finds much more than she expected.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E03 - Buried Things
1.plot: When the wreckage of a plane crash is discovered in the jungle, it sparks the search for its passenger and a race to find Petra before it’s too late.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E04 - Welcome to the Jungle
1.plot: When the Deputy Governor asks Cat to accompany her to visit an island owned by an old friend of Cat's, Dylan Sawyer, the pair become embroiled in a plot to take over Dylan's pot business and, instead, manufacture Yaba.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E05 - The Green Tide
1.plot: When a refinery explosion threatens countless lives on The Reef, Cat Chambers is determined to find out who is behind it before it's too late.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E06 - The Two O'Clock Flight
1.plot: When a group of criminals hijacks a plane and lands on The Reef, Cat Chambers jumps into action formulating a quick-thinking plan to save the passengers on board before it's too late.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E07 - Despot
1.plot: When a mysterious general arrives on The Reef with a secret collection of stolen art and jewelry, chaos and murder ensue leaving Wyatt to question Cat's involvement and who she is really working.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E08 - The Comeback
1.plot: When Tori Eastland hosts The Reef's first women's surf competition, the stakes quickly become deadly for all involved, and a former surfer-rival of Cat Chambers is at the center of it all.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E09 - The Hohenzollern Collection
1.plot: When Betty Ann Miller arrives on The Reef, she presents Cat Chambers an offer too good to refuse, but when Cat considers turning back to her old ways, she turns the tables on the situation.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E10 - Blue Skies
1.plot: Petra unknowingly finds herself in the center of illegal activity involving Regina, the younger sister of criminal Doug O'Casey; and Cat Chambers works to free Petra and comes face-to-face with an old adversary on the Reef.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E11 - Dream Lover
1.plot: It's Cat Chambers' birthday. Everyone on The Reef is getting together to celebrate, but Cat quickly becomes ill resulting in her most dangerous and life-threatening situation yet.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E12 - Prison Break
1.plot: Doug O'Casey involves Cat Chambers in a prison break scheme, and no one is sure who Cat is really working for.

1.title: FR - Reef Break - S01E13 - Endgame
1.plot: Cat Chambers is on the run and fearing for her life and freedom. Hearts are broken and futures are uncertain as Cat faces her toughest case yet—to clear her own name.

meta.plot: Dans un petit archipel du Pacifique, une ex-cambrioleuse met ses talents et son expérience au service de la justice pour résoudre des crimes.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E01 - If I Hadn't Met You
1.plot: Husband and father of two Eduard suffers a sudden and devastating tragedy. In his grief, he meets a strange woman who offers him a unique opportunity.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E02 - The Key
1.plot: Eduard travels to a second parallel universe to change the fate of his loved ones, but is disturbed by the type of man he is in this alternate reality.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E03 - They Won't Meet
1.plot: Dr. Everest has Eduard reflect on choices he made right before two critical moments in his life: his father's death, and the first time he met Elisa.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E04 - I Shouldn't Have Met Him
1.plot: While trying to stop his college-age self from falling for Elisa in 1991, Eduard lands in a situation that could keep him stuck in the wrong universe.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E05 - The Kiss
1.plot: In 1991, Elisa accidentally experiences universe travel and confronts Eduard with her suspicions about his true identity. A different tragedy occurs.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E06 - I Don't Go In
1.plot: In the present, Òscar reveals to Eduard a secret Clara recently told him, which reminds Eduard of a time when he and Elisa had a critical fight.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E07 - It Is And It Isn't
1.plot: Eduard travels to a universe in which Elisa is a renowned singer, living a life very separate from his. But her gain in life means a new loss for him.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E08 - The Wings of a Butterfly
1.plot: Dr. Everest warns Eduard that even a small change can have a great impact, but he ignores her for a second chance at a missed moment with his son.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E09 - Sciences Or Arts
1.plot: When Clara and Òscar become convinced Eduard is delusional, he brings them to meet Dr. Everest to prove otherwise. Joan opens up to his son-in-law.

1.title: FR - If I Hadnt Met You - S01E10 - Universe Zero
1.plot: Dr. Everest's mysterious past and scientific endeavors are finally revealed to Eduard, as she shares her own family tragedy.

meta.plot: Eduard, un mari et père qui a perdu sa famille dans un tragique accident, voyage dans des univers parallèles en quête d'un destin plus heureux pour sa femme.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When an elite assassin carries out a kill, it catches the attention of an intelligence officer, who starts to hunt him down.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: With his client backing out of payment, the Jackal's reputation is on the line, and he starts to plot his revenge.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Armed with the knowledge of his wayward client's identity, the Jackal tracks him down in Munich, determined to settle the score.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: His vengeance fulfilled, the Jackal flees Munich and tries to quell Nuria's suspicions. Bianca follows a new lead in her hunt.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The Jackal visits Norman with a special commission... but with Bianca also tracking Norman down, she is starting to close in on him.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Following his shootout with Bianca, the Jackal must escape his captors and regroup ahead of his next hit, as Bianca follows his trail.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The Jackal and Bianca head to Tallinn ahead of UDC's announcement. The Jackal must use all his wiles as he prepares to take his shot.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Bianca gains insight into a secret file. She learns the true identity of the Jackal and how he became a contract killer.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: With the release of River imminent, UDC believes himself safe. As time runs out, the Jackal must use all his skills to reach his target.

1.title: FR - The Day of the Jackal - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: A wanted man, the Jackal is on the run, desperate to get back to Nuria, but Bianca is given one last shot to bring him to justice.

meta.plot: Le Chacal, un assassin solitaire, insaisissable, et particulièrement doué, se fait payer grassement pour abattre ses cibles. Il se trouve confronté à un officier des renseignements britanniques, une femme aussi tenace que lui, qui va se mettre à le traquer. Une course passionnante à travers l'Europe commence.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Three  years after the Bone Collector ended his career, Detective Lincoln Rhyme teams with NYPD officer Amelia Sachs to investigate a series of murders that suggest the killer's return and an unlikely team is born

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E02 - God Complex
1.plot: Lincoln and Amelia join forces to find a killer inspired by Greek mythology who is live-streaming murders. Meanwhile, the Bone Collector prepares a terrifying gift to celebrate Lincoln's return to work with his new partner.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E03 - Russian Roulette
1.plot: When a young woman from an insular Russian community who witnesses a murder comes to Lincoln and Amelia for help, the case takes a shocking turn when the mysterious murder is linked to a cold case - the tragic disappearance of a teenage girl. Meanwhile, the Bone Collector's 'secret' is discovered.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E04 - What Lies Beneath
1.plot: A bizarre murder at a university research site thrusts Amelia and Kate into the world of post-mortem forensics. Lincoln explores new possibilities with the help of Sellitto's friend.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E05 - Game On
1.plot: The Bone Collector challenges Lincoln, Amelia, and the team with a trifecta of victims across New York City. But as our team races to solve the clue trails before it's too late, Lincoln must come to terms with the Bone Collector's real target - his own ego.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E06 - 'Til Death Do Us Part
1.plot: Lincoln and the team hunt a serial killer who stages perfect murders by brilliantly framing suspects in what appear to be open and shut cases. The hunt hits home when one of Lincoln's closest friends is accused.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E07 - Requiem
1.plot: Lincoln, Amelia and the team are tasked with tracking down an anonymous bomber, targeting a string of buildings all across Manhattan. Meanwhile, the marriage between The Bone Collector and his wife, Danielle, reaches a terrifying crossroad.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E08 - Original Sin
1.plot: When a politician's teenage daughter is kidnapped for ransom, Lincoln, Amelia and the team race against time to rescue her before the unthinkable happens. Meanwhile, the team makes a startling discovery -- The Bone Collector's true identity...

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E09 - Open Warfare (1)
1.plot: Part one of a two-part finale, The Bone Collector's name and face are all over the news. Staying one step ahead of our team, The Bone Collector puts his ultimate revenge plan into action by targeting those closest to Lincoln, including Amelia.

1.title: FR - Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector - S01E10 - Mano a Mano (2)
1.plot: In the first season's terrifying conclusion, Lincoln is forced to save his son, Camden, by putting himself at risk and confronting The Bone Collector in a deadly face off, mano a mano.

meta.plot: Former NYPD detective and forensic genius Lincoln Rhyme was at the top of his game until a serious accident at the hands of a notorious serial killer forced him out of the field. When Amelia Sachs, an intuitive young officer who has a gift for profiling, finds herself hot on the killer's trail, Rhyme finds a partner for this new game of cat and mouse.

1.title: FR - Les Copains d'abord - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Les Copains d'abord - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Les Copains d'abord - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Les Copains d'abord - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Les Copains d'abord - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Deux familles, liées par une amitié avec un grand A, partagent absolument tout : les dîners, les vacances, les emmerdes et même leur palier ! Alors quand on leur demande de libérer leur appartement, ils vont tout faire pour continuer à habiter ensemble. Et si c'était la pire idée de leur vie ?

1.title: FR - Intercomédies : Un événement sportif - S01E01 - The Big Show Show: The Big Games
1.plot: The Big Show and his daughters do their best to help Cassy triumph over an arch-frenemy in a series of seriously silly family vs. family games.

1.title: FR - Intercomédies : Un événement sportif - S01E02 - Mr. Iglesias: Olympic Effort
1.plot: Inspired by the Olympics, Mr. Iglesias teaches his class about privilege — and the importance of playing by the rules — during an SAT prep class.

1.title: FR - Intercomédies : Un événement sportif - S01E03 - Ashley Garcia: Pasadena 2020
1.plot: Tensions mount as Tío Victor fights to reclaim his burrito recipe from a cross-town rival. Can a series of Coffee House Games put an end to the drama?

meta.plot: Les univers s'entrechoquent lors de cet événement spécial issu de quatre séries comiques mêlant visages connus, apparitions surprise et esprit de compétition.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: After a nuclear disaster caused by several terrorist attacks wipes out most of North America, residents of a small Kansas town have to come to terms with a very different reality.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E02 - Fallout
1.plot: The fallout from the nuclear blast in Denver will hit Jericho in an hour and Jake has to get the residents inside.  The official shelter is not adequate and Jake must find another shelter to protect them. Emily faces troubles of her own while being picked up by who she thinks are two officers.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E03 - Four Horsemen
1.plot: After seeing a broadcast via satellite from Asia, Jake gathers a group of people together for information gathering.  After finding out that there is information out there, Jake suggests having four search parties to go out to get a better understanding what is going on outside of Jericho.  The search parties set off in four different directions.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E04 - Walls of Jericho
1.plot: Jake finds a stranger who is sick with radiation poisoning and he must make a decision whether or not to help him.  The hospital’s generator is running out of gas and the residents find that their supplies are also running low.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E05 - Federal Response
1.plot: The children of Jericho start to return back to school. A power line that has fallen causes an accident on the playground when the power returns. Jake has an argument with his mother regarding a secret that Jake hasn't disclosed to his dad.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E06 - 9:02
1.plot: Hawkins must step in when an argument between Jake and an adversary becomes heated.  After an electromagnetic pulse leaves Jericho in the dark crime runs rampant. Later, Jake is held at gunpoint and is rescued.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E07 - Long Live the Mayor
1.plot: The slick gang leader Jonah bails Mitchell out of jail and agrees to give back the food that his bandits stole and agrees to keep out of Jericho. This plan strays off-course as Jonah negotiates new terms involving Jake and Emily.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E08 - Rogue River
1.plot: Jake and Eric head out of Jericho to the nearby town of Rogue River to try and acquire some medicine for their father.  While the brothers are at the hospital they encounter a combative group of individuals who call themselves Ravenwood. The brothers find that they’re trapped and must find a way back to Jericho.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E09 - Crossroads
1.plot: The residents of Jericho receive a visit from a group of questionable outsiders and they realize that they need to form a plan to keep the outsiders out. Emily has a dream about her wedding morning to Roger. She wakes up and realizes that he is probably dead.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E10 - Red Flag
1.plot: Supplies are dropped by air into Jericho and the Green's and Hawkins think that they know where they came from. Jonah Prowse returns to Jericho causing even more trouble.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E11 - Vox Populi
1.plot: Some of the residents of Jericho are concerned that Gray's actions may actually make Gray the new mayor. In other news, Mitchell claims that Jonah is the killer under much speculation.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E12 - The Day Before
1.plot: The lives of Jake and Hawkins are explored during this flashback episode. This episode begins 36 hours before the bombs went off. Sarah is introduced and is associated to Hawkins. Jake had been living in San Diego.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E13 - Black Jack
1.plot: Jake, his dad, Heather and Dale visit Black Jack to try and find the parts needed to fix the windmill. Sarah goes home with Hawkins against the rest of his family's wishes.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E14 - Heart of Winter
1.plot: While on a hunting trip outside of Jericho, Jake, Stanley and Mimi find themselves in a dangerous situation when they run into some strangers.  Meanwhile, Hawkins realizes that his family is in danger because of him. Emily and Roger work on their relationship.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E15 - Semper Fidelis
1.plot: After a company of Marines show up, the town of Jericho has hopes that life will finally start to return to normal. However, their behavior raises Jake's and Johnston's suspicions.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E16 - Winter's End
1.plot: After April collapses and goes into early labor, Jake makes Kenchy face his problems so that they can save April. The wind turbine arrives from New Bern but Heather does not return. Jericho makes a deal with New Bern to send ten of their people to New Bern to make more wind turbines as long as New Bern receives a percentage of their spring crop.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E17 - One Man's Terrorist
1.plot:
Roger gets desperate after Gray kicks the refugees out of Jericho. Dale and Skylar collect on some debts. Hawkins continues his quest to find Sarah's contacts.

Meanwhile, Hawkins begins the process of finding who's coming after him.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E18 - A.K.A.
1.plot: Jake finds that Hawkins has not been honest with the residents of Jericho about his past and holds him at gunpoint for answers.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E19 - Casus Belli
1.plot: Jake believes something more is wrong after Eric doesn’t return from New Bern. Jake and Hawkins go to New Bern and discover that Jericho is in danger.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E20 - One If By Land
1.plot: The hostility mounts between the citizens of Jericho and New Bern. A handful of residents of New Bern are shot and injured after getting caught trying to steal from the Jericho salt mine.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E21 - Coalition of the Willing
1.plot: The residents of Jericho and New Bern fight over precious resources and Gray  must make a tough decision after the streets of Jericho are bombed.

1.title: FR - Jericho - S01E22 - Why We Fight
1.plot: The battle with New Bern ensues, with Jericho residents out-manned and out-gunned, but not outsmarted. Jericho gains the upper hand but suffers a significant casualty. A friend of Jake's sends help from an unexpected source.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E01 - Reconstruction
2.plot: Following the battle of New Bern, Jericho begins the rebuilding process, while the Cheyenne government shows a particular interest in the town. While the dispute between Jericho and New Bern is being sorted out by the Cheyenne government, Heather returns. Meanwhile, an old friend of Rob comes to Jericho.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E02 - Condor
2.plot: Jericho gets ready for a very important visitor from the new Cheyenne government.  Meanwhile, Hawkins and Chavez work to find the new leaderships secrets.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E03 - Jennings & Rall
2.plot: The deadly Hudson River virus hits the area and a vaccine is being withheld from the citizens by a government official. Jake and the Rangers find a way to protect Jericho.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E04 - Oversight
2.plot:
Hawkins receives a call on from someone who knows who he is, where he is and lets Hawkins know exactly when he'll be caught.

Meanwhile, tragedy strikes.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E05 - Termination for Cause
2.plot: Jake and the Rangers take on Goetz and Ravenwood while a Jericho Ranger makes a choice that will alter his life. Meanwhile, an old friend comes to warn Heather that her loyalties to Major Beck have placed her in serious danger.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E06 - Sedition
2.plot: Following the Rangers' decision to take justice into their own hands, Major Beck goes to extreme measures to prove he's in complete control of the town, while Hawkins receives a call from Chavez telling him that it's time to transport the bomb.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E07 - Patriots and Tyrants
2.plot: Jake and Hawkins have one chance to expose the conspiracy behind the Cheyenne government to the independent Texas administration. However, getting there proves to be the most difficult part of their plan.

2.title: FR - Jericho - S02E08 -

meta.plot: Une catastrophe nucléaire plonge les habitants d'une petite ville du Kansas dans le chaos. Le pays est-il complètement ravagé ? Y a-t-il d'autres survivants ? Les doutes, les peurs et le désespoir commencent à gagner le petit groupe de survivants. Mais face à cette épreuve, le pire comme le meilleur peut surgir en chaque être humain...

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E01 - Kash with a K
1.plot: Coming off a devastating heartbreak, Maya travels to London for her best friend Ainsley’s wedding. While in town, Maya reconnects with her old college friends, Craig and Duffy, and finds herself thrust into their personal crises.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E02 - Hounslow
1.plot: Maya and Ainsley struggle to get over their respective breakups. After moving back home with his dad, Kash runs into an old friend he lost touch with. Zara makes a startling discovery that threatens her and Craig’s future.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E03 - We Broke
1.plot: After Ainsley’s mother cuts her off, Ainsley struggles to save her business. Maya attempts to find a job, but realizes it may be harder to escape her past than she anticipated. Duffy and Tabby’s new relationship hits a bump in the road. Kash’s acting ambitions are derailed by a family emergency.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E04 - The Winner Takes It All
1.plot: An impending funeral stirs up old feelings for Maya. Haroon pressures Kash to consider an arranged marriage. Gemma makes a difficult parenting decision. Duffy and Tabby take a big step in their relationship.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E05 - Love, Chalet
1.plot: Craig becomes obsessed with Zara's reality show.  Duffy tries not to screw things up with Maya.  Ainsley meets an exciting new client who could help save her business... as well as the client's horrible ex-husband, Bryce.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E06 - Lights, Camera, Wedding
1.plot: Ainsley doubles down on her fight with Craig; Duffy stumbles on a secret love letter that gives him hope; Kash considers taking the next step with Fatima.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E07 - The Sound of Music
1.plot: Maya feels guilty that her work is forcing her to interact with Ainsley's ex; Andrew and Tony 2 realize that they have an unexpected connection; Bryce tries to take his professional relationship with Ainsley to the next level.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E08 - Game Night
1.plot: Maya and Kash get to know each other behind Ainsley's back. Tony 2 realizes he and Andrew come from very different worlds. Ainsley and Craig play matchmaker, as do Gemma and Duffy.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E09 - Four Friends and a Secret
1.plot: Maya struggles to tell Ainsley about Kash. Fearing their relationship may be getting too friendly, Gemma fires Duffy.  Zara finds a way for Craig to reconnect with his daughter. Andrew has a surprising change of heart.

1.title: FR - Quatre mariages et un enterrement - S01E10 - New Jersey
1.plot: A year after Maya and Ainsley's blowup, the fractured friend group hopes that a wedding may be the perfect occasion for a reunion.

meta.plot: Quatre mariages et un enterrement suit quatre amis américains - Maya, Craig, Ainsley et Duffy - qui se réunissent pour un fabuleux mariage à Londres. Mais après qu’une révélation soit faite devant l’autel, leur vie basculent et ils devront surmonter une année tumultueuse. Des relations se forgent et se brisent, des scandales politiques sont exposés, la vie sociale londonienne gronde, les histoires d'amour vont s'enflammer et s'étendre, et bien sûr, il y a quatre mariages ... et un enterrement

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E01 - Get On It
1.plot: Bannerman Independent School’s known for its reputation and status. Only DGM, made up of four disparate but determined students, dare to reveal the truth.

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E02 - Get In Deep
1.plot: DGM get to work on a new mission, bringing down Ronny Kent. Olivia’s relationship with Donte is put at risk because of it.

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E03 - Get It Together
1.plot: Shocking news shakes the students of Bannerman to their core. Could DGM be in the frame for a terrible crime they didn’t commit?

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E04 - Get Over It
1.plot: Margot’s past comes back to haunt her, Bree’s forced to spend quality time with Rex, and DGM set to work investigating their number one suspect.

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E05 - Get What You Want
1.plot: Kitty is faced with a personal dilemma as the pressure mounts on DGM to expose the truth about a criminal, but not a murderer…

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E06 - Get A Clue
1.plot: Bree gets benched, Ronny’s memorial gig prompts many to seize the day and a suspect makes their way to the top of DGM’s list.

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E07 - Get Out of Hand
1.plot: Olivia’s secret is revealed, Kitty competes in a fencing match, Bree realises she has a boyfriend and a loss means DGM rethink their main suspect.

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E08 - Get Through It
1.plot: We flashback to when DGM began, while in the present they organise their most joyous prank yet. But then a suspect is arrested…

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E09 - Get It Out
1.plot: The Police are satisfied they’ve found the culprit despite a number of loose ends. Can DGM keep investigating when fractures threaten to tear them apart?

1.title: FR - Les Justicières - S01E10 - Get Justice
1.plot: DGM finally learn the truth, but not without great personal risk and devastating consequences…

meta.plot: En surface, Kitty, Margot, Bree et Olivia semblent n'avoir rien en commun - mais il y a une passion qui les unit: dénoncer l'injustice. Ils forment leur propre société secrète, DGM - ils ne se fâchent pas, ils ...

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E01 - Honour Amongst Thieves
1.plot: British police officer DC Miranda Blake is reluctantly paired with wise-cracking German detective Max Winter to investigate a criminal gang based in Mallorca.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E02 - King of the Mountains
1.plot: When top Mallorcan cyclist Esteban Domenech disappears during a routine training session, Miranda and Max take advantage of Ines's absence to investigate.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E03 - The Oligarch's Icon
1.plot: When the famous icon of St Nicholas is stolen by a masked assailant in front of a shocked crowd, Miranda and Max enter the world of Russian oligarchs.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E04 - Number One Fan
1.plot: When a supermodel goes missing, Max and Miranda sashay into the world of fashion and design to try to discover how someone can vanish from a moving train.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E05 - Sour Grapes
1.plot: Miranda and Max head out into wine country to investigate the killing of a dog at one of Mallorca's most famous vineyards. It transpires that the shooting is just one of an increasingly dramatic series of threats faced by property owner Hans Webber.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E06 - To Kill a Stag
1.plot: When a groom-to-be is found dead in the swimming pool of a luxury villa, Miranda and Max believe it's the work of a prostitute who stuns her clients and then robs them.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E07 - Friend Henry
1.plot: Miranda and Max investigate the death of a world-famous DJ after he plays at Mallorca's most popular nightclub, leading the detectives to investigate a sophisticated drug network.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E08 - Death in the Morning
1.plot: The brutal murder of a famous British author and anti-bullfighting campaigner brings Max and Miranda to Cazador in the wild interior of Mallorca.

1.title: FR - Mallorca - S01E09 - Mallorca's Most Wanted
1.plot: An apprehended drug dealer tips off Miranda and Max that a fugitive on Mallorca's most wanted list is back on the island to visit his dying father.

meta.plot: Détachée pour une mission de courte durée, Miranda Blake, une inspectrice anglaise, accro à son travail et sans une once d’humour, est contrainte de prolonger sa collaboration sur l’île de Majorque ; pire encore, elle se voit imposer comme partenaire Max, un flic allemand, débonnaire et jovial. Ce tandem mal assorti s’occupe des affaires impliquant des ressortissants étrangers.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E01 - True Story with Jonathan Cohen
1.plot: Natoo and Ludovik receive Jonathan Cohen. The comedian confides with humor in the incredible and 100% true story that happened to him in Los Angeles.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E02 - True Story with Geraldine and Olivier Nakache
1.plot: Norman and Cyprien receive Géraldine and Olivier Nakache. The director and the actress tell the worst experience of their lives.The story takes place before the two movie stars become famous.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E03 - True Story with Zahia
1.plot: McFly and Carlito receive Zahia. The apprentice actress tells the insane story full of twists and turns that enabled her to live her dream, to participate in the Venice Carnival.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E04 - True Story with Julie Gayet
1.plot: Norman and Cyprien receive Julie Gayet. The actress and film producer tells the incredible and 100% true story that allowed her to realize her dream, to shoot in a genre film.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E05 - True Story with Antoine de Caunes and José Garcia
1.plot: McFly and Carlito receive Antoine de Caunes and José Garcia. The legendary duo tells the story of a merciless battle that has pitted them for 20 years.

1.title: FR - True Story Avec - S01E06 - True Story with Fianso
1.plot: Natoo and Ludovik receive Fianso. The comedian rapper tells the amazing story of his first fan, the one who inspired him the title of one of his biggest successes.

2.title: FR - True Story Avec - S02E01 - Episode 1
FR - True Story Avec - S02E02 - Episode 2
FR - True Story Avec - S02E03 - Episode 3
FR - True Story Avec - S02E04 - Episode 4
FR - True Story Avec - S02E05 - Episode 5
FR - True Story Avec - S02E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Six des plus célèbres YouTubeurs français Natoo, Cyprien, Norman, Ludovik, Mcfly & Carlito, vont donner la parole à des célébrités venues leur raconter une histoire étonnante, surprenante, drôle et - surtout - vraie, qui n’a encore jamais été révélée au grand public.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E01 - Hell Week (1)
1.plot: At Belgrave University, Jack pledges a secret society steeped in mystery and magic. Soon, a series of strange murders sets the campus on edge.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E02 - Hell Week (2)
1.plot: Pops shares a theory about the attacks. Jack and Alyssa try to keep an eye on the other pledges. At the Temple, Jack encounters a notorious figure.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E03 - Introduction to Ethics (1)
1.plot: Jack learns he's been selected for a rival secret society. Later, he gets a lesson in magic -- and discovers that every spell has a price.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E04 - Introduction to Ethics (2)
1.plot: Jack proposes an alliance with the Knights, and Randall teaches him how to harness his powers. Meanwhile, Edward takes Alyssa under his wing.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E05 - Homecoming (1)
1.plot: As the Order prepares to conduct a dangerous, sinister spell, the Knights enlist Jack to sabotage their plans.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E06 - Homecoming (2)
1.plot: While the Order hunts for werewolves on campus, Jack and Alyssa flee with Renee's necrophone, a tool used to communicate with the dead.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E07 - Undeclared (1)
1.plot: Alyssa confronts Jack about his secret. Headmistress Vera questions Edward about the Vade Maecum and sends Gabrielle on a truth-seeking mission.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E08 - Undeclared (2)
1.plot: Alyssa helps the Knights search for Randall and stumbles upon a doctor's twisted experiment. Edward is visited by the Vade Maecum's previous owner.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E09 - Finals (1)
1.plot: Consumed by ambition, Edward clashes with Vera -- and Alyssa is caught in the middle. Jack's brush with the Vade Maecum ignites a painful ordeal.

1.title: FR - The Order - S01E10 - Finals (2)
1.plot: The Knights plot to thwart Edward's plan by kidnapping his son. Gabrielle and the Hermetic Counselor interrogate Lilith.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E01 - Free Radicals (1)
2.plot: After having the Knights' memories wiped, Vera plans to induct them into the Order. But her new pledges prove hard to control.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E02 - Free Radicals (2)
2.plot: While the Knights look for ways to protect themselves, Alyssa gives Jack a job: find the "magic tourist" who's been wreaking havoc on campus.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E03 - Fear Itself (1)
2.plot: The Knights raid the Order’s magic vault, Alyssa confides in Randall about her fading powers, and romance blooms between Lilith and Nicole.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E04 - Fear Itself (2)
2.plot: Vera leads the Order in a spell to summon Rogwan, a powerful demon. But when her plan goes awry, she needs the Knights on her side.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E05 - The Commons (1)
2.plot: Vera negotiates a deal with the Sons of Prometheus — a rival magic society — and sends Jack and Alyssa to their compound as hostages.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E06 - The Commons (2)
2.plot: Amid a standoff with the Prometheans, Alyssa goes into withdrawal. Meanwhile, Randall, Hamish and Gabrielle track professor Foley.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E07 - Spring Outbreak (1)
2.plot: The Knights weigh whether to join the Order. Alyssa suspects that her feelings for Jack might be blocking her magic. Kepler pulls rank on Vera.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E08 - Spring Outbreak (2)
2.plot: The Knights try to prevent a strange affliction from spreading. Kepler schemes to strip Vera of her power, and Alyssa searches Vera's house.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E09 - New World Order (1)
2.plot: Nicole finds a spell that could bring back Lilith, but it hinges on Alyssa’s cooperation. Jack tries to broker a deal between Vera and Salvador.

2.title: FR - The Order - S02E10 - New World Order (2)
2.plot: As chaos reigns, the Knights must convince Vera and Alyssa to work together to seal the eruption and save Lilith from the demon realm.

meta.plot: Jack Morton, nouvel élève à l'Université, rejoint une société secrète légendaire appelée l'Ordre. Il est alors plongé dans un monde magique, de monstres et d'intrigues.

1.title: FR - Ladies First: A Story of Women in Hip-Hop - S01E01 - Shaping Hip-Hop
1.plot: Sha-Rock, Roxanne Shanté and MC Lyte claim space for women in the early days of hip-hop, delivering rhymes with unique perspectives and bold messages.

1.title: FR - Ladies First: A Story of Women in Hip-Hop - S01E02 - What Are They Up Against?
1.plot: In a male-dominated industry, women face criticism, colorism and other obstacles as they set out to define their own narratives, both on wax and off.

1.title: FR - Ladies First: A Story of Women in Hip-Hop - S01E03 - What Have They Lost?
1.plot: Artists, producers and writers recount stories of abuse and erasure while working in hip-hop amid contract disputes, acts of violence and more.

1.title: FR - Ladies First: A Story of Women in Hip-Hop - S01E04 - What's Changing?
1.plot: As women reflect on their journeys across decades of hip-hop, they spotlight the sisterhood in rap — and celebrate being stronger together than apart.

meta.plot: Rappeuses, écrivaines et expertes expliquent l'influence des femmes sur la musique et la culture hip-hop dans cette série documentaire dédiée aux pionnières et aux novatrices.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E01 - Part 1: The Dream Team
1.plot: Now that Riley is a teenager, dream director Paula needs to age up her glitter-filled productions.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E02 - Part 2: Out of Body
1.plot: Paula and her new assistant director Xeni struggle while Janelle's debut dream is a huge hit.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E03 - Part 3: Romance!
1.plot: Paula and Xeni's production goes off the rails, leading to dangerous behavior when Riley sleepwalks.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E04 - Part 4: A Night to Remember
1.plot: Paula and Xeni team up to stop a nightmare, creating a new dream that may give Riley what she needs.

meta.plot: Riley grandit et ses souvenirs méritent parfois un traitement de faveur. Le quartier cérébral envoie ces souvenirs à Rêves Productions, où la célèbre réalisatrice Paula Persimmon doit faire face à un véritable cauchemar : réaliser le prochain rêve à succès de Riley aux côtés de Xeni, un réalisateur de rêveries prétentieuses, qui cherche tant bien que mal à entrer dans la cour des grands en matière de rêves.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E01 - Original Sin
1.plot: The Medici family suffers a great loss with the death of its patriarch Giovanni. When the designated heir Cosimo discovers that his father was poisoned, he decides to put Marco Bello on the assassin's trail.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E02 - The Dome and the Domicile
1.plot: The war is throwing Florence into chaos. Piero, Cosimo's only son, is eager to fight. Meanwhile, Cosimo manages to "buy" the withdrawal of Milan's troops, thus saving the city, but in the meantime Florence has again fallen into the plague.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E03 - Pestilence
1.plot: Albizzi has managed to foment the citizenry against Cosimo, accusing him of the crime of usury. When Cosimo learns of the situation, he decides to return to Florence. Albizzi then invents a ploy to get Cosimo arrested and held for trial.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E04 - Judgement Day
1.plot: From prison, Cosimo asks Contessina to try bribing a member of the Signoria, to buy votes in his favor. Albizzi starts poisoning Cosimo's food through his prison guard. Contessina negotiates exile rather than the death penalty.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E05 - Temptation
1.plot: While the Medici are in exile in Venice, the situation deteriorates day by day in Florence, with Albizzi imposing his rule over a city gravely depleted by the absence of the Medici.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E06 - Ascendancy
1.plot: The return of the Medici to Florence is an out-and-out triumph, with Albizzi in prison for his attempt to become the city's "tyrant".

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E07 - Purgatory
1.plot: The Signoria now has a vacant chair, and Cosimo is asked to choose who should occupy it. Piero thinks that his moment has now come, but the banker Pazzi, too, has his eyes set on that seat.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E08 - Epiphany
1.plot: Pazzi has managed to convince the Pope to remove the Medici as Church bankers, but Cosimo is disinclined to surrender what he has worked so hard to attain.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E01 - Old Scores
2.plot: After a surprise attack, Lorenzo and Giuliano search for the culprits. The trail leads the brothers to the Pazzis, but treachery lies closer at hand.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E02 - Standing Alone
2.plot: Lorenzo's power play comes at a cost and stirs up outrage. With leadership comes sacrifice as he travels to Rome and weighs an advantageous match.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E03 - Obstacles and Opportunities
2.plot: The death of the pope brings strategic challenges as Lorenzo negotiates with the Duke of Milan and welcomes his new bride, Clarice, to Florence.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E04 - Blood with Blood
2.plot: Lorenzo aims to strengthen ties with the Pazzis and proposes a treaty with Venice. Clarice appeals to Lucrezia and learns the way to Lorenzo's heart.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E05 - Ties That Bind
2.plot: In opposition to the pope, Lorenzo moves quickly to acquire the strategic city of Imola. A forbidden love flowers between Giuliano and Simonetta.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E06 - Alliance
2.plot: The papal army advances as important coalitions shift. Meanwhile, Lorenzo negotiates a crucial treaty, and Jacopo attempts a major power grab.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E07 - Betrayal
2.plot: As forces threaten a fragile alliance, the Pazzis embark on a murderous plan to destroy the Medicis while Lorenzo seeks to make peace with Rome.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E08 - Mass
2.plot: The day of reckoning arrives as the circle of conspirators tightens around the Medicis during Mass, and rivals attempt to take control of Florence.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E01 - Survival
3.plot: A few months after the Pazzi Conspiracy, Lorenzo is still animated by the spirit of revenge. There is a distant clash between Lorenzo and Pope Sixtus IV; the cruel count Riario - the last of the conspirators left alive - tries to take advantage of this conflict. A Dominican friar arrives in Florence who seems capable of reading Lorenzo's heart: Girolamo Savonarola.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E02 - The Ten
3.plot: The entry into the field of the Kingdom of Naples alongside the papal troops is likely to mark the end of Florence. Among the Priors there are those who doubt Lorenzo, but the Magnificent, determined not to let Florence fall into the hands of his enemies, finds a stratagem to deprive the Priors of authority. Lorenzo decides to leave for Naples to try to break the encirclement and restore peace.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E03 - Trust
3.plot: Arriving in Naples with Bernardi, Lorenzo finds it difficult to convince King Ferrante of Aragon to abandon the alliance with the Pope. While the Magnificent tries to win the king's trust, Florence remains under siege: the people and Clarice herself fear that Lorenzo has abandoned them.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E04 - Innocent
3.plot: Seven years have passed and Lorenzo hopes to close the accounts with the Pope by obtaining the signing of a peace treaty between the various Italian rulers. Riario hopes to induce Lorenzo to return to open war. While the Magnificent faces this new diplomatic crisis, his mother Lucrezia involves Clarice in the management of the bank. Worn out by the constant clash with Sixtus IV, Lorenzo decides to start his son Giovanni on an ecclesiastical career hoping to increase the influence of the Medici in the Roman Curia. The Treaty of Bagnolo, signed by all the Italian rulers, marks the triumph of the Medici family and Lorenzo, who has become the deciding vote of Italian politics.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E05 - The Holy See
3.plot: Sixtus IV is dead. Lorenzo and Clarice travel to Rome to support the election of their candidate for the papal throne, but they have to deal with the plots of Riario. The Medici find an unexpected ally in Caterina Sforza, Riario's wife. Despite the family's efforts, the new Pope Cybo proves difficult to control. In Florence, Savonarola harangues against Lorenzo for his influence in the conclave.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E06 - A Man of No Importance
3.plot: Lorenzo begins to show the first symptoms of a serious illness while his political enemies decide to attack him, questioning the solidity and provenance of Medici Bank's capital. Among these, Tommaso Peruzzi, once a supporter of the family, is now eager to bring to light a scandal that would condemn the Medici to exile. To cover up the crime and avoid losses, the Magnificent risks a new war and plans to kill Peruzzi.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E07 - Lost Souls
3.plot: Savonarola, who had taken Tommaso's confession, denounces his killing and openly accuses Lorenzo, who however continues to deny. Clarice begins to suspect the truth. To continue his strategy of control over the Holy See, the Magnificent makes a promise that triggers a family crisis.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E08 - The Fate of the City
3.plot: Lorenzo allows Bernardi to convince him that the only solution not to lose everything is to kill Savonarola, whose following gets bigger and bigger. By now, the friar openly preaches the overthrow of the established order to found a new Jerusalem. Lorenzo's plan is ready and the assassins recruited ...

meta.plot: La mort du patriarche est un coup terrible pour le clan Médicis. Lorsque son héritier et successeur, Cosimo, découvre que son père a été empoisonné, il décide de garder l’information pour lui et charge son fidèle ami Marco Bello de remonter la piste de l’assassin. Cosimo, qui a depuis longtemps fait son deuil de son rêve d'être artiste, reprend alors la tête de la banque familiale et le siège de son père à l’assemblée florentine, la Seigneurie, où il doit faire face à l’hostilité des familles nobles menées par Rinaldo Degli Ablizzi. Lorsque le Duc de Milan annexe la ville de Lucques jusqu'ici sous contrôle florentin, Cosimo doit faire un choix: soutiendra-t-il Albizzi et les nobles sur le chemin de la guerre, comme Giovanni l’aurait fait, ou s’affranchira-t-il de l'ombre de son père?

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E01 - Dulcinea
1.plot: In the outer solar system near Saturn, James Holden and the crew of the ice-freighter Canterbury, investigate a distress call from a mysterious derelict ship, the Scopuli. On Ceres Station, Detective Miller begins an off the book investigation of a missing heiress, Julie Mao.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E02 - The Big Empty
1.plot: Holden and crew are trapped in badly damaged shuttle. On Ceres, Miller uncovers clues about Julie Mao. On Earth, Chrisjen Avasarala questions a terrorist.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E03 - Remember the Cant
1.plot: Holden and the crew are taken prisoner by the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. Miller deals with unhappy rioters. Avasarala plays politics and gets severely burned.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E04 - CQB
1.plot: Holden and crew find themselves in the middle of a desperate battle while still aboard the Martian battleship. Miller’s partner, Havelock, goes missing.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E05 - Back to the Butcher
1.plot: Holden finds an unlikely ally. Miller’s obsession with Mao intensifies.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E06 - Rock Bottom
1.plot: Miller gains valuable information from a hidden data cube. Holden and his crew learn their host’s agenda.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E07 - Windmills
1.plot: Holden and his crew face a Martian military blockade. Miller finds a new reason to forge ahead. Avasarala visits Holden’s family.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E08 - Salvage
1.plot: A derelict vessel holds a potentially devastating secret. Holden and his crew cross paths with Miller on Eros. Avasarala receives bad news.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E09 - Critical Mass
1.plot: Julie's origin story ends up revealing her trajectory. Holden and Miller work together as they take a look at a strange emergency happening on Eros.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E10 - Leviathan Wakes
1.plot: Avasarala uncovers a game-changing secret while the future of the human race might be in Holden and Miller's hands.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E01 - Safe
2.plot: Unlikely allies Joe Miller and the crew of the Rocinante led by Jim Holden uncover more about the conspiracy to release the protomolecule on Eros station.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E02 - Doors & Corners
2.plot: With the help of Fred Johnson and the OPA, Miller, Holden and the crew stage a raid for information on the protomolecule. On Earth, Avasarala learns a truth about Fred Johnson.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E03 - Static
2.plot: Holden and Miller butt heads about how the raid was handled.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E04 - Godspeed
2.plot: Miller devises a dangerous plan to eradicate what's left of the protomolecule on Eros.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E05 - Home
2.plot: The Rocinante chases an asteroid as it hurtles towards Earth.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E06 - Paradigm Shift
2.plot: Earth and Mars search for answers in the aftermath of the asteroid collision.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E07 - The Seventh Man
2.plot: Preparations for the Earth/Mars peace conference tighten the tension on Erringwright.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E08 - Pyre
2.plot: Naomi tracks down signs of the protomolecule; Fred Johnson's control over the OPA collapses.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E09 - The Weeping Somnambulist
2.plot: Bobbie becomes a political pawn in the struggle between Earth and Mars.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E10 - Cascade
2.plot: Holden leads his crew through the war-torn station on Ganymede.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E11 - Here There Be Dragons
2.plot: Bobbie makes a decision that changes her life forever.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E12 - The Monster and the Rocket
2.plot: A discovery pushes Naomi and Holden apart and sets the Rocinante crew against each other.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E13 - Caliban's War
2.plot: The Rocinante crew must fight to save the ship.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E01 - Fight or Flight
3.plot: The Rocinante crew deals with the fallout over Naomi's betrayal while caught in the middle of the war between Earth and Mars while Avasarala and Bobbie hatch an escape plan.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E02 - IFF
3.plot: The Rocinante answers an unexpected distress signal. Bobbie and Avasarala find themselves being hunted by a mysterious captor. UN Secretary-General Sorrento-Gillis brings in a colleague from his past to lend an ear during this crucial time of war.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E03 - Assured Destruction
3.plot: As Earth strategizes a costly ploy to gain advantage in the war against Mars, Anna struggles to convince Sorrento-Gillis to do the right thing. Avasarala and Bobbie seek refuge aboard the Rocinante.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E04 - Reload
3.plot: The Rocinante tends to wounded Martian soldiers in exchange for supplies. Avasarala struggles with how to disseminate a key piece of evidence despite being in hiding.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E05 - Triple Point
3.plot: The search for Prax's daughter comes to a head. Admiral Souther's men plan for mutiny aboard the Agatha King

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E06 - Immolation
3.plot: The final battle between Earth and Mars threatens the very future of humanity. A new monster is unleashed on Prospero Station. Anna receives the smoking gun she needs.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E07 - Delta-V
3.plot: All eyes turn to the edge of the solar system as a mysterious new presence emerges; Naomi recommits to her roots; Drummer butts heads with a seasoned new commander aboard the Behemoth; and a young Belter makes a name for himself.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E08 - It Reaches Out
3.plot: An old friend taunts Holden with the answers he seeks. Naomi struggles to fit in. A mysterious low-level tech aboard the Thomas Prince enacts a terrifying plan.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E09 - Intransigence
3.plot: The Rocinante seeks a new gameplan as they attempt to avoid capture. Melba's true motives are revealed. Naomi is torn between identity and ideal. Anna seeks a way to stay aboard the Thomas Prince.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E10 - Dandelion Sky
3.plot: Holden sees past, present, and future. A ghost from Melba's past threatens her mission. Bobbie struggles to trust an old friend as she leads a group into unchartered territory.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E11 - Fallen World
3.plot: Drummer and Ashford find themselves trapped with few options for survival; Anna tends to the wounded masses as Melba continues to hunt down her prey; the Rocinante crew struggles to survive as Naomi reunites with her true family.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E12 - Congregation
3.plot: As survivors arrive to the Behemoth, two factions form over how to handle a life-or-death threat. Holden grapples with what he's seen and the choices he must make.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E13 - Abaddon's Gate
3.plot: Holden and his allies must stop Ashford and his team from destroying the Ring, and perhaps all of humanity.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E01 - New Terra
4.plot: The crew of the Roci investigates a strange protomolecule ruin on an alien planet. Bobbie copes with civilian life on Mars. Drummer and Ashford battle with piracy in the Belt.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E02 - Jetsam
4.plot: Avasarala is blindsided while on a visit to Mars. The Roci crew continue their protomolecule investigation while tensions between the RCE and Belters reach a tipping point. Drummer and Ashford track down a terrorist.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E03 - Subduction
4.plot: New alien threats emerge on Ilus as Naomi battles health challenges on the planet. Bobbie searches for a missing person on Mars. Avasarala faces a new challenge in the UN.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E04 - Retrograde
4.plot: Drummer and Ashford confront a dangerous person from Naomi's past. Murtry hunts down a target. Bobbie's makes a life-changing confession.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E05 - Oppressor
4.plot: As tensions on Ilus reach a boiling point, Holden reveals a secret. Avasarala debates Nancy Gao while an emergency on the Roci forces Alex and Naomi into action.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E06 - Displacement
4.plot: The Roci crew prepares for an incoming disaster on Ilus. Ashford and Drummer close in on an enemy within the Belt. Bobbie takes on a dangerous job.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E07 - A Shot in the Dark
4.plot: Naomi and Alex work to keep the Barbapiccola in orbit amidst a power outage. Avasarala faces a tough decision. Holden and Elvi race to find a cure for a disease spreading on Ilus.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E08 - The One-Eyed Man
4.plot: Avasarala faces fallout for the UN's military mission. Ashford and Drummer makes big decisions about their future within the OPA. A spreading illness on Ilus takes a toll on Amos. Alex and Naomi's attempt to rescue the Barb turns desperate.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E09 - Saeculum
4.plot: Holden and Miller race to save Ilus. Murtry puts his endgame into motion, putting the Roci crew's lives at risk.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E10 - Cibola Burn
4.plot: Ashford closes in on an enemy while uncovering a dangerous plot. Avasarala faces a crossroads in her personal and political life. The Roci crew works to reestablish life on Ilus in the wake of a deadly catastrophe.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E01 - Exodus
5.plot: Holden tries to convince Fred Johnson to destroy the last sample of protomolecule. Naomi gets an important lead to her son. On Luna, Avasarala begins to hunt for Marco Inaros.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E02 - Churn
5.plot: Holden and Fred deal with infiltrators on Tycho. Drummer's past comes back to haunt her. Amos returns to Baltimore. Alex and Bobbie's investigation on Mars leads to rogue soldiers.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E03 - Mother
5.plot: Naomi comes face to face with Filip. Holden and Fred turn the tables. Avasarala closes in on Marco's plot.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E04 - Gaugamela
5.plot: Marco's grand plan shocks Earth, Mars and the Belt.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E05 - Down and Out
5.plot: Amos and Clarissa are trapped in a collapsed building. Naomi contends with her old family. Holden assembles a new crew on the Roci. Alex and Bobbie make a dangerous discovery in the Belt.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E06 - Tribes
5.plot: Holden and the Roci go on the hunt. Amos and Clarissa seek shelter on a devastated Earth. Bobbie and Alex fight a desperate battle. Marco makes Drummer an offer she can't refuse. Avasarala returns to a position of power.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E07 - Oyedeng
5.plot: Naomi makes a desperate attempt to save her son from Marco. On the Roci, Holden battles for the last sample of protomolecule.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E08 - Hard Vacuum
5.plot: Amos returns to Baltimore with Clarissa. On Luna, Avasarala's alliances begin to shift. Alone and adrift, Naomi becomes a deadly lure.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E09 - Winnipesaukee
5.plot: Amos, Clarissa, and a gang of thieves work together to leave Earth. Avasarala tries to head off a brutal military strike. Drummer's new family bonds are tested as Naomi's life hangs in the balance.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E10 - Nemesis Games
5.plot: Holden and the Roci face off against Marco's forces and Drummer, while Alex and Bobbie attempt a dangerous rescue of Naomi, and the balance of power in the Solar System shifts.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E01 - Strange Dogs
6.plot: The Rocinante crew make a startling discovery on an asteroid. Avasarala and Bobbie contend with the devastation on Earth. Drummer and her family must make a heartbreaking decision. On Ceres, Marco and Filip's struggles turn inward.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E02 - Azure Dragon
6.plot: With an unexpected passenger aboard the Rocinante, Holden and crew undertake a dangerous mission that could shift the balance of power in the war. Drummer decides to make an uneasy alliance. Filip wrestles with his guilt.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E03 - Force Projection
6.plot: Avasarala, with the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars, takes the war to Marco. Filip and Marco's relationship is tested. The war becomes more perilous and personal for Holden and Naomi when the Rocinante is suddenly forced into a battle.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E04 - Redoubt
6.plot: Holden finds himself at odds with his crew when a controversial decision is uncovered. On Ceres, Avasarala struggles to contain an escalating humanitarian crisis. Drummer's growing faction stage a daring raid with dire stakes. Filip, demoted to repair skiff duty, makes an unexpected discovery.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E05 - Why We Fight
6.plot: Paths converge on Ceres when Drummer and her fleet arrive to aid the relief effort. Holden tries to convince Avasarala to release crucial information that might avert catastrophe, but she has her own request of him. As Amos and Bobbie get a little R&R at the station, Naomi has a difficult and long-awaited reunion.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E06 - Babylon's Ashes
6.plot: In the thrilling season finale, Inners and Belters fight side by side with the crew of the Rocinante in a last, massive, desperate battle with Marco and his Free Navy, with the fate of the Solar System, the Ring Gates, and of all humanity hanging in the balance.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: The recently returned Syrian warrior, June al-Baqee, is taken hostage by four Islamist terrorists, several of whom are believed to be returning Syrian warriors who – unlike June – fought ISIS in Syria. Philip Nørgaard, currently is on leave from TTF, June knows from the past and, unlike PET, believes that a major crime lies behind her disappearance. He decides to investigate the case on his own.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Philips’ hunt for June has led them both aboard the Swedish ferry in the Sound. As June opportunistically manages to escape the hostages and hide, they now have to panic search the ferry before it reaches land. Meanwhile, Philip manages to alert the Ferry Captain, who activates the terrorist alarm. Soon PET and the Defense Intelligence Service are realizing that a highly tense and apparently Islamist terrorist campaign is underway. The police anti-terror unit TTF is activated, but this time without Philip to lead it.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: The hostages have hijacked the ferry and taken passengers and crew hostage. While the ship is stationary in the middle of the Sound, the TTF from their position at Kronborg tries to get an overview of the situation. Negotiation and attack strategies are evaluated and the attackers motive investigated. On the ferry, the hostages still find June unsuccessful, and they must now use other means to lure her out of her hiding place. But Philip is also looking for June.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: With Philip trapped in the ferry’s freezer room, the hostages use harsh methods to grab June’s cell phone, which turns out to be the object of their kidnapping and hijacking. On land, investigators SP and Simon quickly try to get closer to the hostages’ identities, motives and possible conspiracies, while the TTF with the government in the back sets for an armed surprise attack to get all the hostages released and the situation shut down once and for all.
