meta.plot: In a town where clubs compete for supremacy, Ando Shintaro, the president of the "Zennichi Civil Engineering" contractors, lived a fulfilling life. Though he wasn't wealthy, he worked hard alongside his fellow colleagues. However, one day, the number one "Club Texas" appear in front of Shintaro and the others and are told that they are now under the umbrella of "Club Texas". Shintaro ponders this and consults with a lawyer regarding buying back the company. However, he is told that it's impossible since "Club Texas" on the number one club. Riki, an employee, goes into "Club Texas" on his own but gets into a fight. Furious, Shintaro rushes in to defeat the person who beat up Riki. However, the number one host there is his older brother that left 10 years ago.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E01 - The Galaxy Being
1.plot: A radio station engineer named Allan Maxwell establishes contact with an alien being. But when the station's power is turned up, the alien is teleported to Earth where its radioactive nature causes havoc.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E02 - The Hundred Days of the Dragon
1.plot: A sinister foreign power replaces the President of the United States with its own agent via the use of a powerful drug allowing the skin to be temporarily molded into any likeness.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E03 - The Architects of Fear
1.plot: A noble scheme goes horribly awry when a group of scientists plan an elaborate hoax designed to frighten and ultimately unite humankind.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E04 - The Man with the Power
1.plot: A radical experiment gives a college professor incredible power, which his subconcious mind uses to destroy his enemies.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E05 - The Sixth Finger
1.plot: A scientist discovers a way to speed up evolution and tries out the process on a simple miner.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E06 - The Man Who Was Never Born
1.plot: An astronaut travels to the 23rd Century, where he finds the Earth a blasted wasteland inhabited by monsters.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E07 - O.B.I.T.
1.plot: A new invention allows spying on anyone, anywhere.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E08 - The Human Factor
1.plot: At a military base far in the arctic, a man invents a machine which allows two minds to contact one another. An earthquake causes a malfunction and two men wake up to find that their minds have switched bodies.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E09 - Corpus Earthling
1.plot: A man with a steel plate in his head overhears conversations about global conquest. But where are the voices coming from?

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E10 - Nightmare
1.plot: In a war action with the planet Ebon, some soldiers are captured, interrogated and tortured.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E11 - It Crawled Out of the Woodwork
1.plot: An incredible being made of pure energy imperils the staff of a research lab and hides a deadly secret.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E12 - The Borderland
1.plot: A scientist named Ian Fraser invents a machine which can pierce the borderland between this world and... The Afterlife? Maybe. Fraser convinces an industrialist to finance future experiments with the possibility of contacting the rich man's dead son.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E13 - Tourist Attraction
1.plot: In a South American country a group of explorers discover a prehistoric monster in an ancient lake. The discovery leads them into conflict with the country's dictator.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E14 - The Zanti Misfits
1.plot: Exiles from the planet Zanti arrive on Earth, and a startling truth is uncovered when two human renegades invade their privacy.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E15 - The Mice
1.plot: A convict serving a life sentence finds that he has an alternative: change places with an alien.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E16 - Controlled Experiment
1.plot: Two Martian investigators probe our custom of homicide.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E17 - Don't Open Till Doomsday
1.plot: A young couple's honeymoon is cut short by the horrifying contents of a mysterious box.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E18 - ZZZZZ
1.plot: A queen bee assumes a human appearance in order to make an unwary scientist into her new mate.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E19 - The Invisibles
1.plot: A government agent infiltrates a secret criminal organization that uses alien parasites to control its members.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E20 - The Bellero Shield
1.plot: A scientist captures an alien that can protect itself with an unbreakable shield.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E21 - The Children of Spider County
1.plot: Four scientists disappear in one day. All were born in the same county, on the same day. A fifth scientist is in jail and a federal agent is assigned to the case. The fifth man is sprung from jail by a mysterious stranger who says he's the young man's father.

1.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S01E22 - Specimen: Unknown
1.plot: Scientists on a space station discover an unusual and dangerous plant.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E01 - Soldier
2.plot: Two soldiers from the future are thrust back through time to the present day.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E02 - Cold Hands, Warm Heart
2.plot: After returning from a mission to Venus, an astronaut can't seem to stay warm enough and has strange dreams about encountering a wraith-like being outside his spaceship window.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E03 - Behold, Eck!
2.plot: A scientist invents a pair of glasses which enable him to see and communicate with a two dimensional being.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E04 - Expanding Human
2.plot: A man experimenting with conciousness expansion drugs becomes super-human and not really human at all.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E05 - Demon with a Glass Hand
2.plot: A man with a glass hand attempts to unravel the mystery of who he is.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E06 - Cry of Silence
2.plot: A couple of motorists stranded in the desert are stalked by a bunch of tumbleweeds.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E07 - The Invisible Enemy
2.plot: A manned mission to Mars is menaced by Martian creatures who swim in the planet's sandy soil.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E08 - Wolf 359
2.plot: A college professor recreates the environment of a distant planet in a lab in order to study its evolution... which happens quickly.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E09 - I, Robot
2.plot: A robot is put on trial for the murder of his creator.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E10 - The Inheritors Part I
2.plot: After being shot in the head, a soldier gains a genius IQ and begins working fervently toward a mysterious goal.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E11 - The Inheritors Part II
2.plot: An investigation reveals a desperate plan involving the construction of a spaceship and a group of special children.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E12 - Keeper of the Purple Twilight
2.plot: An alien offers his technical knowledge of how to build a ray gun in exchange for a scientist's ability to feel emotions.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E13 - The Duplicate Man
2.plot: A man wants to capture a dangerous alien creature. Doing it himself would be way too dangerous, so he has his clone do it.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E14 - Counterweight
2.plot: Six future astronauts are put through a simulation of a long space flight.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E15 - The Brain of Colonel Barham
2.plot: A dying astronaut agrees to have his brain implanted into a robot body.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E16 - The Premonition
2.plot: An out-of-control test flight traps a pilot and his wife in a slow-moving time warp, and they're not alone.

2.title: FR - The Outer Limits - S02E17 - The Probe
2.plot: After flying into a hurricane, the crew of a cargo plane bound for Tokyo is captured by an alien space probe.

meta.plot: The Outer Limits is an anthology tv series of self-contained sci-fi-horror stories, sometimes with a plot twist at the end.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E01 - Qué Sera
1.plot: After the death of his wife, Sarah, John West packs up his three children and moves from their hectic urban life to his small northern hometown to take command of the local search-and-rescue service.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E02 - Making Lemonade
1.plot: Aunt Charlie’s house burns down, so the Wests move into a vacant water park. John meets his SAR team, and Maddie attends court-ordered therapy.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E03 - Sarah's Stuff
1.plot: The Wests search Sarah’s belongings for keepsakes. John rescues an injured hiker from a forest fire. Charlie faces an obstacle to rebuilding her home.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E04 - D-U-A-L-I-T-Y
1.plot: Taylor puts herself under intense pressure to win a school spelling bee. Scout clashes with a wrestling team rival. Maddie struggles to keep a secret.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E05 - 12 Months to the Day
1.plot: A sports rivalry stunt leaves two teens injured and the town powerless. Taylor organizes a party for her parents’ anniversary. Maddie is arrested.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E06 - The Little Things
1.plot: Scout gets kicked off the wrestling team. Taylor’s spelling bee blackout goes viral. Maddie and Henry share a kiss while playing truth or dare.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E07 - The Dividing Line
1.plot: John and Simmons rescue victims of an island plane crash. Scout conceals his team status from his father. Maddie’s attempt to defend Taylor backfires.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E08 - The Bear
1.plot: Scout calls on John to help a critically injured bear. Maddie receives important mail addressed to her mother. Taylor makes peace with Raji.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E09 - Wake Up
1.plot: Hurt while rescuing a motocross biker, John is placed into a medically induced coma. Charlie gets a proposal from Alex - to leave Turtle Island Bay.

1.title: FR - Northern Rescue - S01E10 - Dad Knows Best
1.plot: Maddie’s determination to learn the truth about her mother’s past with Rick Walker leads to an emotional confrontation - and exposes a family secret.

meta.plot: Après la mort de sa femme, John West retourne vivre dans sa ville d'origine de Turtle Island Bay, où il y reprend la tête du service de recherche et sauvetage local. Ses trois enfants et lui vont alors vivre leur deuil chacun à leur manière.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E01 - If I Hadn't Met You
1.plot: Husband and father of two Eduard suffers a sudden and devastating tragedy. In his grief, he meets a strange woman who offers him a unique opportunity.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E02 - The Key
1.plot: Eduard travels to a second parallel universe to change the fate of his loved ones, but is disturbed by the type of man he is in this alternate reality.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E03 - They Won't Meet
1.plot: Dr. Everest has Eduard reflect on choices he made right before two critical moments in his life: his father's death, and the first time he met Elisa.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E04 - I Shouldn't Have Met Him
1.plot: While trying to stop his college-age self from falling for Elisa in 1991, Eduard lands in a situation that could keep him stuck in the wrong universe.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E05 - The Kiss
1.plot: In 1991, Elisa accidentally experiences universe travel and confronts Eduard with her suspicions about his true identity. A different tragedy occurs.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E06 - I Don't Go In
1.plot: In the present, Òscar reveals to Eduard a secret Clara recently told him, which reminds Eduard of a time when he and Elisa had a critical fight.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E07 - It Is And It Isn't
1.plot: Eduard travels to a universe in which Elisa is a renowned singer, living a life very separate from his. But her gain in life means a new loss for him.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E08 - The Wings of a Butterfly
1.plot: Dr. Everest warns Eduard that even a small change can have a great impact, but he ignores her for a second chance at a missed moment with his son.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E09 - Sciences Or Arts
1.plot: When Clara and Òscar become convinced Eduard is delusional, he brings them to meet Dr. Everest to prove otherwise. Joan opens up to his son-in-law.

1.title: FR - Si je ne t'avais pas rencontrée - S01E10 - Universe Zero
1.plot: Dr. Everest's mysterious past and scientific endeavors are finally revealed to Eduard, as she shares her own family tragedy.

meta.plot: Eduard, un mari et père qui a perdu sa famille dans un tragique accident, voyage dans des univers parallèles en quête d'un destin plus heureux pour sa femme.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E01 - 1,000 People Fight for $5,000,000
1.plot: I gathered 1,000 people to fight for $5,000,000, the LARGEST cash prize in TV history! I don't know why you're still reading this, go watch it right now! No more spoilers.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E02 - 500 People Trapped in My City
1.plot: The remaining 500 contestants must fight to stay in the MASSIVE city I built from scratch (not joking). The end of the episode may be the craziest thing that's ever happened in television history. Watch it right now!

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E03 - The Solitary Experiment
1.plot: What would happen if three best friends were trapped in a room, but only two could escape? Watch and see for yourself right now!

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E04 - The Golden Ticket
1.plot: The rules are simple: fight for a seat on the helicopters, or lose $5,000,000. My private island awaits.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E05 - Fight to Win a Private Island
1.plot: You're about to witness someone win a private island AND continue to compete for $5,000,000. I just sent the Navy SEALs to hunt these players down. Stop reading and watch this episode.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E06 - Physical, Mental, Chance...Your Choice
1.plot: I gave the remaining contestants a choice. Play a physical game, play a mental game, or play a game completely left up to chance. No excuses!

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E07 - The Elimination Train
1.plot: How much money would it take to eliminate your best friend? Watch this episode as players make the hardest decisions of their lives. This one is brutal.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E08 - Betray Your Friend For $1,000,000
1.plot: The remaining 10 players take their share of $1,000,000 AGAIN. Will they split it evenly or will one of them take it all?

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E09 - Bribe Your Way To Finale
1.plot: The Final 10 use all of their current winnings to bribe their way to the finals. Lying and deception are at an all-time high, making it difficult to trust even your closest allies.

1.title: FR - Beast Games - S01E10 - $10,000,000 Coin Flip
1.plot: One contestant flips a coin to potentially double the grand prize to $10,000,000 or get eliminated. Beast Games crowns the winner of season 1.

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E01 - Strong vs Smart Compete for $5,000,000
2.plot: 200 of the strongest competitors and smartest minds in the world battle for 100 spots in Beast City to keep fighting for their chance at the $5,000,000 prize. Only the best of each team will advance as the Strong compete in a game of perseverance while the Smart battle in a game of focus - who will move on and who will go home?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E02 - Choose Your Fate
2.plot: After an unexpected twist, the 50 Smartest and 50 Strongest face their biggest decision yet. A $1,000,000 bribe is on the line that could change the course of the entire season: will the contestants accept MrBeast's life-changing offer? Or will they risk it all and bet everything on a challenge of their choice? The stakes couldn't be higher as players fight to earn their place among the Top 50.

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E03 - The Obstacle Course
2.plot: The Top 50 face their next brutal challenge, an obstacle course that demands the perfect balance of strength and smarts. As new alliances form and old friendships crumble, every victory counts with only half the contestants advancing. A fan-favorite challenge returns, testing loyalty and shattering promises. Everyone has a price, but who will break first?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E04 - The Survivor Takeover
2.plot: Survivor and Beast Games collide in the biggest competition crossover of all-time! Legendary host Jeff Probst joins MrBeast as contestants arrive on the world-famous Survivor island. Players face a series of iconic Survivor-inspired challenges with a $1,800,000 private island on the line. It all comes down to a Final Tribal Council… who will be Beast Games' newest millionaire?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E05 - Ask for Anything You Want
FR - Beast Games - S02E06 - Hearts Will Be Smashed
2.plot: A battle between brains and biceps takes place 100 feet in the air and across a massive life-sized puzzle to crown the strongest and smartest player in Beast City. Lies and deceit run wild as the winners must decide on three players' hearts to smash, eliminating them from the game entirely! No one is safe in Beast City… but first, will the $10,000,000 Coin even survive the final Cube?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E07 - Bury Me Alive
FR - Beast Games - S02E08 - Would You Steal $1,000,000?
2.plot: Buried underground with $1,000,000 up for grabs, every choice counts as each contestant can secretly take as much money as their heart desires. Personal stakes and old grudges collide as the tension between the players reaches a boiling point. Will they take their fair share, or will a new villain emerge once again?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E09 - Trust Nobody
2.plot: Voting begins... with nothing but a phone and their share of $1,000,000, the remaining players battle in a game of wits and social strategy to determine the Final 6. Friendships are tested and bribes run wild as one player's big secret is threatened to be exposed. How much is a spot in the finale worth, and who's willing to pay the price?

2.title: FR - Beast Games - S02E10 - $5,000,000 Decision
2.plot: Former alliances are shattered as the final six contestants backstab and scheme their way to bring $5,000,000 home. A truly life-changing amount of money is at their fingertips, but will it be Team Strong or Team Smart that is ultimately crowned the next Beast Games champion?!

meta.plot: Un millier de concurrents vont s'affronter dans des épreuves physiques et mentales à couper le souffle, pour tenter de gagner la somme de 5 millions de dollars. Chaque semaine, les participants devront faire preuve de force et d'esprit pour rester dans la course et remporter le premier prix.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E01 - Sometimes Heads Break
1.plot: Sleech and Klak perform an enticing, dangerous, and super illegal surgery.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E02 - The Land of Sex and Death
1.plot: Sleech and Plowp wrangle an exploding patient. Outside the hospital, Klak deals with her mom, which is more stressful than an exploding patient.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E03 - Tomorrow's Death is Yesterday's Problem
1.plot: Sleech and Klak treat a venture capitalist with an illicit time sickness and a great outfit.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E04 - The Curse of the Orlosh
1.plot: A sexually transmitted infection spreads quickly through the very horny hospital.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E05 - Beef Sturgeon Sleech
1.plot: A surprising doctor is chosen as temporary chief surgeon! Klak develops a new crush, and Matt goes on a sexy hunt for alien limbs.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E06 - That's Science, Baby!
1.plot: Happy St. Cthonk's Day! (The St. stands for scientist). While Sleech and Matt unexpectedly spend the holiday together, Klak does something equally festive: an autopsy.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E07 - Just One More Adjustment
1.plot: The galaxy watches as Sleech tries to save Klak from herself. Unrelated, Matt and Plowp do a lot of crying.

1.title: FR - Le (2ème) Meilleur Hôpital de la Galaxie - S01E08 - Apocalypse Got You Down?
1.plot: Sleech and Klak try to save the world and end up in a surprisingly roomy digestive tract.

meta.plot: Les docteurs Sleech et Klak affrontent un cas extrêmement dangereux et potentiellement révolutionnaire, qui pourrait mettre en péril la nature même de l'existence. Pourtant, au vu de leurs vies personnelles désastreuses, le néant ne paraît pas si dépaysant...

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When a U.S. Army unit arrives in Iraq for their first tour of duty, they quickly find themselves engaged in a bloody firefight and discover the essence of who they are as soldiers. Some show more mettle in the face of death, while others become paralyzed

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E02 - Roadblock Duty
1.plot: The squad is assigned to roadblock duty and is forced to shoot two motorists who ignore their orders to stop. Meanwhile, Boâ€™s estranged, alcoholic father visits him in the hospital.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E03 - The Prisoner
1.plot: The squad helps guard a prisoner who undergoes both physical and mental distress in order to find out vital information.. Bo requests to be taken off morphine. Sergio attends a family support group meeting. Eddy finds himself alone.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E04 - I Want My Toilets
1.plot: Angel's rifle skills come in handy when a supply truck must make a delivery to a dangerous area. Terry makes the house wheelchair accessible in preperation for Bo's return home.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E05 - Embedded
1.plot: When Smoke is implicated in the death of a civilian, his mother takes the news hard. An embedded reporter disappears after suggesting the death was an Iraqi setup.  Also, Bo gets his new prosthetic leg.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E06 - It's Alright Ma, I'm Only Bleeding
1.plot: The squad races against time to rescue journalist John Moffet before he is executed by his abductors. The team also learns a bounty has been placed on Smoke's head. Meanwhile, Bo returns home and Vanessa finally hits rock bottom.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E07 - Mission Accomplished
1.plot: The squad is assigned to guard a prison that is in not so good condition and soon find themselves in a dangerous situation. Mrs. B temporarily returns home to care for her autistic son.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E08 - Situation Normal
1.plot: The squad is assigned to protect workers installing a pipeline. Meanwhile, Mrs. B is AWOL in Hollywood mixing with some questionable characters and Bo tries to run on his prosthetic leg.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E09 - Spoils of War
1.plot: The squad faces a moral dilemma when they discover millions of dollars. Mrs. B returns from being AWOL and finds a friend in Dim. Meanwhile, Bo is training hard to return to his squad and Vanessa is sticking with AA and trying to make amends.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E10 - Suicide Rain
1.plot: Angel puts his own life at risk when an American is held hostage. Meanwhile, Sergio and Anna's relationship continues to grow, and Venessa tries to make up for her past.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E11 - Orphans
1.plot: The squad is ordered to evict the residents of an orphanage. Sergio is conflicted over his attraction to Anna. Meanwhile, Terry looks into why Bo has stopped receiving his military pay.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E12 - Weapons of Mass Destruction
1.plot: As the squad searches for an elusive bomber, they are joined by a squad of undertrained Iraqi soldiers. Meanwhile, Bo confronts his father and Vanessa continues to struggle with her alcoholism.

1.title: FR - Over There - S01E13 - Follow the Money
1.plot: (Season Finale) The squad is assigned to protect a civilian convoy. Lt. Underpants leadership skills take a toll on the squad. Back at home, Bo meets somebody who may be able to help him get back in the Army and Sergio receives surprising news from Anna.

meta.plot: Le quotidien de soldats américains en Irak. En ces temps troublés, ces hommes et femmes en uniformes doivent affronter la mort, ainsi que leurs peurs les plus terribles. Face à l'adversité, des liens très forts commencent à se créer entre eux... Dans le même temps, leurs proches, restés seuls au pays, doivent faire face à l'épreuve de la séparation.

1.title: FR - Coincoin et les Z'inhumains - S01E01 - Black Be Black
1.plot: Li'l Quinquin has grown up and now goes by the name of Coincoin. His girlfriend, Ève, has left him for another girl, Corinne, but he continues to run wild with his friend, Fatso. One day, in a field, he discovers a strange black magma that seems to have fallen from the sky. As Inspector Van der Weyden and his loyal assistant Carpentier investigate, new "extra-human" events occur.

1.title: FR - Coincoin et les Z'inhumains - S01E02 - The Extra-Humans
1.plot: Confronted with the irrational, Van der Weyden and Carpentier try to understand: are they seeing signs of alien activity? The invasion already seems to have begun. And as Coincoin seeks solace in the arms of the pretty Jenny, the locals give birth to clones as emotionless as they are disturbing.

1.title: FR - Coincoin et les Z'inhumains - S01E03 - Gunk, gunk, gunk!!!
1.plot: As more and more doubles appear and confusion grows, everyone seems to agree on one point: the end of the world is nigh. As for Van der Weyden and Carpentier, they continue to rush hither and thither and back again without getting closer to understanding anything at all.

1.title: FR - Coincoin et les Z'inhumains - S01E04 - The Apocalypse
1.plot: Van der Weyden and Carpentier, our unfailing representatives of law and order, decide to grasp the bull by the horns. But how can they when everything has become so disorientated and the dead have begun rising from their graves? Even Coincoin and his little gang, caught between fear and excitement, have become entangled in the never-ending carnival dance.

meta.plot: Suite à la découverte inexpliquée d’un magma extraterrestre, Quinquin, qui se fait désormais appeler Coin Coin, et les inspecteurs Roger Van der Weyden et Rudy Carpentier se retrouvent embarqués dans une nouvelle et folle aventure policière et existentielle…

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Helene Barizet's first act as new conductor is to choose Selena Riviere, the youngest musician, to take over as concertmaster. With musicians rebelling, what will happen at her first concert?

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The flooding is a serious threat to the orchestra's future, and Helene is confronted with a face from her past. Meanwhile, rumours about her husband's affair and her mother's death circulate.

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The mysterious death of a musician has massive aftershocks. Is the orchestra cursed? Leopold believes that Helene is responsible for the death. And Peter takes an important step.

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Taking advantage of a fainting spell by Helene, Leopold replaces her. Musicians threaten to strike, Rafael threatens to withdraw funding, and Helene fears she is a danger to those close to her.

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Helene's father has offered her reassurance, so she is determined to fight on and to expose her enemies within the Philharmonia. Will they turn out to be far closer to home than she realises?

1.title: FR - Philharmonia - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Selena has serious problems and Helene goes to Selena's mother to find out about her own past. But time is running out as the final concert is looming, so Helene must play her last card.

meta.plot: Hélène Barizet est une musicienne prodige devenue chef d’orchestre. Nommée à la tête du Philharmonia contre l’avis de la Direction et des musiciens, elle est la première femme à diriger un orchestre permanent. Son audace et sa conduite nourrissent les rancœurs tout autant qu’elles forcent l’admiration. Le Maestro a une saison pour faire sa place et sauver l’orchestre. Elle peut compter sur Selena Rivière, une jeune violoniste virtuose pour l’y aider. Hélène l’a nommée premier violon, bien décidée à lui transmettre sa passion et son génie musical. Mais comment transmettre quand tout ce que l’on souhaite, c’est rompre avec le passé ?

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E01 - Miss Sharp in the Presence of the Enemy
1.plot: Lowly teaching assistant Becky issues headmistress Miss Pinkerton with an ultimatum – pay her properly to teach at her Academy for Young Ladies or find her a station elsewhere. Miss Pinkerton calls Becky's bluff, and Becky is forced to pack away her meagre possessions. Kindly stockbroker's daughter Amelia Sedley takes pity on the poor orphan and offers to take her home for the week.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E02 - Miss Sharp Begins to Make Friends
1.plot: In darkest Hampshire, Becky spends her days as governess to Sir Pitt Crawley’s neglected daughters. Her employer's handsome youngest son, Rawdon, does his best to interest Becky in a flirtation. But Becky's ambition is to get into her employer's good books, and soon she is promoted to the position of Sir Pitt's indispensable secretary.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E03 - A Quarrel About an Heiress
1.plot: Becky lives with rich Aunt Matilda, and her future is looking bright. But as war clouds gather, everyone's fortunes take a tumble.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E04 - In Which Becky Joins Her Regiment
1.plot: When George refuses to apologise for his marriage to Amelia, his father sends him a letter, cutting him off from the family and denying him his inheritance. All the friends set sail for Belgium, where Becky makes use of every opportunity to advance in society.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E05 - In Which Battles Are Won and Lost
1.plot: The Napoleonic Wars enter their decisive moment as the battle of Waterloo gets underway, with George fighting on the front line. Becky has come to the conclusion that war is not such a bad thing, since it presents plenty of opportunities for money to be made.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E06 - In Which a Painter's Daughter Meets a King
1.plot: Becky works out how to live well on nothing a year, but flies too high as she joins the dizzy ranks of lords, ladies and kings.

1.title: FR - La foire aux vanités - S01E07 - Endings and Beginnings
1.plot: Becky is left alone in the world and living in greatly reduced circumstances when Steyne arranges for Rawdon to be shipped overseas. Dobbin discovers that Amelia plans to remarry, a revelation that inspires him to finally confess his feelings for her - but he is not prepared for her reaction. The Sedley family takes a holiday in Germany, where they are unexpectedly reunited with Becky - who gets the chance to perform a single good deed. Last in the series.

meta.plot: Angleterre, première moitié du XIXe siècle. Becky Sharp est une femme hypocrite, ambitieuse et sans scrupules : on assiste à son ascension au sommet de la Société Anglaise et à sa chute. Autour d'elle s'agite, dans une immense fresque, la "Foire aux Vanités".

1.title: FR - Madame Columbo - S01E01 - Word Games
1.plot: Kate Mulgrew is Kate Columbo, wife of the rumpled police lieutenant and - in her own right - a mother, homemaker and reporter for a neighborhood throwaway. In this week's opener, she also demonstrates a knack for investigation after she overhears a neighbor plotting the murder of his wife.

1.title: FR - Madame Columbo - S01E02 - Murder Is a Parlor Game
1.plot: An apparent suicide is actually the handiwork of a retired Scotland Yard investigator who is teaching a course that Mrs. Columbo is taking.

1.title: FR - Madame Columbo - S01E03 - A Riddle for Puppets
1.plot: A puppet maker is murdered by a tormented ventriloquist who acted at the urging of his "evil" dummy.

1.title: FR - Madame Columbo - S01E04 - Caviar with Everything
1.plot: Two women own a catering firm. Both love the same man. To one, the solution is obvious: murder.

1.title: FR - Madame Columbo - S01E05 - A Puzzle for Prophets
1.plot: A famous psychic engineers the murder of her business partner and appears to have an airtight alibi - she was demonstrating her "powers" to Mrs. Columbo at the time of death.

meta.plot: Cette série met en scène l'épouse du célèbre lieutenant Columbo. Entre son métier de journaliste et l'éducation de sa fille Jenny, la jeune femme se livre à la résolution de quelques enquêtes.

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E01 - First Potty Accident
1.plot: It's Hazzy's turn to lead the pajama parade, but he needs to go to the potty. What should he do to avoid an accident? Stop — and listen to his body!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E02 - First Time Making New Friends
1.plot: Kiki is new to Roo City and wants to meet friends at the playground. She feels shy at first — but soon discovers that saying hello is a great start!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E03 - First Morning Routine
1.plot: Luly wants to dance before nature class, but skipping her morning checklist will make her late. She learns that a routine keeps everything on track!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E04 - First Time I Couldn't Fall Asleep
1.plot: The Groovin' Roos concert is tomorrow, and Dewey is too excited to sleep! But if he doesn't calm down, he'll be too tired to enjoy the show.

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E05 - First Glasses
1.plot: Teshi's first trip to the eye doctor is full of new experiences. But asking questions and paying attention during the visit makes him feel less scared.

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E06 - First Sunburn
1.plot: It's pool party time, and Kiki's ready for some fun in the sun. But when she decides to skip out on the sunscreen, she gets a painful sunburn. Ouch!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E07 - First Snowy Day
1.plot: It's snowing in Roo City, and Dewey wants to play outside with his pals! But will he take the time to put on warm winter clothes to stay safe and cozy?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E08 - First Time Trying a New Food
1.plot: Hazzy's unsure about tasting a pickle for the first time. But with Teshi and Luly cheering him on, he might just discover a yummy new snack!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E09 - First Time Losing Something Special
1.plot: When Teshi can't find his favorite stuffed animal, he learns to handle the feelings of losing something important to him with the support of his friends.

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E10 - First Compromise
1.plot: Luly and Kiki are baking cookies for their friends but can't agree on a surprise ingredient. Can they come up with a solution that makes them both happy?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E11 - First Apology
1.plot: Kiki covers Teshi's puppet, Little T, with bubbles at Hazzy's car wash, which makes Teshi upset. Can Kiki fix things up with an apology?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E12 - First Time Getting a Shot
1.plot: Hazzy's worried about getting his first shot at the doctor. Will sharing his feelings with the other Wonderoos help him feel better?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E13 - First Time I Had to Be Calm
1.plot: Dewey's excited to see dinosaur bones and other exhibits at the museum. But he has to learn how to calm down before visiting a special room about space.

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E14 - First Time Talking About Differences
1.plot: Hazzy's painting a picture of the Wonderoos! When Luly notices that Hazzy missed one of her special features, will she say something — or keep it inside?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E15 - First Long Wait
1.plot: There's a long line for the magic show, and Teshi doesn't want to wait! Will he skip the show or enjoy the time with his pals?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E16 - First Time Getting Lost
1.plot: Hazzy wanders away from Luly to play a game at the carnival, then realizes he's lost. It's always best to stick with a buddy — and now he knows!

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E17 - First Time at the Dentist
1.plot: Kiki has her very first dentist visit, then goes home for a fun sleepover with friends. But will she do the right thing and brush her teeth before bed?

1.title: FR - Wonderoos - S01E18 - First Time I Didn't Want to Tell the Truth
1.plot: As the Wonderoos set up a surprise birthday party for Hazzy, Dewey sneaks a bite of the cake. Will he tell the truth when his friends ask what happened?

meta.plot: À Zooville, Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly et Teshi apprennent à se faire des amis, découvrent de nouveaux aliments et font tout plein de nouvelles expériences.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E01 - Hello Rainbow Road
1.plot: Separated from her Rider during battle, Horse wakes up in a colorful world filled with strange beasts. But where is her trusty friend?

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E02 - Fragile Things
1.plot: The herd sets out to find the way home. Wammawink encourages them to be careful and take it slow, but fearless Horse charges ahead.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E03 - The Key
1.plot: Horse meets Waterbaby — one of Centaurworld's shamans — and learns about the key: a mysterious object that could reunite her with Rider.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E04 - What You Need
1.plot: Searching for the next piece of the key, Horse leads the herd into a mysterious forest to see the tree shamans. They grant wishes — but there's a catch.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E05 - It's Hidin' Time
1.plot: The friends seek shelter in a cave during a storm... but they're not alone. While looking for an exit, they discover strange paintings on the walls.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E06 - Holes: Part 2
1.plot: The group follows the Rainbow Road into a deep, dark hole, where a Moletaur locks them in jail and informs them that they'll face the judge.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E07 - Johnny Teatime's Be Best Competition: A Quest for the Sash
1.plot: Zulius brings the herd to Cataur Valley, where the shaman is fuzzy but fierce. To earn a piece of the key, Horse goes glam for a silly competition.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E08 - Ride the Whaletaur Shaman!
1.plot: Horse hopes to find the final shaman in Merfolk Town. But she's growing discouraged — and looking more and more like a centaur every day.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E09 - The Rift (1)
1.plot: The herd makes it to the Rift and reminisces about their time together while waiting for Waterbaby to arrive with the final piece of the key.

1.title: FR - Centaurworld - S01E10 - The Rift (2)
1.plot: Horse and Rider face a frightening enemy. Back in Centaurworld, the herd summons up the courage to enter the void and fight for their friend.

meta.plot: Un cheval de guerre est transporté dans un monde étrange peuplé de centaures chantants.

1.title: FR - Ever After High - S01E01 - Stark Raven Mad
1.plot: Apple White is royally ready for Legacy Day! But her world -- and the entire world of Ever After High - will be flipped on its crown if Raven Queen questions her destiny instead of pledging it. Can Apple save her Happily Ever After from becoming a Happily NEVER After?

1.title: FR - Ever After High - S01E02 - True Reflections
1.plot: Mirror, mirror tell me true -- can Apple and Raven find another mirror like you? While Apple usually knows her mirror's answers, she's throne for a loop after Raven's magical aim interferes with her reflection.

1.title: FR - Ever After High - S01E03 - Maddie-in-Chief
1.plot: Madeline Hatter decides to go off script and run against Apple White™ in the Royal Student Council Election. Will Maddie's riddlish-filled debate win over the other students, or is she putting the cup before the kettle?

1.title: FR - Ever After High - S01E04 - Briar's Study Party
1.plot: Professor Rumplestilskin's plan of failing all the students may have worked in the past, but he may have met his match with Briar Beauty. She HAS been studying Forever After, you know. Now, if she can only keep her eyes open long enough to help the other students...

2.title: FR - Ever After High - S02E01 - Blondie's Just Right
2.plot: When Blondie Lockes uses her MirrorCast to prove that Ever After High's legends are true, Headmaster Grimm goes to great lengths to make sure her show ends up being just right.

3.title: FR - Ever After High - S03E01 - Ginger in the Breadhouse
3.plot: Ginger Breadhouse gets a little help from Raven Queen when she tries to prove to everyone that she just wants to bake spellbinding treats, not follow her story.

3.title: FR - Ever After High - S03E02 - Ashlynn's Fashion Frolic
3.plot: Ashlynn Ella’s evil stepsisters try to steal the spotlight at her spelltacular fashion show, but when the clock strikes 12, they find out what it’s like in their stepsister’s shoes.

3.title: FR - Ever After High - S03E03 - An Hexclusive Invitation
3.plot: Ashlynn gets an invitation to the exclusive Blue Moon Forest Fest, but Faybelle Thorn, daughter of the Dark Fairy, is only looking forward to causing trouble.

3.title: FR - Ever After High - S03E04 - Chosen with Care
3.plot: Ashlynn decides who to invite to the Forest Fest, and Dexter works up the nerve to ask Raven out.

meta.plot: Les enfants de célèbres personnages de contes de fées ont grandi. Lycéens, ils doivent désormais choisir quelle sera leur destinée.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E01 - Confessions of a Teenage Superhero
1.plot: While taking a break from the rigors of high school life, three friends cause a lab accident that results in them gaining incredible superpowers.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E02 - Pulled in Every Direction
1.plot: When Jake, Nathan and Ricardo are captured by Kane and Rook, instead of being punished, their lives are changed in unimaginable ways.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E03 - Ninja and the Ghost
1.plot: As they adjust to their new powers, the Flex Fighters encounter a mysterious ninja trying to take down Rook and Charter City.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E04 - Online Presence
1.plot: When computer hacker Circuit-Stream develops powers to pass through solid objects, it's up to the Flex Fighters to stop him from taking over the city.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E05 - Stretchipedes
1.plot: While Stretch and the Flex Fighters try to work out their issues, a mysterious villain schemes to take over Rook's latest creation, the Stretchipedes.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E06 - The Gangs of Old Town
1.plot: The Flex Fighters and Kane must confront former gangster Jack Kinland, who has taken over the criminal underworld with the help of Stretch Monster.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E07 - Fast Times
1.plot: Quick Charge, a scientist with the ability to skate on electricity, sabotages the city's electric grid in order to carry out revenge on Rook.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E08 - Lie Sandwich
1.plot: The Flex Fighters must race against Blindstrike to the location of Dr. C's downed plane, where secrets of the dangerous Hyper-Flexarium reside.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E09 - Singularity Event
1.plot: Stretch's odds of attending the school dance are slim when his powers go haywire after criminals Brick and Mortar hit him with an unknown weapon.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E10 - Crisis at the Cleo
1.plot: When the mysterious Tech Men take the museum hostage, Stretch and the Flex Fighters must find a way to stop them without revealing their identities.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E11 - Secret Ninja Party
1.plot: To discover the identity of Blindstrike, Stretch and the Flex Fighters work together with an unlikely ally to locate Dr. C’s secret base.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E12 - Endgame
1.plot: Stretch and the Flex Fighters race against Stretch Monster to secure a mysterious and dangerous chemical held by Blindstrike.

1.title: FR - Stretch Armstrong et les Flex Fighters - S01E13 - The Age of Flexarium
1.plot: With Stretch Monster’s sinister plan finally revealed, Stretch and the Flex Fighters must stop his Flexarium Army from taking over the world.

meta.plot: Jake Armstrong et ses meilleurs amis se transforment à l'improviste en super-héros et découvrent que leurs moyens d'action dépassent ceux des adolescents ordinaires.

1.title: FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Papa ou Maman - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Suite à une infidélité, deux époux décident de divorcer. Mais alors que chacun cherche à conserver la garde exclusive des enfants, César Mendès prend une décision surprenante qui va bousculer le semblant d'équilibre que pensait avoir trouvé la famille, d'autant plus quand les amis et les proches s'immiscent dans l'histoire.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E01 - Novo Mundo
1.plot: In 2033, the first human mission to Mars enters its atmosphere, while currently, SpaceX attempts to land the world's first reusable rocket.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E02 - Grounded
1.plot: The Daedalus crew battles harsh Martian terrain to reach base camp. NASA Astronaut Scott Kelly undergoes a mission on the International Space Station.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E03 - Pressure Drop
1.plot: In 2033, the Daedalus crew struggles to find shelter that can provide protection from radiation. In present day documentary, European Space Agency and Roscosmos partner to launch an orbiter that will help future Mars missions prepare for settlement.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E04 - Power
1.plot: A new crew arrives on Mars four years after the Daedalus landed to help execute plans for expansion and search for life. McMurdo Station in Antarctica serves as a modern example of how humans will settle Mars.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E05 - Darkest Days
1.plot: In 2037, the psychological pressures of life on Mars reveal themselves while the crew is trapped inside the habitat. In present-day, scientists study the effects of extreme isolation in various long-term analog missions.

1.title: FR - Mars - S01E06 - Crossroads
1.plot: In 2037, a devastating tragedy in the colony forces everyone on Mars and Earth to question the mission. In present-day, commercial space company SpaceX again attempts to pioneer the rocket technology that would help mankind reach the red planet.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E01 - We Are Not Alone
2.plot: After almost a decade alone on Mars, scientists at the International Mars Science Foundation’s (IMSF) fully developed Olympus Town settlement prepare for the arrival of a group of highly skilled astronauts working for Lukrum Industries, a for-profit corporation specializing in natural resource extraction. In present day on Earth aboard the world’s northernmost oil platform in the Arctic, extreme conditions make for a Mars-like work environment.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E02 - Worlds Apart
2.plot: IMSF and Lukrum, now sharing a common water and power source, have established a tenuous coexistence that threatens to dissolve when Kurt and his crew make unexpected headway in their mission to mine the planet, and Hana works to maintain diplomacy between the two camps—until tragedy strikes. Meanwhile, on Earth, Dr. Leslie Richardson asserts her authority as the new IMSF Secretary General. In present day, Greenpeace activists take to the seas to protest Arctic oil drilling in the Barents Sea, and the effectiveness of such tactics are examined.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E03 - Darkness Falls
2.plot: A solar flare knocks out communications on Mars and forces Olympus Town to locate exobiologist Marta Kamen before tragedy strikes. Meanwhile, the colony is bracing for its first-ever pregnancy on the Red Planet; tragedy strikes Hana (Jihae); and Amelie’s plans to return to Earth are thwarted. In present day, a scientist and his team on Earth brave harsh and dangerous conditions in the pursuit of data that will help predict the effects of glacial melt on global sea levels.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E04 - Contagion
2.plot: Marta convalesces as a mysterious illness sweeps through Olympus Town and Lukrum Colony. When IMSF realizes one of its own has died as a result, it races to determine the cause, origin and mode of transmission before time runs out—and more lives are claimed. Back in present day, Vladimir Chuprov, a Greenpeace activist, sheds light on an indigenous health crisis being kept quiet by the Russian state to benefit their Arctic oil endeavors.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E05 - Power Play
2.plot: Lukrum strikes a deal with Russia for exclusive mining rights. Uneasiness spreads over Olympus Town as LT. Commander Mike Glenn undermines Hana and endangers the members of Lukrum Colony as a result. And, a new baby – the first-generation Martian – arrives two months early! In the Arctic Circle in present day, nations attempt to work together to reign in corporate interests, protect fragile ecosystems and preserve indigenous lifestyles while fossil-fuel companies prioritize their own profit over the public good.

2.title: FR - Mars - S02E06 - The Shakeup
2.plot: Lukrum pushes its corporate interest too far and unintentionally jeopardizes the safety of both colonies. IMSF springs into action to stabilize the situation, but for some, it will be too late. In the current climate on Earth, human activity has destabilized the natural world. NASA’s Operation Icebridge studies Arctic sea ice in an attempt to bring awareness to global warming and the dramatically changing state of our planet, the only home we have… for now!

meta.plot: Le vaisseau spatial Daedalus a prévu d'atterrir sur Mars au mois de novembre de l'an 2033, comprenant l'équipage de six astronautes qui va effectuer sa première tentative afin d'établir une colonie permanente sur la Planète Rouge.

1.title: FR - The Confession Killer - S01E01 - Everything Except Poison
1.plot: The hunt for two missing women leads authorities to Henry Lee Lucas. In court, he drops a bombshell, setting off a media circus and riveting a nation.

1.title: FR - The Confession Killer - S01E02 - Make It Strawberry
1.plot: At Georgetown, Lucas regales visiting officers with stories to clear murder cases. But one Lubbock family will do their own police work to refute him.

1.title: FR - The Confession Killer - S01E03 - War in Waco
1.plot: Suspicions about Lucas’s confessions crescendo as a front-page investigative story hits the newsstands, and an ambitious DA takes on the Texas Rangers.

1.title: FR - The Confession Killer - S01E04 - All the Damn Lies
1.plot: As families long for closure, the manipulation continues. Years later, on death row, Lucas steps up the fight for his life. But the lies don't stop.

1.title: FR - The Confession Killer - S01E05 - Not One Shred of Evidence
1.plot: DNA testing and a close examination of the evidence reveal the truth about Lucas and the officers who let the real killers get away with murder.

meta.plot: Henry Lee Lucas est devenu tristement célèbre en avouant avoir commis des centaines de meurtres. Cette docu-série se penche sur les faits et leurs conséquences horribles.

1.title: FR - Lockerbie - Autopsie d'un attentat - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In 1988, the families of those on board flight Pan Am 103 learn that the plane has crashed over Lockerbie, Scotland, killing 270. A terrorism investigation begins.

1.title: FR - Lockerbie - Autopsie d'un attentat - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The prime suspects for the bombing of flight Pan Am 103 are a Palestinian terror group funded by Iran. But Scottish and FBI investigators are led elsewhere.

1.title: FR - Lockerbie - Autopsie d'un attentat - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A Libyan double agent provides the evidence needed to bring the two suspects to court. The trial gets underway, but a key witness changes his story.

1.title: FR - Lockerbie - Autopsie d'un attentat - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A shock verdict leaves the families unsatisfied. Doubt is cast on the court's decision, and 34 years after the bombing, a new suspect is taken into US custody.

meta.plot: Le 21 décembre 1988, le vol 103 de la Pan Am explose au-dessus de la petite ville écossaise de Lockerbie. Le réalisateur John Dower démêle les fils de l'histoire en s'entretenant avec certains des personnages clés de l'affaire qui s'expriment pour la première fois.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When MIT grad student Liam Cole discovers an asteroid is set to collide with Earth in 186 days, he joins forces with tech billionaire Darius Tanz and the U.S. government to try and stop it – and together they stumble onto the greatest conspiracy never told.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E02 - Another Trip Around the Sun
1.plot: Darius and Liam work to invent a theoretically impossible piece of technology to divert the asteroid, and Grace risks everything to help Darius. Also, Liam heads home to Boston to track down critical research, but finds something shocking instead.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E03 - Truth or Darius
1.plot: It’s a race against time as Darius must accelerate his plan to stop the asteroid before the Pentagon shuts him down. Also, Grace has to make difficult decisions that could have life or death consequences for millions of people, and Liam and Jillian reunite under surprising circumstances.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E04 - The Human Strain
1.plot: In order to prove to Harris and Grace that he’s not a traitor, Darius must reveal one of his most closely guarded secrets. Also, Liam helps Jillian adjust to her new job at Tanz.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E05 - Keeping the Faith
1.plot: While Darius works to discover who killed his friend Lazlo, he is forced to reckon with his past, and Liam discovers who’s been selling secrets to the Russians.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E06 - Chip Off the Ol’ Block
1.plot: Darius recruits Grace, Harris and Liam for a dangerous mission, and Jillian confronts Liam about his secret.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E07 - Seeing Red
1.plot: Grace and Darius slip off to Russia behind Harris’ back in an attempt to stop a potential nuclear conflict. Also, Liam seeks solace with Amanda.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E08 - From Russia, With Love
1.plot: Framed for murder, Darius and Grace must try to escape from Russia, and Liam tries to convince Jillian to come back to Tanz.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E09 - Patriot Games
1.plot: Grace narrowly escapes a deadly assassin and Darius and Liam forge unlikely alliances.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E10 - Coup de Grace
1.plot: Grace and Darius seek answers from the President and Harris discovers deadly secrets.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E11 - All In
1.plot: Grace and Harris must forge an alliance when their children’s lives are in jeopardy. Also, Liam presents Jillian with an unusual proposal.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E12 - The Wormwood Prophecy
1.plot: Darius, Grace and Harris join forces to prove the president was murdered. Also, Grace tells Zoe the truth.

1.title: FR - Salvation - S01E13 - The Plot Against America

meta.plot: Cette série suit les aventures de la petite Ada Twist, 8 ans, une scientifique poids plume à la curiosité insatiable, qui veut tout savoir sur tout. Avec l'aide de ses complices, Rosie Revere et Iggy Peck, Ada dénoue et résout des mystères pour ses amis et sa famille. Mais trouver la clé du mystère n'est que le début de l'aventure ! En effet, la science ne se limite pas à répondre aux questions "Comment ?", "Pourquoi ?", "Quoi ?" Encore faut-il mettre ses connaissances en action pour rendre le monde meilleur.

Lorsqu'une fille du coin disparaît en laissant des traces de sang dans sa voiture, la jeune femme pense saisir l'occasion rêvée. Aussi, quand la victime réapparaît le jour suivant comme si rien ne s'était passé, Riya est décontenancée. Suivent une série d’événements étranges et de crimes horribles qui ne semblent pas inquiéter les habitants...

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E05 - Awesome Possum

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E06 - Frozen Fiasco

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E07 - Sky's The Limit

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E08 - All That Llama Drama

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E09 - A Good Day To Dino

1.title: FR - Action Pack - S01E10 - Trophy Trouble

meta.plot: Armés de leur bonté, d'un esprit vif et de super-pouvoirs, les jeunes héros de l'Académie Action font équipe pour vaincre les méchants et faire ressortir le bon en eux !

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Katie, a frustrated cable news producer, is horrified when her mom, Carol, gets an internship at "The Breakdown."  Despite Katie's best efforts, Carol is instantly beloved by the entire office, including blowhard veteran anchor Chuck. But when Katie hits a roadblock while producing a big story, she realizes that maybe having a mom at work isn't such a bad thing.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E02 - Bear Attack
1.plot: Katie tries to set workplace boundaries with Carol, but when a big story about an escaped bear lands in her lap, her mom can't help but meddle. Meanwhile, Greg tries to get Chuck and Portia to do a little friendly banter at the end of the show.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E03 - Chuck Pierce Is Blind
1.plot: Chuck is having cataract surgery and, for the first time ever, must miss a day of work. Carol, eager to shirk her overwhelming intern duties, offers to take care of him. Meanwhile, Katie is excited for a peaceful day but with Chuck gone, Greg is reluctant to be the bad guy. As a result, "The Breakdown" descends into chaos as Greg is forced to say yes to Portia, Justin and everyone else's "great ideas for the show."

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E04 - War Is Hell
1.plot: Katie's secret war reporter boyfriend, Trip, is back in town and working at the MMN offices. Despite Katie's best efforts, Carol quickly uncovers the covert relationship using a plan she stole from "Days of Our Lives". Meanwhile, Chuck, feeling threatened by Trip, is determined to return to the field. Greg and Justin support the idea until they find footage of Chuck's time as a war reporter in the '90s.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E05 - Snowmageddon of the Century
1.plot: A huge snowstorm traps everyone in the building overnight. Meanwhile, Portia convinces Katie that Chuck's romantically interested in her; and Carol saves the day when she breaks into the offices of their competitor and steals all the morning show's wine.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E06 - Serial Arsonist
1.plot: Katie gets an opportunity to appear on the air after a field reporter is exposed as an arsonist, leading Carol to embrace the role of stage mom. Meanwhile, Chuck tries to compose a new theme song for the show after growing jealous of Portia's creative pursuits.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E07 - The Red Door
1.plot: Carol is excited when Chuck asks her to wait for the cable guy at his townhouse, until Chuck gives an ominous warning that tests her curiosity. Meanwhile, Portia's phone gets hacked and Katie struggles not to read her private emails.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E08 - Celebrity Hacking Scandal
1.plot: Katie secretly investigates a celebrity phone hacking ring behind Greg's back. In Katie's absence, Carol falls into producing a piece on her favorite phone game, "Biscuit Blitz." Meanwhile, Chuck gets in hot water when Portia accuses him of mansplaining.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E09 - Carol Has a Bully
1.plot: Carol has a midterm she must pass in order to keep her internship. Katie needs to choose between helping her mom and focusing on her hacking story, which she can't seem to crack. Meanwhile, Greg's wealthy estranged grandmother pays a visit to the office. Chuck finds her cold and cruel, but almost immediately falls in love with her.

1.title: FR - Great News - S01E10 - Carol's Eleven
1.plot: Katie makes a huge discovery about the story she's been chasing and, with the help of Carol and the rest of the staff, concocts a scheme to get the story out. Greg struggles with balancing his conflicting loyalties to his family, co-workers and conscience.

meta.plot: S'entendre avec ses collègues peut s'avérer difficile mais travailler avec sa mère ? C'est une tout autre histoire ! La vie de Katie, une jeune productrice d'un journal télévisé, est bouleversée lorsque sa mère décroche un stage dans la chaîne de télévision pour laquelle elle travaille.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E01 - The Tick vs. The Idea Men
1.plot: Tick and Arthur reveal their superhero origin story.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E02 - The Tick vs. Chairface Chippendale
1.plot: A criminal mastermind with an evil plan and a face only an interior decorator could love.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E03 - The Tick vs. Dinosaur Neil
1.plot: Mutant Dino-Park scientist Neil proves to be a major headache.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E04 - The Tick vs. Mr. Mental
1.plot: Mr. Mental hypnotizes The Tick and sends him to steal the Thinking Cap from Pendecker Labs.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E05 - The Tick vs. The Breadmaster
1.plot: The Breadmaster is an evil baker that uses baked goods to terrorize The City.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E06 - The Tick vs. El Seed
1.plot: El Seed hopes to take over the city by bringing all of the plants and trees to life.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E07 - The Tick vs. The Tick
1.plot: A night at the local superhero bar turns explosive thanks to the evil midnight bomber!

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E08 - The Tick vs. The Uncommon Cold
1.plot: Arthur is nursing The Tick, who is infected with a most uncommon cold!

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E09 - The Tick vs. Brainchild
1.plot: While Charles's parents discuss child-rearing with no punishinment, their Branchild is ending Earth!

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E10 - The Tick vs. Pineapple Pokopo
1.plot: Arthur and The Tick try to rescue Yank, a super-genius, space monkey, captured by an evil ruler.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E11 - The Tick vs. The Mole-Men
1.plot: The King of the Mole People and his ministers come to the surface for a vacation.

1.title: FR - The Tick - S01E12 - The Tick vs. The Proto-Clown
1.plot: A clown with a major hang-up. Laugh at him and you'll pay the price.

1.title: FR - Picnic at Hanging Rock - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In the final decade of the 19th century, mysterious widow, Hester Appleyard, arrives in Australia, haunted by a secret past. Here, in the new world, she establishes a successful school for young ladies. But six years later, on Valentine's Day, 1900, the enigmatic headmistress allows her pupils to picnic at Hanging Rock. And there, in the strange brooding landscape, something unthinkable happens.

1.title: FR - Picnic at Hanging Rock - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hester's three star pupils and a governess have disappeared. Led by a dogged sergeant, local men search for the missing. Has something supernatural befallen them? Or has a human outrage occurred? An aristocratic young Englishman, Michael Fitzhubert, was the last person to see the girls, and when the search is abandoned, he is compelled to return to the Rock where he makes a shocking discovery.

1.title: FR - Picnic at Hanging Rock - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The missing Rothschild heiress, Irma Leopold, has been found, remarkably unharmed, but claiming to remember nothing. Meanwhile, rumours spread and the sergeant turns his attention to the college. What secrets lie hidden behind the locked gates? His investigation intensifies Hester's paranoia and she grows certain that the young orphan, Sara, knows something about the disappearance.

meta.plot: En 1900, en Australie. Trois élèves et l'une de leurs professeurs disparaissent mystérieusement au cours d'un pique-nique près du site de Hanging Rock.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Having recently discovered time travel, Dan, a facilities manager at a small Massachusetts college, has been transporting himself back to the 1700s to spend time with the colonial woman for whom he's fallen. In the present, Dan is misunderstood by all, and anxious that life is passing him by. But in the 18th century, he's absolutely hilarious - he gets the girl and makes friends. But Dan's actions in the past are messing up the present. That woman he's dating is not just any woman. She's Paul Revere's daughter, Deborah, and Dan's meddling causes her father to delay his famous ride, which may have altered the outcome of the entire American Revolution. To set matters right, Dan enlists the help of Chris, a brilliant, polished and popular history professor at the college, who's now given the incredible opportunity to actually live the history he teaches.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E02 - The Shot Heard Round the World
1.plot: Dan and Deb head back to colonial times to rescue Chris and help spark the Revolutionary War. Dan and Chris are forced to go undercover as British allies as they simultaneously try to rally the colonists to revolt in the Battle of Lexington. Unexpected friendships are formed and history is remade.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E03 - The Boyfriend Experience
1.plot: Deborah slowly discovers that Dan may not be the thrilling inventor he claimed to be back in 1776, and questions their budding relationship. To get her back, Dan resorts to desperate (and alarming) measures. Meanwhile, Chris is under intense scrutiny from his mentor, Dr. Cobell, as he works to finally achieve tenure at the university.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E04 - Chadwick's Angels
1.plot: In need of a victory, the trio heads back to the 1990s to give Dan another shot at his childhood dream: finishing the infamous "Bellybuster" ice cream sundae at a local parlor. As Deb bonds with the parlor's owner, Chris is on a mission to save a life in honor of his late British friend. But all of their plans are derailed when Dan runs into the bully that tormented him.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E05 - The Touchables
1.plot: In need of some quick cash for Deb to purchase an ice cream parlor, the trio decides to make some money rather than save the world. But after Chris devises a strategy to cash in on the fixed 1919 Chicago World Series baseball game, their get-rich-quick scheme is derailed when they run into the infamous mobster Al Capone.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E06 - The Godfriender
1.plot: Dan, Deb and Chris find themselves stuck in 1920s Chicago, with Al Capone holding their time travel bag hostage. Chris opts for a play-it-safe plan, using history to take out Capone, while Dan and Deb befriend him instead. As they teach him how to be a better mobster - and husband - they quickly realize that proving their loyalty may not be as easy as they thought.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E07 - Night Cream
1.plot: With the ever-present threat of losing tenure looming over him, Chris reaches out to John Hancock and Samuel Adams to help spice things up in the classroom in 2017. Meanwhile, Deb's dream of re-opening Chadwick's ice cream parlor is finally coming to fruition, but Dan has a few marketing ideas of his own.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E08 - The Duel
1.plot: Just as they're heading back to colonial times, John Hancock and Sam Adams meet the woman of their dreams and decide that there's no better way to determine who gets to court her than a classic duel. In the meantime, in hopes of garnering good publicity for Chadwick's, Dan sets up a meeting with a local reporter, who winds up asking some challenging questions about Deborah's identity.

1.title: FR - Making History - S01E09 - Body Trouble
1.plot: Chris' life is in shambles, so Dan plays the time travel card with Dr. Cobell to help get Chris' job back, but his efforts go awry when he accidentally gives him a heart attack instead. Meanwhile, Deb hunts down Hancock and Adams to convince them to return to the past.

meta.plot: Dan Chambers, professeur d'informatique dans une petite université du Massachusetts, découvre qu'il peut voyager dans le temps et se rend à plusieurs reprises au 18ème siècle, où il s'est épris d'une belle jeune femme prénommée Deborah. Seulement, ses actions dans le passé semblent avoir des répercussions sur le présent, d'autant plus que sa prétendante n'est autre que la fille du patriote Paul Revere. Il ne le réalise pas, mais il est peut-être en train d'altérer le déroulement de la Révolution Américaine. Pour que tout rentre dans l'ordre, Dan finit par demander de l'aide à son collègue historien, Chris Parish.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E01 - The Day I Became a Shinigami
1.plot: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E02 - A Shinigami's Work
1.plot: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E03 - The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
1.plot: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E04 - Cursed Parakeet
1.plot: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E05 - Beat the Invisible Enemy!
1.plot: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E06 - Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
1.plot: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E07 - Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E08 - June 17, Memories in the Rain
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E09 - Unbeatable Enemy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E10 - Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
1.plot: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E11 - The Legendary Quincy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E12 - A Gentle Right Arm
1.plot: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E13 - Flower and Hollow
1.plot: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E14 - Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E15 - Kon's Great Plan
1.plot: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E16 - The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
1.plot: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E17 - Ichigo Dies!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E18 - Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E19 - Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
1.plot: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E20 - Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
1.plot: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E21 - Enter! The World of the Shinigami
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E22 - The Man who Hates Shinigami
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are forced to find another way into Seireitei due to 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru's intervention.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E23 - 14 Days Before Rukia's Execution
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the household of the Shiba Clan.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E24 - Assemble! The 13 Divisions
1.plot: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin their preparations to get into the Seireitei, the Gotei 13 captains assemble for a meeting.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E25 - Penetrate the Center with an Enormous Bombshell?
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the Seireitei.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E26 - Formation! The Worst Tag
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are scattered throughout the Seireitei, where they encounter new enemies.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E27 - Release the Death Blow!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki completes his battle with 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame while his friends continue to progress through the Seireitei.

1.title: FR - Bleach Kai - S01E28 - Orihime Targeted
1.plot: Ganju Shiba wins his battle against 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa while Uryū Ishida begins his own.

meta.plot: Adolescent de quinze ans, Ichigo Kurosaki possède un don particulier : celui de voir les esprits. Un jour, il croise la route d'une belle Shinigami (un être spirituel) en train de pourchasser une "âme perdue", un esprit maléfique qui hante notre monde et n'arrive pas à trouver le repos. Mise en difficulté par son ennemi, la jeune fille décide alors de prêter une partie de ses pouvoirs à Ichigo, mais ce dernier hérite finalement de toute la puissance du Shinigami. Contraint d'assumer son nouveau statut, Ichigo va devoir gérer ses deux vies : celle de lycéen ordinaire, et celle de chasseur de démons...

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Calvin Hastings returns home to reconnect with his family, but the reunion is cut short by a string of killings perpetrated by a supernatural villain only Calvin and his family can take down.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E02 - The Dredge
1.plot: The Dredge sends a Trojan horse to the Hastings Funeral Home to gather information about the Ring of Solomon. Calvin and Isaac subdue the intruder, but it comes at a great cost.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E03 - Half Truths & Half Breeds
1.plot: Isaac sends a mysterious half-human-half-infernal to help Calvin with the fight in La Rochelle.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E04 - Through The Looking Glass
1.plot: While on a case, May is sucked into a mysterious mirror world, and the Hastings must save her before the witch that inhabits the mirror world escapes using May's comatose body as a free ride. Bea, Garvey and Tilly grapple with how to properly bury a known racist.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E05 - Tangled Web
1.plot: The Hastings are visited by a local mystic, Aunt Nancy, who believes she has the answer to defeating The Dredge.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E06 - Dr. Dredge M.D.
1.plot: The Dredge returns, but this time he inhabits the body of May's old flame, Dr. Kim; Calvin trains; Garvey grapples with her parents' rekindled romance.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E07 - Echoes of My Mind
1.plot: The Dredge captures Calvin and tries to torture him into releasing the evil demons imprisoned in his ring; the Dredge's minions descend on the town's Founders Day Festival.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E08 - You're Not My Momma
1.plot: Calvin and the gang take on a demonic doll intent on finding justice for her recently deceased, surrogate mom; Isaac strikes an unlikely truce with Mayor Bickley.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E09 - Uncle Bubba
1.plot: Garvey and Russ venture into an old house designed by a mysterious clock demon, who traps them inside; Calvin, Isaac, May and Bea's cousin Leon try to free them.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E10 - Green-on-Blue
1.plot: Calvin tries to get to the bottom of some mysterious deaths at a nearby military base; Garvey and Russ experiment with her powers; Tilly buries her recently deceased mother.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E11 - Back to One
1.plot: The Hastings family is trapped in a time loop designed to end in their deaths unless they can find the root of the loop and break the spell.

1.title: FR - Superstition - S01E12 - Resurrection
1.plot: The Dredge possesses Calvin to break free of the Ring of Solomon and re-inhabit his original body.

meta.plot: Une famille aux dons surnaturels se bat pour préserver sa petite ville du Sud des États-Unis des esprits malins et autres funestes intrusions de l'au-delà.
