1.plot: Norma discovers a portal into Pauline Phoenix's movies — and a new mystery emerges when the friends follow her there.

1.title: FR - Dead End: Paranormal Park - S01E09 - The Phantom of the Theme Park
1.plot: With the help of Pugsley's musical spell, Barney and Norma try to stop Pauline's plan. Meanwhile, Courtney wrestles with a dilemma.

1.title: FR - Dead End: Paranormal Park - S01E10 - Into the Fire
1.plot: Barney and Norma face off against a mob of ancient demons who've turned all the park guests to stone — and kidnapped Patrick!

meta.plot: Deux adolescents et un carlin qui parle font équipe pour combattre des démons dans un parc à thème hanté - et peut-être même sauver le monde d'une apocalypse surnaturelle.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E01 - Whap
1.plot: Abby Mills returns to Harper's Island for the wedding celebration of her best friend, Henry Dunn, and his fiance, Trish Wellington. Abby hasn't been home in seven years, since her mother and five others were murdered by John Wakefield.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E02 - Crackle
1.plot: The wedding party heads out on a scavenger hunt. While out, Trish meets up with an old flame, Henry talks to the locals, and Abby runs into a friend who has been haunted by John Wakefield.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E03 - Ka-Blam
1.plot: When a local girl’s death is ruled a suicide, Abby challenges her father, the Sheriff, to investigate what really happened. As the wedding approaches, Trish must come to a decision about Hunter.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E04 - Bang
1.plot: The groomsmen take Henry fishing for his bachelor party and make a gruesome discovery. The bridesmaids celebrate Trish's final days as a bachelorette with a psychic who has a very strong reaction to Abby.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E05 - Thwack
1.plot: A father/daughter bike ride in the woods leads to a startling revelation. Abby uncovers the Sheriff's secret obsession as Trish and Henry's wedding rehearsal takes an unexpected turn.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E06 - Sploosh
FR - Harper's Island - S01E07 - Thrack, Splat, Sizzle
1.plot: The wedding guests begin preparing to leave the island but the Sheriff suspects that one of them is the killer. Some new information reveals an eerie connection between Abby and Wakefield.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E08 - Gurgle
1.plot: As the guests get ready to leave the island, one guest mysteriously disappears. Abby receives a phone call from someone threatening to kill the missing guest if anyone leaves the island.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E09 - Seep
1.plot: The group turn against each other. However they find a map and are forced to come together to find  Madison.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E10 - Snap
1.plot: An attempt to leave the island after Katherine has been killed turns into a disaster that will keep the remaining members of the wedding trapped for now. Meanwhile they find out a secret that will leave them reeling, and four more victims are claimed.

1.title: FR - Harper's Island - S01E11 - Splash
1.plot: Abby confronts the killer, but the guests start thinking he may have an accomplice. Another guest dies and another goes missing.

meta.plot: Une petite île au large de Seattle abrite une ville dans laquelle six meurtres ont eu lieu il y a sept ans. Parmi les victimes figurait la mère d'Abby Mills qui, après cette tragédie, a décidé de déménager à Los Angeles. Mais elle se voit obligée de revenir sur l'île lorsque Henry, son ami d'enfance, se marie avec Trish Wellington. Ces derniers ont invité tous leurs amis et toute leur famille au mariage.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E01 - The World of Swords
1.plot: It's launch day for one of the most highly-anticipated video games of all time. Join the character "Kirito" as he begins his journey in the virtual world of Sword Art Online.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E02 - Beater
1.plot: It’s been one month since the players have been locked in the game.  2000 people have died; the first floor hasn’t been cleared yet.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E03 - The Red-Nosed Reindeer
1.plot: Kirito has finally joined a guild made up of close friends in reality.  Everything is going well until a tragic accident changes Kirito completely.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E04 - The Black Swordsman
1.plot: Silca is known as Dragon Tamer Silca, but after leaving her group she is caught and her pet, Pina paid the ultimate price.  Before she is killed, Kirito saves her and offers her a choice.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E05 - Murder in the Safe Zone
1.plot: A player has been killed inside a safe zone and not by the known means.  Asuna and Krito take it upon themselves to find out how and why this is happening.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E06 - Illusionary Avenger
1.plot: Kirito has figured out the how and now he has to figure out the why.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E07 - The Temperature of the Heart
1.plot: A trip to get a new sword leaves Kirito battling a dragon and his fears.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E08 - The Sword Dance of Black and White
1.plot: After 2 years, people have got used to living in SAO, with a dwindling front line it might just be up to Kirito and Asuna to continue the charge.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E09 - The Blue-Eyed Demon
1.plot: To save a group of players and Asuna from a Boss character, Kirito is forced to play his trump card.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E10 - Crimson Killing Intent
1.plot: Kirito has agreed to a duel with the head of the Blood Alliance Knights.  If Kirito wins, Asuna is free to leave the Knights and if he loses…

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E11 - The Girl of Morning Dew
1.plot: The newly married couple is enjoying their time away from the front lines.  But a new guest will take them all the way back to the beginning.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E12 - Yui's Heart
1.plot: Yulier, second in command, of the Liberation Army has approached Kirito and Asuna for help saving her friend and her guild.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E13 - Edge of Hell's Abyss
1.plot: While enjoying a fishing tournment Kirito receieves an urgent e-mail from the leader of the guild requesting their return.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E14 - The End of the World
1.plot: Game over.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E15 - Return
1.plot: Kirigaya is adjusting to his life outside of the game, but he hasn't forgotten about Asuna. A recent visit to her in the hospital, he meets Sugou Nobuyuki.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E16 - Land of the Fairies
1.plot: A new MMO allows users to fly and encourages player killing. Kirito has joined this new game in search of Asuna and is pleasantly surprised with what he finds.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E17 - Captive Queen
1.plot: As Kirito learns about the game from Leafa and the hatred between the races, Asuna learns the truth of her role from the Fairy King.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E18 - To the World Tree
1.plot: Leafa is making enemies leaving her area and group to team up with Kirito. On their way to neutral Territory, they speak more of the rules and areas of the ALO.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E19 - The Lugru Corridor
1.plot: Something isn’t right; Recon has sent Leafa a message “I was right. Be careful. S."  What does he mean and will Leafa and Kirito have the time to figure it out?

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E20 - General of the Blazing Flame
1.plot: Kirito and Leafa have made it to the meeting and Kirito’s bluff as an ambassador has been called out.  If he can survive in a fight against the Salamanders General Eugene, his plan to prevent a war might work.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E21 - The Truth about Alfheim
1.plot: While Asuna continues her attempt to escape, another woman in Kirito’s life tries to make sense of her emotions.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E22 - Grand Quest
1.plot: Kirito’s determination to save Asuna borders on the insane.  His reckless is stopped when Leafa suddenly logs out.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E23 - Bonds
1.plot: Even though a wall has been built between Kirito and Sugu, he must save Asuna.  The next time he challenges the final dungeon he won’t be alone.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E24 - Gilded Hero
1.plot: Kirito, Asuna, and Yui are finally together again, but the locks placed on Asuna are unbreakable.  Before they have a chance to come up with a plan, the fairy king makes his grand entrance.

1.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S01E25 - The World Seed
1.plot: Kirigaya Kazuto has beaten death twice but there is one more thing he must do.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E01 - The World of Guns
2.plot: A year has passed since SAO was cleared. Summoned by Kikuoka of the Virtual Division at the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Kazuto learns of a series of bizarre murders linked to the popular VR game, Gun Gale Online (GGO), the only game in Japan played by pros.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E02 - Cold-Hearted Sniper
2.plot: Armed with a large sniper rifle, Hecate II, the young girl Sinon is making a name for herself as the No. 1 sniper in GGO. When her squadron ambushes another squadron, she succeeds in taking out her first target. But when she takes aim at her second target, a robed “Behemoth,” he dodges the bullet.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E03 - Memories of Blood
2.plot: In real life, the player Sinon is a high school student named Shino Asada. On her way home from school, she’s dragged into an alley by delinquent girls. Their leader, Endo, tries to extort money from Shino, but she bravely refuses.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E04 - GGO (Gun Gale Online)
2.plot: Kikuoka has recruited Kirito to investigate GGO, and so he logs in. To lure Death Gun into targeting him, he hopes to enter Bullet of Bullets (BoB), a tournament to decide the most powerful gunman in GGO. But as a first-timer, he doesn't know his way around this game, and soon loses his way, when he catches sight of Sinon and approaches her.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E05 - Guns and Swords
2.plot: To register for BoB, Kirito starts entering the required information into a terminal, but is astounded to see that the form includes columns for his real-world name and address. He is temporarily torn when he realizes that without this info, he won't be eligible for the top prizes...

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E06 - Showdown in the Wilderness
2.plot: A man in a beat-up cloak watches Kirito fight his first battle and demands to know if he's "the real thing".  The man has the tattoo of Laughing Coffin, a murderer's guild that existed within SAO.  He tells Kirito that he'll kill him someday, and vanishes.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E07 - Crimson Memories
2.plot: The man in the ragged cloak is an SAO survivor, and he might also be a player Kirito fought with to the death... This thought consumes Kirito, and his anguish is palpable - to the point that it worries Suguha.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E08 - Bullet of Bullets
2.plot: Kirito decides that Death Gun and the man in the cape will be appearing in BoB.  He uses the remaining time to exchange information with Sinon and find out more about the contestants.  Sinon sees how strange he was acting during the qualifier and asks him what happened.  She learns that he is a SAO survivor.  The main BoB tournament begins and 30 players are dropped in a 10km wide field.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E09 - Death Gun
2.plot: The man in the cape shoots Pale Rider and he is eliminated despite the fact that he has HP remaining.  The man says that he is Death Gun, and declares that he will bring true death.  Asuna and her friends are watching a live stream of BoB and realize that Death Gun is one of the leaders of Laughing Coffin.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E10 - Death Chaser
2.plot: Sinon is attacked from behind by Death Gun and paralyzed. He's using a Black Star Type-54, ironically the same gun that Sinon used to shoot the robber. Her memories of the incident come flooding back and Sinon loses control, and Death Gun tries to kill her to make Kirito angry. But just before he can kill her Kirito saves her at the last second. Sinon is out of the fight, and Kirito tries to flee with her but is pursued by Death Gun.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E11 - What It Means To Be Strong
2.plot: After escaping from Death Gun, Kirito and Sinon lay low in a desert cave. There, Kirito speculates on how Death Gun murdered other players. In doing so, he hits upon a certain terrifying possibility.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E12 - Bullet of a Phantom
2.plot: BoB nears its end, and the only surviving players are Kirito, Sinon, and Dark Wind, the second place winner of the last tournament.  Since Death Gun may have multiple partners, and Dark Wind may be in danger as well, Kirito decides to defeat him first.  He acts as a decoy while Sinon snipes the enemy.  Kirito's trust in her pays off as her bullet strikes true, and he finally faces off with Death Gun.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E13 - Phantom Bullet
2.plot: Death Gun's attack is modeled after Star Splash, a SAO skill that doesn't exist in GGO.  Death Gun is skilled with not only a gun but a blade as well, and he gradually wears down Kirito's health.  Meanwhile, Sinon's scope has been destroyed by Death Gun and she cannot attack, so she's forced to simply watch the fight.  She grits her teeth and wonders if there's anything else she can do.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E14 - One Little Step
2.plot: Kyouji attacks Shino, saying he'll kill himself after she's dead. Kazuto saves her at the last second by jumping Kyouji.  During the fight, Kazuto is hit with Kyouji's poison syringe, but miraculously it doesn't work and Kirito is saved.  The next day Kazuto and Shino go to meet Kikuoka, and discuss the incident.  Kikuoka has a message from one of the captured Death Guns...

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E15 - The Queen of the Lake
2.plot: It's reported that the Holy Sword Excalibur has been discovered inside ALO. Hearing the news, Kirito and Leafa decide to take possession of Excalibur before other players get to it first.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E16 - The King of the Giants
2.plot: Kirito and the others are tasked with subjugating the Frost King Thrymr, and a quest to recover Excalibur. It's Yui's guess that this isn't a quest planned by the game admins, but something automatically generated by the system. And if that's the case…

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E17 - Excalibur
2.plot: Kirito and the others are taking on Thrymr, the Boss lurking at the bottom level of the dungeon. But unable to make much of a dent in Thrymr's HP, they soon find themselves in grave danger. Just then, their new ally, Freyja, raises her voice…

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E18 - Forest House
2.plot: In an upcoming update of ALO, Floors 21-30 of New Aincrad will be unlocked. Asuna, Kirito and Yui revisit their dream of once again living together in their log cabin on Floor 22.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E19 - Zekken
2.plot: Hearing rumors about a brilliant player known as Zekken, Asuna decides to mount a challenge. But when Asuna logs out, she is told by her mother to take an exam to transfer into an academically oriented high school.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E20 - The Sleeping Knights
2.plot: Asuna is asked to help the guild “Sleeping Knights,” which has decided to disband soon due to the members’ circumstances. Before they do, they want to defeat a Floor Boss with only their party.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E21 - The Monument of Swordsmen
2.plot: Asuna and the Sleeping Knights’ attempt to defeat the boss on Floor 27 has been observed by a guild specializing in boss raids. Now 20 of its members block the boss room.  With Kirito stalling the rest of the guild, can Asuna and the others break through?

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E22 - The End of the Journey
2.plot: A few days have passed since Yuuki suddenly disappeared from in front of Asuna, and she still hasn’t logged in to ALO. Later, Asuna meets Kazuto on the school roof, where he hands her a note and tells her Yuuki might be at the location written on it.

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E23 - The Dream Begins
2.plot: As a tester for the world’s first medical-use Full-Dive device, Yuuki has been diving into virtual worlds from the hospital. Unable to leave her hospital room, she longs to go to school again. To make that wish come true, Asuna asks Kazuto for help…

2.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S02E24 - Mother's Rosario
2.plot: Getting to experience the outside world, Yuuki’s days are more satisfactory than ever before. In ALO, the players have a barbecue and end up on a quest. In the real world, Asuna and the girls take a trip to Kyoto. One day, Asuna receives an email…

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E01 - Underworld
3.plot: Kirito, along with his childhood friend, Eugeo, has been tasked with cutting down a colossal tree called the Gigas Cedar. They’re swinging their ax when their friend Alice arrives with lunch. As they eat, the three friends decide to go to a fabled cave.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E02 - The Demon Tree
3.plot: Kirito wakes up to find himself inside a mysterious world evoking a fantasy game. His memory fuzzy, he tries to log out, but is unable to return to the real world. After wandering aimlessly, he finds himself underneath a colossal tree.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E03 - The End Mountains
3.plot: Kirito makes up his mind to journey to Centoria. Since he'll need Eugeo's help, he also decides to fell the Gigas Cedar. Meanwhile, Alice's little sister, Selka is worried about Eugeo, and opens up to Kirito about her concerns.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E04 - Departure
3.plot: Kirito and Eugeo realize Selka has taken off to the End Mountains alone, and decide to chase after her. As they enter the cave, they encounter goblins, presumably from the Dark Territory, and must engage in a battle.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E05 - Ocean Turtle
3.plot: In the real world, Kazuto Kirigaya lies unconscious. At Kikuoka’s request, Kazuto is moved to a well-equipped hospital, but when Asuna and Suguha try to visit, they’re turned away. Suspicious, Asuna and the others split up to find out more about Rath.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E06 - Project Alicization
3.plot: Asuna infiltrates Rath, the research lab in the Ocean Turtle, where she relentlessly grills Kikuoka about Kazuto's whereabouts. Kikuoka reveals that behind the development of the Soul Translator is a mind-blowing objective of epic scale.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E07 - Swordcraft Academy
3.plot: Two years have gone by since Kirito and Eugeo left Rulid Village. In the capital city, Centoria, both boys have attained their goal of being admitted to the North Centoria Imperial Swordcraft Academy.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E08 - Swordsman's Pride
3.plot: Kirito finds himself in a duel against the Elite Disciple Volo Levantein, using real swords. As the curious crowd looks on, Kirito is encouraged by Sortiliena, and the duel begins.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E09 - Nobleman's Responsibilities
3.plot: Now an Elite Disciple along with Kirito, Eugeo struggles with the question of what he should infuse in his sword so he can become stronger. When he's taunted by First-Seat Elite Disciple Raios and Second-Seat Humbert, Eugeo decides to accept Humbert's request for a duel.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E10 - Taboo Index
3.plot: Ronie and Tiese are late getting to the dorm. Kirito rushes out in search of them, but no sooner has he gone than Frenica appears. She tells Eugeo about how she's suffered at Humbert's hands, and that Tiese and Ronie went to confront him about it.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E11 - Central Cathedral
3.plot: Kirito and Eugeo are now considered criminals for having violated the Taboo Index and are thrown into the underground prison in the Central Cathedral. Meanwhile, on the Ocean Turtle in the real world, Asuna is watching over Kazuto as he's being treated.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E12 - The Sage of the Library
3.plot: Kirito and Eugeo escape from their cell, only to find their way blocked by Eldrie Synthesis Thirty-One, under orders from Alice to lie in wait for them. Kirito and Eugeo struggle against him until Eugeo realizes that he's seen Eldrie somewhere before.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E13 - Ruler and Mediator
3.plot: Kirito and Eugeo have been rescued by the young girl, Cardinal, who has secluded herself inside the Central Cathedral’s Great Library. Cardinal explains to Kirito how the Axiom Church and the Taboo Index came to be, starting with Administrator’s past.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E14 - The Crimson Knight
3.plot: After being entrusted with the fate of the world by the Cardinal, Kirito and Eugeo head to the top floor of the Central Cathedral. On the way, they find their confiscated swords among a vast pile of weapons in an arsenal, only to be greeted with a hail of arrows by the Integrity Knight, Deusolbert Synthesis Seven.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E15 - The Relentless Knight
3.plot: Kirito and Eugeo are on their way up the stairs of the Central Cathedral when they encounter two girls named Linel and Fizel. As they stand, wondering what two children are doing there, they let their guard down and...

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E16 - The Osmanthus Knight
3.plot: Though riddled with wounds, Kirito manages to activate his Perfect Weapon Control art. Continuing on their way to the top floor of the Central Cathedral, Kirito and Eugeo find themselves standing before a strange-looking floating platform.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E17 - Truce
3.plot: When Kirito and Alice both unleash the Perfect Weapon Control art in the Cloudtop Garden, the impact rips a hole into the seemingly impregnable Central Cathedral wall, which sends them both flying outside.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E18 - The Legendary Hero
3.plot: Eugeo reaches the ninetieth floor of the Central Cathedral, which turns out to be a vast bathing area. The perplexed Eugeo encounters Bercouli Synthesis One soaking in the bath. Meanwhile, Kirito and Alice are still climbing the Central Cathedral wall.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E19 - The Seal of the Right Eye
3.plot: Seeing Alice’s reaction when he mentioned the name Selka, Kirito decides to tell her the truth about the Integrity Knights. Meanwhile, after being knocked unconscious during his battle with Bercouli, Eugeo awakes on the top floor of the cathedral.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E20 - Synthesis
3.plot: Kirito and Alice reach the communal bath on the nintieth floor. There, they find the Integrity Knight Commander, Bercouli, who's been turned to stone by Chudelkin. Alice breaks down in tears upon seeing her mentor's tragic plight, but then...

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E21 - The 32nd Knight
3.plot: Standing in Kirito and Alice's way is Eugeo, who's undergone the Synthesis Ritual and become an Integrity Knight. Kirito is rattled, until Alice admonishes him into resolving to fight Eugeo with everything he's got.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E22 - Titan of the Sword
3.plot: On the top floor of the Central Cathedral, Kirito, Eugeo, and Alice finally face Administrator. But Chudelkin uses the sacred arts to transform himself into a giant clown and attacks.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E23 - Administrator
3.plot: Cardinal appears on the top floor of Central Cathedral for a showdown with her bitter foe of the last two hundred years. She moves to achieve her objective of deleting Administrator, only to see the fallen sword golem rise up again.

3.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S03E24 - My Hero
3.plot: Carrying the hopes of Cardinal, Eugeo, and Alice in his heart, Kirito stands yet again and visualizes the Black Swordsman, the top player who cleared SAO. For the sake of everyone he’s encountered in this world, Kirito, faces off with Administrator.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E01 - In the Far North
4.plot: Six months have passed since the fierce battle against Administrator. Alice has brought Kirito to her childhood home, Rulid Village, where they live peacefully. Gazing out at the world that she saved with Kirito, Alice reflects on all that’s happened.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E02 - Raids
4.plot: A force from the Dark Territory is attacking Rulid Village. Though she’d lost her purpose in battle, in order to fight for her family, and for the people that Kirito and Eugeo tried to protect, Alice takes up the Osmanthus Blade once again!

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E03 - The Final Load Test
4.plot: The mysterious group that attacked the Ocean Turtle turns out to be a secret unit under orders from the U.S. National Security Agency. And its leader, Gabriel, has battled Kirito and Sinon before.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E04 - Dark Territory
4.plot: Shasta, commander of the Dark Territory's dark knights, had intended to use Administrator's death as a chance for peace with the Human Empire. But his plans are thwarted by Emperor Vecta's return to the land of darkness.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E05 - The Night Before Battle
4.plot: Resolved to fight for humankind, Alice joins the forces of the Human Empire, bringing Kirito with her. But while the forces of darkness boast overwhelming numbers, only thirteen Integrity Knights are available to fight for the Human Empire.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E06 - Battle of the Knights
4.plot: The Final Load Test has begun, and the Eastern Gate has collapsed. Incited by Gabriel, now Emperor Vecta, the massive army of the land of darkness pushes on towards the Human Empire.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E07 - Stigma of the Disqualified
4.plot: Integrity Knight Renly Synthesis Twenty-Seven, in battle for the first time, flees his position, allowing goblins from the forces of darkness to infiltrate to the tent where Kirito is.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E08 - Blood and Life
4.plot: The powerful formal art unleashed by the Integrity Knight Alice inflicts severe casualties on the forces of darkness. Alice encounters an enemy survivor and learns that Emperor Vecta's objective is to find the "Priestess of Light."

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E09 - Sword and Fist
4.plot: Upon seeing Alice, Gabriel orders his entire army to capture her. The pugilists guild races ahead of the main force. As Alice and Bercouli try to come up with a strategy to counter them, the silent Integrity Knight Sheyta Synthesis Twelve steps forward.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E10 - Stacia, the Goddess of Creation
4.plot: Asuna has logged into the Underworld using the superuser account of Stacia, the Goddess of Creation. After she descends, she is reunited with Kirito, thanks to Ronie and Tiese. But soon Alice arrives, leading to a precarious situation!

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E11 - Heartless Choice
4.plot: Asuna has created a bottomless chasm. The dark knights and the pugilists attempt to cross over to the other side, where the Human Empire Army waits. Meanwhile, Critter releases an announcement about a limited-time beta test for a bizarre new VRMMO.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E12 - Ray of Light
4.plot: Due to Gabriel's scheme, U.S. players were given black knight accounts, and are now continuously logging in to the Underworld. They begin mercilessly slaughtering soldiers from both the Human Empire Army and the Dark Territory Army.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E13 - The War of Underworld
4.plot: Sinon has logged in with the super-account of Solus, the Sun Goddess and rescues Asuna and the others at the last minute. Meanwhile, Leafa logs in with the super-account of Terraria, the Earth Goddess, and descends to the Underworld.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E14 - End to Eternity
4.plot: Despite its modest size, the Human Empire Army and Asuna valiantly battle the wave of American players surging towards them. But they’re hopelessly outnumbered, and the Human Empire soldiers start to fall one after another.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E15 - Instigation
4.plot: Bercouli pursues Vecta, who’s abducted Alice. After a long, vicious battle, Bercouli unleashes his secret sword skill, Uragiri, and finally defeats Vecta, despite having sustained severe injuries himself.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E16 - Code 871
4.plot: The traitor inside Rath turns out to be a researcher named Yanai. When Higa attempts to restore Kirito, Yanai tries to thwart the operation by holding him at gunpoint. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Sinon confronts Gabriel, who has logged back in.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E17 - Prince of Hell
4.plot: Asuna and the others succumb to Vassago and the Chinese/Korean players. Discovering the catatonic Kirito, Vassago kicks his wheelchair over. Enraged, Klein lunges at Vassago, only to be pinned down by enemy players. Just then, someone unexpected appears.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E18 - Memories
4.plot: Sinon manages to severely damage Gabriel, but her strength has been sapped. Leafa collapses after wiping out the American players. And Asuna, her situation now hopeless, gazes at Kirito. But the Black Swordsman continues to wander through his dreams.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E19 - Awakening
4.plot: Escaping his nightmares, Kirito regains consciousness at last. With the Night-Sky Blade in his right hand and the broken Blue Rose Sword in his left, he faces off against Vassago, armed with the Mate-Chopper, now enormous in size.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E20 - The Night-Sky Blade
4.plot: Alice and Asuna head to the World’s End Altar as Kirito confronts Gabriel. Unless he can defeat Gabriel and return to the real world before the maximum-acceleration phase begins, Kirito will have to spend the next 200 years in the Underworld.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E21 - Beyond Time
4.plot: The maximum-acceleration phase has begun. Alice successfully logs out of the Underworld, but Kirito doesn’t make it in time. In the real world, Higa and Kikuoka rush to shut down the STL, in order to disable the maximum-acceleration phase, but…

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E22 - Alice
4.plot: The “Rath Attack Incident,” masterminded by the American National Security Agency, is over. Now head of the newly formed Oceanic Resource Exploration & Research Institution, Rinko unveils Alice to the world as an authentic artificial general intelligence.

4.title: FR - Sword Art Online - S04E23 - New World
4.plot: Rinko informs Kazuto that Alice is missing. He’s about to rush to the Rath Roppongi branch when the doorbell rings. In a panic, Kazuto throws open the door, only to find a deliveryman there with a huge cardboard box.

meta.plot: In the near future, a Virtual Reality Massive Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (VRMMORPG) called Sword Art Online has been released where players control their avatars with their bodies using a piece of technology called Nerve Gear. One day, players discover they cannot log out, as the game creator is holding them captive unless they reach the 100th floor of the game's tower and defeat the final boss. However, if they die in the game, they die in real life. Their struggle for survival starts now...

1.title: FR - Nos océans - S01E01 - Pacific Ocean
1.plot: In the world's largest ocean, one mighty current brings the Pacific to life in astonishing ways, from enriching rainforests to sustaining coral reefs.

1.title: FR - Nos océans - S01E02 - Indian Ocean
1.plot: From the minute mantis shrimp to the mighty sperm whale, inhabitants of the tropical Indian Ocean use their ingenuity to find food and raise their young.

1.title: FR - Nos océans - S01E03 - Atlantic Ocean
1.plot: In the choppy, unpredictable Atlantic Ocean, fish and mammals must face down predators and navigate the fast-changing climate in order to survive.

1.title: FR - Nos océans - S01E04 - Arctic Ocean
1.plot: With temperatures mounting and sea ice melting, the creatures of the Arctic Ocean must go to new extremes to survive in a new, warmer world.

1.title: FR - Nos océans - S01E05 - Southern Ocean
1.plot: In the most remote ocean on Earth, the Global Ocean Current is at its most powerful — and its cold waters are home to some extraordinary species.

meta.plot: Découvrez les histoires qui se cachent sous la surface des cinq océans de notre planète, dans cette série documentaire époustouflante.

meta.plot: Sofia a quinze ans. Après une violente dispute avec ses parents, elle fait le mur pour la première fois. Le lendemain, au réveil plus aucune trace d’eux, ni de son petit frère… Plus de vingt ans après leur disparition dont l’attentat des Twin Towers a étouffé le fait divers, Sofia est toujours hantée par des questions sans réponse. Sa famille a-t-elle été assassinée ? Pourquoi a-t-elle, elle seule, été épargnée ? S’ils sont en vie, pourquoi l’ont-ils abandonnée ?  Sofia n’arrive pas à laisser ce drame derrière elle, malgré un mariage et une fille. Elle n’a jamais quitté la région et attend désespérément un signe, un retour. Ce signe arrive enfin… mais pas celui qu’elle attendait… Et si le passé revenait pour achever ce qu’il avait commencé 20 ans auparavant…

1.title: FR - Kerviel : Un trader, 50 milliards - S01E01 - Just One Man
1.plot: On January 24, 2008, French bank Société Générale announces a sudden loss of €4.9 billion, leading to an investigation of trader Jérôme Kerviel.

1.title: FR - Kerviel : Un trader, 50 milliards - S01E02 - Delta One
1.plot: When the bank discovers €50 billion in hidden trades, a specialist is brought in to sell the positions and divert a market crash.

1.title: FR - Kerviel : Un trader, 50 milliards - S01E03 - The Idol
1.plot: As charges loom, Kerviel speaks out against the system he claims encouraged his risky trades, using the media frenzy to rally public opinion.

1.title: FR - Kerviel : Un trader, 50 milliards - S01E04 - And Yet, It Governs Us
1.plot: In the years following his trial, Kerviel's case reveals deep flaws in the global financial system as further testimonies come to light.

meta.plot: Le 24 janvier 2008, la Société Générale, l'une des plus grandes banques françaises, provoquait un séisme en annonçant une perte de 4,9 milliards d'euros, liée à une fraude commise par l'un de ses traders, alors inconnu.  Du choc initial à la saga médiatico-judiciaire qui a suivi, cette série documentaire retrace , en 4 épisodes , les événements clés de cette affaire devenue un symbole des dérives de la finance:  Le choc de l’annonce, les trois jours où la banque a cherché à limiter ses pertes dans la plus grande discrétion, et examine la personnalité complexe de Jérôme Kerviel, un homme traqué par les médias, placé aux cœurs d'un combat judiciaire avec de forts enjeux politiques.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Bill and Jo juggle a typical day that starts with a parent-teacher conference and ends with a trip to the ER. After defending their parenting style, or lack thereof, to teachers, doctors and social workers, they find comfort in the fact that their kids are healthy and happy and that they’re all in this together.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Biter
1.plot: At Chuy’s insistence, Bill and Jo finally enroll Lulu in preschool only to discover she is a biter. While they navigate incident reports and overprotective parents, Sandy explores their family history with an ancestry DNA kit.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Date Night
1.plot: Bill and Jo reluctantly ask Sandy to babysit after Chuy and Brie convince them to join their weekly date night. And while Bill and Jo discover they’re a bit rusty at romance, Sandy discovers she’s a bit rusty at parenting.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Participation Trophy
1.plot: In an attempt to get Emily interested in something other than her tablet, Bill and Jo enroll her in her uncle Chuy's soccer clinic. Sandy's infamous gift-giving habit gets out of hand.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - My Favorite Marta
1.plot: Jo steps in as a role model for her teenage niece Marta, much to her strict father Chuy's dismay; while under the influence of post-colonoscopy drugs, Sandy inadvertently professes her love for her first husband, Dave.

1.title: FR - United We Fall [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - You're Doing It Wrong
1.plot: Bill and Jo take their niece Marta in after she clashes with her father, while Bill regrets playing matchmaker when he gets wind of Dave’s plans to propose to Sandy.

meta.plot: Le quotidien compliqué de Jo et Bill, un couple qui élève ses deux jeunes enfants avec l'aide de leurs deux familles respectives, très voire trop impliquées dans leur éducation. Mais ensemble et avec beaucoup d'amour, tout semble possible...

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: In the wake of tragedy, LBPD training officer Traci Harmon takes on new trainee, Alex Diaz who on day one is already learning the job is harder than he imagined.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E02 - Laws of the Universe
1.plot: A chaotic street takeover finds our officers grossly outnumbered, revealing philosophical rifts inside West Division.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E03 - South of Heaven
1.plot: Diaz learns that Harmon has enemies within West Division, and begins to fear she cannot be trusted.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E04 - Unsung
1.plot: Desperate for a lead, Harmon goes off book resulting in a major breakthrough and a deadly showdown.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E05 - Not Your Savior
1.plot: Back on patrol, the rift between Harmon and Diaz comes to a head.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E06 - L.A. Woman
1.plot: When Diaz's family is threatened, Harmon realizes she must break her own rules to fix it.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E07 - War Machine
1.plot: A shot caller's revenge mission results in West Division going head to head with an entire gang.

1.title: FR - En Service - S01E08 - How the West Was Won
1.plot: Harmon and Diaz join forces with an elite squad to intercept a major drug shipment.

meta.plot: À travers la formatrice Traci Harmon et la jeune recrue Alex Diaz, cette série met en lumière l'impact de ce métier sur la condition humaine. Harmon est inspirée par un jeune des rues, alors que Diaz apprend qu'être flic ne se résume pas à tout voir en noir ou blanc et qu'il faut composer avec des nuances de gris.

1.title: FR - La Guerre selon Churchill - S01E01 - The Gathering Storm
1.plot: Driven by a childhood conviction to save Britain, Winston Churchill forges a path from soldier to prime minister amid the looming threat of German forces.

1.title: FR - La Guerre selon Churchill - S01E02 - His Finest Hour
1.plot: Serving as PM and Minister of Defense, Churchill rallies the nation with speeches, aiming to attract US support as Hitler launches the Blitz on London.

1.title: FR - La Guerre selon Churchill - S01E03 - The Day of Destiny
1.plot: Churchill's unyielding efforts secure US entry into the war. But to defeat Nazi Germany, he must ally with Stalin and Roosevelt to form a Second Front.

1.title: FR - La Guerre selon Churchill - S01E04 - Out of the Storm
1.plot: As the war ends, Churchill navigates a shifting global landscape dominated by US-Soviet tensions, decolonization and the emerging nuclear era.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire captivante explore le rôle crucial de Winston Churchill lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale et les évènements qui ont fait de lui un dirigeant emblématique.
