meta.plot: Quand des corps commencent à apparaître, avec comme signature commune un os de corbeau enfoncé dans la gorge, deux enquêtrices coriaces, Gabrielle et Clémence, doivent faire équipe pour élucider ces crimes qui choquent la province... et le monde entier. Les circonstances les forceront à se révéler l'une à l'autre, à souder un lien impérissable et à se questionner sur ce qui est de l'ordre du réel ou non.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E01 - The Beginning and the End
1.plot: When his sister dies in a scuba accident, Yehia is sent to prison for her murder. 15 years later, he emerges with one objective — revenge.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E02 - Doubt
1.plot: A shocking incident at a factory leaves everyone scrambling for answers. Layla begins to question the past, and claims to know who killed Nadia.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E03 - To Remember, or Not to Remember
1.plot: Layla makes an unlikely partner in her own hunt for the truth, but learns of a disturbing fight. At a lavish party, Yehia is caught in a chase.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E04 - Videotapes
1.plot: Yehia seeks tapes from the day of Nadia's murder. But to get to them, he'll need to get past a hired killer. Layla confronts her father about the past.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E05 - Back to the Past
1.plot: Yehia returns to the only place he believes they will find answers — the scene of the crime. Mona uncovers a startling revelation from her own past.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E06 - PTSD
1.plot: When Mona returns to Cairo, her presence throws everything into question. Yehia confronts a new source about Nadia's death.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E07 - The Price
1.plot: Layla questions Yehia about his intentions. Yassin approaches his wife with a startling ultimatum.

1.title: FR - Echoes of the Past - S01E08 - Truth and the Rebirth
1.plot: With Yehia closing in on his targets, Layla interrogates her family to finally learn why the past continues to haunt their present.

meta.plot: Accusé du meurtre de sa sœur, Yehia est farouchement déterminé à obtenir vengeance et démasquer le vrai coupable.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Hannah arrives in Korea, and gets more than she bargained for when she’s assigned to tutor one of OME’s top trainees, Chan-Mi.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E02 - K-Flop
1.plot: When Ken suggests that Hannah tries living a day-in-the-life of a trainee, she quickly struggles to find her footing.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E03 - K-Crushed
1.plot: Hannah faces challenges in her first official K-pop class when she’s paired up with Chan-Mi to write a song.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E04 - Bad Rep
1.plot: Insecure about her inability to rap, Hannah does anything she can to show she can keep up with the other trainees.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E05 - Trainee Wreck
1.plot: When a secret is revealed, Hannah must prove to her peers that she has the talent and drive to be an OME trainee.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E06 - Boys, Clothes, Money
1.plot: Unimpressed with the lyrics for Astra’s debut song, Hannah decides to write something more meaningful.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E07 - Family K-Drama
1.plot: An unexpected visitor arrives in Korea and challenges everything Hannah thought she knew about her family.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E08 - Interview
1.plot: Hannah helps a distracted Chan-Mi prepare for an important interview with a potential Showcase sponsor.

1.title: FR - Gangnam Project, l'aventure K-pop - S01E09 - Dress Rehearsal
1.plot: Tensions rise between Hannah, Sun Hee, and Mina as they struggle to rehearse for Showcase without a leader.

meta.plot: Hannah Shin, une fan de K-pop métisse dont la mère est canadienne et le père coréen, obtient la chance de toute une vie : devenir tutrice d’anglais dans une des plus importantes sociétés de production de divertissements coréenne, One Mile Entertainment (OME). OME est à l’origine du lancement des carrières des meilleurs Idols de la K-pop et Hannah devra travailler avec leur star montante, Chan-Mi.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E01 - The Bounty Hunter
1.plot: Birthday boy Sean and his sister, Lisa, plan to spend the weekend with their dad. But when he's called into work, they both decide to secretly tag along.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E02 - Bucky Quanto's
1.plot: Terry's latest mission brings him and the stowaways to the galaxy's best wing spot, where ruthless killers, an old partner and intergalactic chaos await.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E03 - Pit Stop
1.plot: At a convenience store, Sean makes a new pal and a frustrated Lisa confides in a stranger. But a sticky situation soon forces them into action.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E04 - Pulga
1.plot: A quest to find a ship part on a scrap planet takes a wild turn when the kids venture off on their own while another bounty hunter tracks Terry down.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E05 - Chillion-5 (1)
1.plot: Terry surprises the kids with a trip to the happiest place in the galaxy — until a heartbreaking sight upsets them and puts the family at odds.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E06 - Chillion-5 (2): Rise of the Chillas
1.plot: Lisa joins forces with a rebellious crew of aliens and quickly becomes an asset when the team sets out on a daring mission to take on a larger threat.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E07 - Planet Fall
1.plot: Emotions run high when a crisis jeopardizes the kids' safety and pushes Terry to ride through a dangerous storm with Glorlox hot on his heels.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E08 - Bizarre Ride
1.plot: A new alliance forms on the planet of Chillion for a risky rescue mission. Vax, Lisa and Sean use their skills and work together on an escape plan.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E09 - Showdown
1.plot: Glorlox brings his bounty to the Conglomerate with unexpected consequences. Aboard the ship, the kids hatch a scheme that leads to an epic battle.

1.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S01E10 - The Bounty Hunters
1.plot: Terry and the kids race through space to make it home before Mom does. Back on Earth, Lisa and Sean learn the truth, and an unwanted visitor appears.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E01 - Abduction
2.plot: When Terry goes missing, Tess leaves Lisa and Sean at home with grandma to rescue him alone... unless the kids can find their own way into space.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E02 - Jailbreak
2.plot: Tess and the team head to the nearest bounty containment facility to break Terry out. The first step? Using a decoy to gain access to the building.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E03 - Ocanom Grind
2.plot: The group heads to a planet that doubles as an elite gambling destination to get intel on the Widowmaker. But there's a strict "no kids allowed" rule.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E04 - This is Doloraam
2.plot: The Hendrix kids make an interesting discovery about their family history. Meanwhile, Terry stands trial in a distant kingdom. Can he clear his name?

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E05 - Old Friends
2.plot: Tess brings the crew to Veeger-79 to ask an old friend for help but gets hit with some hard truths instead. Terry learns more about Tess' past.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E06 - Wolves & Sheep
2.plot: Adja and Tess make plans to infiltrate a dangerous space station to track down the bot that took Sean and Lisa — but they'll need Blobby's help.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E07 - For the Throne
2.plot: After the EHC returns precious cargo to the Doloraami Empire, a marvelous family reunion is interrupted by a fight — to the death.

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E08 - Tales of Doloraam (1)
2.plot: As the kingdom prepares for battle, a difficult decision faces the Hendrix family: return to their home on Earth or fight alongside the Doloraami?

2.title: FR - Papa est un chasseur d'aliens - S02E09 - Tales of Doloraam (2)
2.plot: To win the battle, the Hendrixes must find and destroy the person who's secretly controlling the Beta Bots — with a little help from an unexpected ally.

meta.plot: Un chasseur de primes intergalactique assume son devoir de père envers et contre tout quand ses deux enfants embarquent par mégarde avec lui et perturbent sa mission.

1.title: FR - Gagné ou Perdu - S01E01 - Coach's Kid
1.plot: Laurie's insecurity about the upcoming championship manifests into a sentient blob called Sweaty.

1.title: FR - Gagné ou Perdu - S01E02 - Blue
1.plot: Umpire Frank, a pro on the field, lives his life from the sidelines, unable to let down his guard.

meta.plot: À l'approche d'un match important, huit personnages voient leur vie hors du terrain bouleversée.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E01 - A Stitch in Time
1.plot: Inspector Kiera Cameron loses everything she has and finds herself on a new mission when she and eight dangerous terrorists are transported from their time in 2077 back to 2012 during the terrorist’s attempt to escape execution. She takes on a new identity and joins the Vancouver Police Department in order to stop the terrorists’ reign of violence. Along the way, she befriends Alec Sadler, the 17 year old who will one day grow up to create the technology her world is built upon.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E02 - Fast Times
1.plot: Kiera tries to find the members of Liber8 before they do more damage. Her attempts are hindered when her cover is blown and her partner on the VPD, Carlos Fonnegra, arrests her. But when she discovers Liber8’s plan to attempt to get back to 2077, she has to escape and possibly ally herself with her sworn enemies to get back home.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E03 - Wasting Time
1.plot: Kiera and Carlos investigate a series of mysterious murders in which victims have been drained of endocrine fluid only to discover that the crimes were committed by Liber8 in an effort to save Travis, their leader. Kellog tries to make a truce with Kiera by delivering her a gift, one that could cost her and Carlos their lives and will lead to Kellog’s expulsion from Liber8.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E04 - A Matter of Time
1.plot: A scientist who is working on developing a source of clean energy is found murdered. The list of suspects leads Kiera on a journey that takes her to a precarious place – deciding between the right thing to do and the preservation of the future.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E05 - A Test of Time
1.plot: Kagame's return begins with a reset of Liber8’s agenda, away from violence and towards blending into the community. But there may be a glitch – there is the possibility that if their ancestors living in this time are murdered, they might cease to exist. A test of this theory is devised with Kiera and her grandmother as the guinea pigs.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E06 - Time's Up
1.plot: Kagame pursues the first step of his new agenda – winning over the intellectuals and the grassroots dissenters. When Liber8 kidnaps the CEO of a major corporation, Kiera and Carlos must race an actual ticking clock to save the CEO from public punishment.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E07 - The Politics of Time
1.plot: The high-stakes Union Election gives Kiera her first taste of contemporary political intrigue. But issues of trust and loyalty come up for Kiera as evidence points to Carlos in the death of an investigative reporter. Kiera will learn firsthand the lengths a person will go to get elected.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E08 - Playtime
1.plot: When Kiera and Carlos investigate two mysterious murder-suicides, they quickly realize that both may be the result of a lethal computer program turning video game programmers into killers.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E09 - Family Time
1.plot: While accompanying Carlos on a routine investigation of a farmer who purchased large quantities of ammonium nitrate, a fertilizer used in explosives and agriculture, Kiera discovers that the farm is actually the home of Alec. What seemed like a routine check quickly escalates into a tense standoff.

1.title: FR - Continuum - S01E10 - Endtimes
1.plot: Kiera must race against the clock when she realizes that in her timeline, today is the day that terrorists bomb a building killing hundreds of innocent people. As she tries to stop the imminent bombing, Liber8 kidnaps her trusty sidekick Alec after he realizes his stepbrother Julian is under their sway.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E01 - Second Chances
2.plot: Kiera resurfaces after the mayor is killed in a brazen assassination. She reunites with Carlos to solve the murder and also tries to reconnect with Alec, who has changed since reading the message from his future self.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E02 - Split Second
2.plot: Kiera and Carlos's reunion is a bumpy one as they attempt to thwart Liber8's brazen hijacking of a prison transfer. Meanwhile, Kellog approaches Alec with an enticing partnership proposition. The young genius is tempted, but will it lead him down a dark path?

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E03 - Second Thoughts
2.plot: Alec is injured in a car accident while joyriding with his friends who are intoxicated on a dangerous new drug sweeping the streets. Kiera recognizes this new poison as a drug from her future and deduces that Liber8 is responsible for putting it on the streets. Julian’s mother visits him in prison, awakening his desire to take the fight in a new direction.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E04 - Second Skin
2.plot: It appears another time traveler has arrived in 2013 when the CMR network "pings" a brief connection with another CPS suit. Kiera's pursuit of the traveler leads her to her old partner, Elena - but also draws unwanted Liber8 attention, and dangerous scrutiny from Gardiner of Kiera's every move.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E05 - Second Opinion
2.plot: Sam's Birthday puts Kiera on the path to an emotional meltdown which triggers an internal diagnostic within Kiera's CMR that forces her to deal with her loss or lose her tech abilities. Meanwhile, Kiera becomes the target of a department mole hunt, when Dillon is ousted and Escher installs Nora Masters as his puppet.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E06 - Second Truths
2.plot: Kiera must use her knowledge of the future to stop a serial killer while keeping a curious Carlos in the dark about the truth behind her uncanny insights.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E07 - Second Degree
2.plot: Kiera and Carlos discover that a Juror on Julian's trial has been compromised and must race to protect his family from a Liber8 plot. Alec is torn between telling the truth at his brother's trial or protecting his mother. Emily reveals she is more than just a pretty face.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E08 - Second Listen
2.plot: Kiera investigates the mysterious disappearance of several deceased time travelers’ bodies while Alec is taken hostage by Garza on orders from his future self.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E09 - Seconds
2.plot: Alec’s mother is shot by a bullet meant for Julian while Dillon’s new Liber8 task force is put to the test when Kiera must decide how far she will go to stop Julian's murderous future.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E10 - Second Wave
2.plot: After a surprise attack by the shadowy group posing as Section Six, Kiera is captured by Julian’s followers. Alec reactivates Travis' military chip in order to hunt him, but the hunter soon becomes the hunted.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E11 - Second Guessed
2.plot: Chaos breaks out in Vancouver when a series of cyber attacks turn the city upside down. Kiera and Carlos race to find the perpetrator while clues suggest Alec's own technology has something to do with it.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E12 - Second Last
2.plot: Kiera and Carlos must stop Travis after he gets his hands on a second CPS suit while Alec and Emily try to escape the mysterious Freelancers and deal with a revelation about his past that could change everything.

2.title: FR - Continuum - S02E13 - Second Time
2.plot: Kiera races to rescue Alec from himself and preserve her own chance of getting home. Alec must make a difficult decision between solving Kiera's dilemma or his own.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E01 - Minute By Minute
3.plot: Kiera risks everything to stop Alec from altering history in his quest to save Emily, but can the mysterious group Kiera aligned herself with be trusted?

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E02 - Minute Man
3.plot: While Kiera investigates the two Alecs in one timeline, the mayor is kidnapped by a reunited Liber8. Carlos struggles with the reality shattering truth of Kiera’s predicament.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E03 - Minute to Win It
3.plot: Kiera has to solve a series of Liber8 connected bank heists and discovers the robbers are controlled by a recently escaped Lucas. Carlos’ new and unwanted knowledge about time travel begins to affect his work.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E04 - A Minute Changes Everything
3.plot: As Kiera works to free a college student caught in a police cover-up, her perspective on police behaviour is thrown into question. Carlos discovers Liber8's influence reaches right inside of VPD. Alec secures an unlikely ally.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E05 - 30 Minutes to Air
3.plot: Kiera and Carlos work to free hostages including Dillon, taken prisoner by Liber8 at a television station. Meanwhile, Kellog and Alec's business alliance falls apart, turning the two men from partners to adversaries.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E06 - Wasted Minute
3.plot: Kiera and an emotionally unravelling Carlos must stop Liber8 from committing a devastating chemical attack on the city.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E07 - Waning Minutes
3.plot: Kiera crash lands her CPS flyer during a prisoner transport and is forced to work with her enemy captive in order to survive. In present day, the mystery of Kiera's murder is solved when Alec finds a way to recover the recording of her final moments from her CMR.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E08 - So Do Our Minutes Hasten
3.plot: Kiera confronts uncomfortable truths while paired on an investigation with Dillon. Julian puts himself in the spotlight by exposing a corporation's dirty deeds. Alec deals with the pressures of his new role at Piron and an uncomfortable secret revealed by Carlos.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E09 - Minute of Silence
3.plot: Kiera and Carlos, reeling from a shocking loss, hunt down a ring of enigmatic high-tech thieves, even as a handsome, yet distant amnesiac begs for help in discovering his identity.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E11 - 3 Minutes to Midnight
3.plot: Kiera finally learns the truth about John Doe. Alec must make a difficult choice between business and family. Liber8 is rocked to the core by new information about their mission.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E12 - The Dying Minutes
3.plot: Something's hidden deep in the Freelancer facility. Kiera and John Doe work to retrieve it, but the price of knowledge may be betrayal. Carlos resolves to wrest control of the VPD from Piron and Dillon. Help arrives courtesy of an unlikely – and deadly – ally.

3.title: FR - Continuum - S03E13 - Last Minute
3.plot: Kiera and Liber8 join forces to stop a power-hungry Alec; Kiera and John Doe realize their relationship is doomed; Scar Alec sacrifices his hard-won desire for a simpler life.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E01 - Lost Hours
4.plot: Kiera, injured during her and Brad's escape from the future soldiers, has a renewed desire to return to her son in the future. Brad reunites with the future soldiers in a bid to gain their trust and work from the inside. Alec gets revenge on Kellog by hacking into Piron which causes unexpected consequences and revelations.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E02 - Rush Hour
4.plot: Kellog uses Alec's weakness against him. Kiera tries to negotiate. Alec sets out on his own to try to save Emily.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E03 - Power Hour
4.plot: Alec joins Carlos and the VPD. Kiera and Garza form an alliance.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E04 - Zero Hour
4.plot: Kiera and Brad's trust reaches a breaking point. Carlos and Kellog come to their own realizations; Alec has a strange encounter.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E05 - The Desperate Hours
4.plot: Kiera pressures Carlos for more time. Kellog faces unexpected danger. The future soldiers plan a raid.

4.title: FR - Continuum - S04E06 - Final Hour
4.plot: Kiera and Alec risk everything to stop the future soldiers.

meta.plot: Alors qu'elle est à la poursuite de condamnés à mort en cavale, Kiera Cameron, une jeune flic du futur, se retrouve coincée dans le Vancouver d'aujourd'hui. Loin des siens restés en 2077, elle s'engage auprès des forces de police de la ville pour arrêter des terroristes à notre époque.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E01 - Nuts About You
1.plot: Scrat meets his son Baby Scrat and experiences the pure joy of being a new parent—until Baby Scrat sees The Acorn for the first time.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E02 - LoFi Scrat Beats to Sleep/Chill to
1.plot: Scrat pounds out a percussive lullaby to get a crying Baby Scrat to fall asleep.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E03 - X's and Uh-O's
1.plot: Scrat demonstrates for Baby Scrat how to plant The Acorn, but Scrat is really the one being taught a lesson.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E04 - Nutty Reflections
1.plot: Scrat and Baby Scrat run after The Acorn into a dark cave, which resembles a creepy funhouse hall of mirrors.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E05 - Teeter Toddler
1.plot: Thanks to a dodo bird, Scrat and Baby Scrat end up on opposite sides of a log held up by a single branch.

1.title: FR - L’Âge de glace - Les aventures de Scrat - S01E06 - Nut the End
1.plot: The Acorn goes flying off a cliff. With it seemingly gone forever, can Scrat and Baby Scrat live in harmony?

meta.plot: Devenu père, notre héros malchanceux s’occupe tant bien que mal de son fils, l’adorable Baby Scrat, qui est aussi un petit coquin. Leur vénération commune pour le précieux Gland n’arrange rien à l’affaire !

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E01 - Dino Park
1.plot: A dino park visit turns into a pulse-pounding, prehistoric nightmare starring Mater and Lightning.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E02 - Lights Out
1.plot: The rain-soaked duo check into a creepy hotel where Lightning is haunted by four-wheeled frights.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E03 - Salt Fever
1.plot: When Mater is outfitted as a racer, he experiences record speeds and an out-of-chassis experience.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E04 - The Legend
1.plot: Mater and Lightning join local creature hunters in their search for a mysterious, elusive “monster.”

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E05 - Show Time
1.plot: A traveling circus exposes Lightning’s fear of clowns and his new friend Ivy’s unexpected talents.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E06 - Trucks
1.plot: Mater bonds with fellow trucks at a rest stop, and they celebrate their solidarity through song.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E07 - B-Movie
1.plot: Lightning McQueen and Mater stumble onto a movie set and are cast in a zombie sci-fi film.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E08 - Road Rumblers
1.plot: Road warriors carnap Lightning and Mater, forcing them to battle in the perilous Thundercone.

1.title: FR - Cars : Sur la route - S01E09 - Gettin' Hitched
1.plot: At his sister’s wedding, Mater must confront a past he thought he’d left in the rearview mirror.

meta.plot: Flash McQueen et son meilleur ami Martin quittent Radiator Springs pour un voyage à travers le pays pour aller retrouver la sœur de Martin. En chemin, chaque arrêt est une aventure à part entière. Au programme : des attractions touristiques délirantes en bord de route et de nouveaux personnages hauts en couleur.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E01 - Carn-Evil
1.plot: Cuphead convinces Mugman they should ditch their chores and head to the carnival, unaware it's a front to collect souls.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E02 - Baby Bottle
1.plot: The brothers take care of a baby left at their front door. But with Elder Kettle gone and a strict warning to be good, it's harder than they imagined.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E03 - Ribby & Croaks
1.plot: A squabbling Mugman and Cuphead sneak into a club to grab some ice cream after the boxing champs who own it steal their money.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E04 - Handle with Care
1.plot: After Mugman's handle breaks off, the brothers visit a greedy shopkeeper and get creative while on the hunt for glue.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E05 - Roll the Dice
1.plot: All bets are off when Cuphead takes over Inkwell Isle's No. 1 game show, much to the annoyance of its devious host King Dice and his devilish boss.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E06 - Ghosts Ain't Real
1.plot: A spooky bunch of ghosts treat Cuphead and Mugman to a night of chills and thrills after trapping them inside a creepy graveyard.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E07 - Root Packed
1.plot: Cuphead and Mugman have to defend Elder Kettle's precious vegetable garden after a rotten gang turns their yard into a party.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E08 - Sweater Off Dead
1.plot: Mugman knits a special sweater to keep Cuphead's soul safe. Meanwhile, in the underworld, the Devil is throwing a party.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E09 - Sweater Luck Next Time
1.plot: The Devil follows the brothers day after day, waiting for Cuphead to take off his sweater so he can collect his soul before Stickler finds out.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E10 - Dangerous Mugman
1.plot: Cuphead and a cowardly Mugman test their courage after Porkrind sends them on a dangerous errand that quickly gets out of hand.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E11 - Dirt Nap
1.plot: Elder Kettle overhears strange conversations between Cuphead and Mugman, then worries that the boys have menacing plans for him.

1.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S01E12 - In Charm's Way
1.plot: Trouble follows the brothers when Cuphead and Mugman get in over their heads upon meeting a free-spirited, street-smart new friend.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E01 - Jail-Broken
2.plot: Cuphead and Mugman are in the slammer after breaking into the cookie factory. Prison's scary — but now they can't decide whether to bust out or stay in!

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E02 - Charmed and Dangerous
2.plot: Trouble comes a-knockin' when Ms. Chalice turns up on Elder Kettle's doorstep and turns on the charm. The question is: Can she be trusted?

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E03 - A High Seas Adventure!
2.plot: The boys think they're just "playing" pirate until they actually drift out to sea and get roped into a mission to reunite a captain and his sweetheart.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E04 - Another Brother
2.plot: After an argument with Mugman, Cuphead goes looking for another brother. But his reckless new sibling isn't all he's cracked up to be.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E05 - Sweet Temptation
2.plot: Cuphead's self-control is put to the test when he discovers a sugary dreamland where he can eat all the sweets he wants... with a catch.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E06 - The I Scream Man
2.plot: All Mugman wants is a little peace and quiet while Cuphead and Elder Kettle are away. Enter the ice cream man — and his jaunty truck's maddening jingle.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E07 - Piano Lesson
2.plot: Mugman gets dangerously jealous when his snooty piano teacher taps Cuphead to compete for a $10,000 musical prize instead of him.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E08 - Release the Demons!
2.plot: Steaming mad and ready for revenge, the Devil summons his finest demons and sends them above ground on a mission to recapture Cuphead's soul.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E09 - Dead Broke
2.plot: Ms. Chalice and the boys craft a perfect spooky scam: making money as ghost removers! But things get real when they pick a house that's already haunted.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E10 - Rats All Folks!
2.plot: A crafty rat claims ownership of Elder Kettle's cottage and all of its contents after a careless Cuphead and Mugman leave the door open.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E11 - Say Cheese!
2.plot: Elder Kettle wants to snap a family portrait of him and his boys — and, boy, does he get it! Just not in the picture-perfect setting he was expecting.

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E12 - Lost in the Woods
2.plot: Winter's coming and there's lots of work to do, but Cuphead doesn't want to do any of it. Forget chopping wood — he'd rather launch rockets into the sky!

2.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S02E13 - The Devil's Pitchfork
2.plot: Cuphead and Mugman are giddy with power when they get their hands on the Devil's pitchfork and make fiery mischief all over town.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E01 - The Devil's Revenge!
3.plot: Without Mugman, Cuphead doesn't know what to do with himself. Can he strike a deal with the Devil to save his beloved brother and bring him home?

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E02 - Don't Answer the Door
3.plot: Knock, knock! Danger's at the door when Elder Kettle goes out to get his mustache waxed, leaving a bumbling Cuphead and Mugman home alone.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E03 - Cupstaged
3.plot: Sally Stageplay's holding auditions for an exciting new space opera. But Cuphead, Mugman and the Devil all want the same role: the lead.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E04 - Roadkill
3.plot: After hitting the Devil with his car, Elder Kettle takes him in, mistaking him for a humble house cat he affectionately calls "Mrs. Meow Meow."

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E05 - Holiday Tree-dition
3.plot: With Christmas fast approaching, Elder Kettle sends the boys on an important errand: to pick out the perfect tree.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E06 - A Very Devil Christmas
3.plot: Christmas brings out the worst in the Devil, who's notoriously naughty... until he schemes to get himself onto Santa's nice list.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E07 - Special Delivery
3.plot: After breaking Porkrind's window, Cuphead, Mugman and Ms. Chalice must work off the debt by delivering a mysterious package to Ribby and Croaks.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E08 - Down and Out
3.plot: King Dice — the Devil's onetime No. 1 — is out of the spotlight. But Cuphead of all people wants to be his manager and help him make a comeback.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E09 - JoyRide
3.plot: It's time for a day of fun with Elder Kettle... or is it? With an assist from Ms. Chalice, Cuphead and Mugman are scaring up shenanigans all over town!

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E10 - Dance with Danger
3.plot: A fateful flashback reveals what Ms. Chalice's life was like before she met Cuphead and Mugman.

3.title: FR - Le Cuphead show ! - S03E11 - The Devil and Ms. Chalice
3.plot: An epic dance contest morphs into a high-stakes game of winners and losers, with more than one soul on the line. How will it all end? Hilariously.

meta.plot: Partagez les mésaventures de l'impulsif Cuphead et de Mugman, son frère facilement influençable, dans cette série animée inspirée du jeu vidéo à succès.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E01 - Save the Porcupine! / Save the Runaway Egg!
1.plot: A porcupine gets stuck in a tight spot, and a mama chicken's precious egg rolls away.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E02 - Save the Mountain Lion! / Save the Baby Chick!
1.plot: A mountain lion aims a little too high for his size, and a hungry chick struggles to be seen and heard.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E03 - Save the Woodpecker! / Save the Salmon!
1.plot: A woodpecker can't shake free from a tree, and a young salmon needs some uplifting words to make it upstream.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E04 - Save the Hedgehog! / Save the Hippo!
1.plot: A hedgehog becomes a "wedged-hog," and a hippo's cooldown turns into a muddy mess.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E05 - Help the Peacock! / Save the Woolly Mammoth!
1.plot: A peacock questions his dancing abilities, and a woolly mammoth gets trapped on a chunk of ice.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E06 - Save Tate? / Save the Song Birds!
1.plot: A search for a souvenir lands Tate inside a sidewalk grate, and two song birds need to find their rhythm.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E07 - Help the Bear Cub! / Save the Sad Sumi-e Frog!
1.plot: A bear cub would rather play all day than go to bed, and a painted frog could use some cheering up.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E08 - Save the Roly Poly! / Save Jack (and the Giant, Too)!
1.plot: A lonely pill bug looks for a pal, and Jack goes on the run from a much (much) bigger kid.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E09 - Save the Elephant! / Help the Little Hawk!
1.plot: A thirsty elephant who's blind needs to find the watering hole, and a young hawk tries tackling an impressive move.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E10 - Save the Screaming Goat! / Help the Wild Culpeo!
1.plot: A dwarf goat has a serious case of the yelps, and an energetic fox is eager to play with a delicate butterfly.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E11 - Save the Chinchilla! / Help the Golden Spider?
1.plot: A chinchilla needs rescuing from a tricky spot, and a spider wants to spin a web that'll wow.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E12 - Help the Caribbean Crab! / Save the Bighorn Sheep!
1.plot: A crab's colorful castle risks getting washed away, and two sibling sheep fight over who goes first.

1.title: FR - Les Wonder Choux dans la grande ville - S01E13 - Help the Red Squirrel! / Help the Dung Beetle!
1.plot: A squirrel loses track of a buried treat, and a beetle battles a blowfly over a ball of dung.

meta.plot: Rejoingez Izzy le cochon d'Inde, Zuri le lapin et Tate le serpent pour vivre des aventures héroïques. Un trio d'animaux de compagnie digne de chanteurs d'opéra vivant à New York et répondant aux appels d'animaux dans le besoin venant du monde entier.

1.title: FR - Malédiction ! - S01E01 - The Restricted Wing
1.plot: When Alex doesn't return from a family game of hide-and-seek, secrets are revealed about the Vanderhouvens' past, present, and future.

1.title: FR - Malédiction ! - S01E02 - The Golden Baboon Head
1.plot: Pandora, Russ, and Sky befriend two unlikely allies—Stanley and Larry—while racing against time to capture a creature on the loose in the manor.

1.title: FR - Malédiction ! - S01E03 - The Baboon Temple
1.plot: The Vanderhouvens leave home to search for answers about a cursed artifact from the Congo. But upon arrival, they face unexpected mayhem.

1.title: FR - Malédiction ! - S01E04 - The Olmec Babies
1.plot: When three fertility statues come to life, it's up to Russ, Pandora, and Sky to reunite them with their “mother” on display at the Paxton Museum.

1.title: FR - Malédiction ! - S01E05 - The Scryer Bowl
1.plot: The Vanderhouvens discover a possible way to contact Alex. But chaos ensues—and Stanley gets caught in the center of it.

meta.plot: Les Vandehouven sont une famille comme les autres... jusqu'au jour où Alex, le père, est maudit et changé en statue. Afin de le sauver, sa femme et ses enfants n'ont d'autre choix que de s'embarquer dans des aventures frissonnantes pour restituer des artefacts volés par l'un de leurs ancêtres.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E01 - En residence
1.plot: When their dormitory is damaged by fire, university students are forced to move into the building across the street: a senior center...

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E02 - Les intolerances
1.plot: Isabelle, a nutrition student, must take into consideration the residents' multiple dietary restrictions in order to concoct a menu that will please both young and old. Lumina, Anne-Sophie's roommate, dies suddenly.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E03 - L'inspection
1.plot: Big stress at Belâgio: an inspector visits the residence! Dugas and the residents help each other to avoid a possible closure. Meanwhile, Camille introduces Doris to dating apps in order to calm her overflowing libido.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E04 - Journee portes ouvertes
1.plot: Lumina's sisters come to visit her. Anne-Sophie does everything she can to hide the fact that Lumina is dead. Conversely, Isidore never has any visitors. JF makes it his mission to help him reconnect with his son.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E05 - Locataire recherche
1.plot: After Lumina dies, it's time to figure out who will take her place. Zeke, who is a hypochondriac, believes he has caught a deadly virus. Camille takes advantage of her condition to feed her social networks.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E06 - Catfish
1.plot: To become "cool", Isabelle agrees to wear the costume of the university's sports mascot. Marcel is the victim of an Internet scammer. Dugas asks Camille to do some prevention work with the residents on the dangers of phishing.

1.title: FR - En Résidence - S01E07 - Football
1.plot: Marcel, who trains every morning in the room, offers JF, who has to go to football trials to try out for the team, to become his coach. Doris asks Camille for help, because she thinks she has an STI. Camille asks Anne-Sophie for help. They organize a screening clinic at the residence. All residents must submit to it. Zeke looks for his pills while Isidore starts painting.

meta.plot: Lorsque leur dortoir est endommagé par un incendie, des étudiants universitaires se voient obligés d'aller vivre dans l'édifice d'en face : un centre pour personnes âgées..

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E01 - A Master of Circumstance
1.plot: Stripped of aristocratic privilege, Count Alexander Rostov is sentenced to life imprisonment at the Metropol Hotel. Contending with allies and foes alike, it’s nine-year-old Nina and her unexpected friendship that changes his life.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E02 - An Invitation
1.plot: The Count reckons with his past when old friend Mishka turns up at the hotel; he meets Anna Urbanova for the first time, embarking on a passionate affair; his friendship with Nina deepens, but their time together may be cut short.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E03 - The Last Rostov
1.plot: As his old life crumbles, the Count receives some devastating news; blinded by hurt, he embroils his friends in a dangerous plan; his disregard for the state may have consequences; Nina makes a surprise return, as Anna's career takes a turn.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E04 - Good Times
1.plot: The Count must undertake a dangerous political mission to save a friend.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E05 - An Arrival
1.plot: The Count's life at the hotel is turned upside down by a startling arrival.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E06 - The Fall
1.plot: When someone close to him suffers a terrible accident, the Count resolves to save them at any cost, making a decision that endangers his life; as the hotel rallies to protect him, the crisis forces Anna to confront her true feelings about the Count.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E07 - An Assembly
1.plot: Russia stands on the brink of change in 1953, as someone close to the Count is granted a major opportunity. But when the return of an old friend makes the Count see clearly, he's confronted with a difficult choice about the future.

1.title: FR - Un gentleman à Moscou - S01E08 - Adieu
1.plot: The Count and Anna devise an elaborate plan, with huge consequences should it fail. However, things quickly start to unravel. An inevitable showdown is set between the Count and an old enemy.

meta.plot: Au lendemain de la révolution russe, le comte Alexandre Rostov découvre que son statut de privilégié le place du mauvais côté de l'histoire. Même s’il échappe à une exécution immédiate, un tribunal soviétique le condamne à vivre retranché dans une chambre dans les combles du luxueux hôtel Metropol et le menace de mort si jamais il en sortait. Tandis que les années passent et que le pays traverse les décennies parmi les plus tumultueuses de son histoire, les conditions de vie restreintes de Rostov l’ouvrent sur un vaste monde de découverte émotionnelle. Alors qu'il se construit une nouvelle vie entre les murs de l'hôtel, il découvre la véritable valeur de l'amitié, de la famille et de l'amour.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed & breakfast – only to find it’s inhabited by the many opinionated spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E02 - Hello!
1.plot: When Sam thinks she’s crazy because she continues to see the ghosts of Woodstone Manor, she tries to ignore them, making them even more determined to get her to acknowledge they’re real.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E03 - Viking Funeral
1.plot: When Thorfinn’s bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he’s always wanted. However, Sam and Jay are torn when they learn that the bones could be sold to a museum for a lot of much-needed cash. Also, the ghosts conduct an election for a “ghost representative” to bring issues to Sam.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E04 - Dinner Party
1.plot: When Sam and Jay invite the nosy neighbors Henry and Margaret to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E05 - Halloween
1.plot: On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who annually vandalize the house.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E06 - Pete's Wife
1.plot: Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she’s been keeping a dark secret from him for many years. Also, Sassapis gets angry with Thorfinn for binge-cheating their favorite show without him, and Trevor learns he may have a daughter.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E07 - Flower's Article
1.plot: When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she’s embarrassed about a part of the story she’s never revealed.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E08 - D&D
1.plot: After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts. Also, Isaac confronts his feelings for Nigel, a British soldier ghost from whom he’s been keeping a gigantic secret.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E09 - Alberta's Fan
1.plot: Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go on a walk with him in hopes that it will spark a special memory.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E10 - Possession
1.plot: Hetty accidentally possesses Jay’s body just as he and Sam are to about show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E11 - Sam's Mom
1.plot: Sam and Jay travel to where Sam’s mother, Sheryl, died to see if she’s now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret to his fellow ghosts that he overheard Sam and Jay discussing.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E12 - Jay's Sister
1.plot: When Jay’s sister, Bela, comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they’re shocked to discover that she’s communicating with someone they know on a dating app.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E13 - The Vault
1.plot: Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend’s wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty’s husband, Elias Woodstone, tries to ruin it.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E14 - Ghostwriter
1.plot: When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over the creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a new living friend, and Flower attempts to be Pete’s new basketball buddy.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E15 - Thorapy
1.plot: When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him. Also, Isaac makes a big, personal revelation after he’s compelled to seduce his new roommate, Hetty.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E16 - Trevor's Pants
1.plot: The secret about Trevor’s missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone’s corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E17 - Attic Girl
1.plot: An ‘80s “mean girl” ghost named Stephanie, who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

1.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S01E18 - Farnsby & B
1.plot: As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official B&B guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn. Also, Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E01 - Spies
2.plot: Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to integrate Nigel into his friend group.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E02 - Alberta's Podcast
2.plot: Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta’s death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E03 - Jay's Friends
2.plot: Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay’s new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah. Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E04 - The Tree
2.plot: Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try and save an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower’s attention.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E05 - Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
2.plot: A séance at Sam and Jay’s last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty’s past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E06 - The Baby Bjorn
2.plot: Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys’ house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E07 - Dumb Deaths
2.plot: When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E08 - The Liquor License
2.plot: Alberta’s expertise from her past comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into some complications during their Woodstone whiskey tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac’s past.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E09 - The Christmas Spirit (1)
2.plot: Jay’s sister, Bela, visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves. Meanwhile, the ghosts have conjured up a very different holiday plan for Trevor and Bela. Also, Isaac has an awkward encounter with Nigel that forces him to look back on events in his life.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E10 - The Christmas Spirit (2)
2.plot: Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay’s sister, Bela, and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Also, Isaac’s marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E11 - The Perfect Assistant
2.plot: Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B – however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E12 - The Family Business
2.plot: Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, ignoring Hetty’s warning not to get too close to “the help.” Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica, the ghost who lives in Freddie’s car.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E13 - Ghost Hunter
2.plot: Sam and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica when Freddie sells his car.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E14 - Trevor's Body
2.plot: Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel’s relationship hits a roadblock.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E15 - A Date to Remember
2.plot: Sam and Jay help Thorfinn create a perfect first date with Flower. Also, Hetty feels slighted by the ghosts’ new housemate, Nigel.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E16 - Isaac's Book
2.plot: Sam struggles to keep Isaac’s spirits up after she hits a wall trying to publish a biography about him. Also, Trevor and Hetty conspire to keep their relationship hidden and Thor tries to prove to Flower that he can control his anger.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E17 - Weekend from Hell
2.plot: Elias Woodstone returns to Woodstone seeking Hetty’s forgiveness so he can stay out of hell for good. Also, Jay struggles to repeat an inspired culinary creation that he came up with after walking through Flower.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E18 - Alberta's Descendant
2.plot: Alberta is thrilled when a living relative, Alicia, visits Woodstone to learn more about her, but things take a turn when she hits it off with Todd, Sam's podcast co-host. Also, Nigel uses his knowledge of Trevor and Hetty's secret tryst to try to blackmail Hetty.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E19 - Ghost Father of the Bride
2.plot: After learning that Pete’s daughter, Laura, is getting married, Sam, at Pete’s behest, tries to convince her to hold her wedding at Woodstone B&B. Also, Alberta and Isaac team up to solve the mystery of what happened to Crash’s head.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E20 - Woodstone's Hottest Couple
2.plot: When teen ghost Stephanie, who lives in the attic, awakens to find that her crush Trevor is now dating Hetty, she decides to sabotage all the relationships at Woodstone.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E21 - Whodunnit
2.plot: Sam, Jay and the ghosts go into detective mode when Sam’s podcast editor gives her one last episode to wrap up Alberta’s murder. Also, Trevor, Flower and Pete discover an email from a Nigerian prince asking for help.

2.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S02E22 - The Heir
2.plot: When a woman shows up claiming to be the rightful heir to Woodstone Mansion, Sam and Jay enlist the help of a lawyer. Meanwhile, Isaac tries to decide how to spend half of Sam’s advance on his autobiography. Also, a surprise event takes place that could dramatically change life at the manor.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E01 - The Owl
3.plot: Sam, Jay and the remaining ghosts unravel the mystery of which ghost passed into the afterlife. Also, Sam and Jay must relocate an owl in order to do construction on the barn to turn it into Jay's restaurant.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E02 - Man of Your Dreams
3.plot: Sam learns that one of the ghosts' powers is to enter the dreams of the livings and influence their decisions. Also, two of the ghosts think they've learned the secret to moving on.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E03 - He Sees Dead People
3.plot: When Jay's sister, Bela, and her boyfriend, Eric, visit Woodstone Mansion, Eric reveals a major change that took place after his near-death experience there over Christmas.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E04 - Halloween 3: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
3.plot: Pete's ex-wife, Carol, shows up at Woodstone Mansion during Sam and Jay's Halloween party, where they're trying to impress some cool friends. Also, the ghosts hope to bring Flower back with a séance.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E05 - The Silent Partner
3.plot: A big investor backs out of Sam and Jay's restaurant, leaving them to turn to the one ghost who has money - Isaac.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E06 - Hello, Brother
3.plot: Trevor's brother, Jeremy, checks into Woodstone after discovering a loophole in the Woodstone Rewards Points program.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E07 - The Polterguest
3.plot: Alberta hits it off with a poltergeist who is attached to a newly arrived Woodstone guest. Also, Isaac and Nigel have separate bachelor parties.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E08 - Holes Are Bad
3.plot: When Sam and Jay leave the ghosts home alone for the weekend in an attempt to have a romantic getaway, shocking revelations are made about two of Woodstone's beloved spirits.

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E09 - The Traveling Agent
3.plot: Pete discovers a power that he never knew he had – one that brings him closer to his buddy Jay (and further apart).

3.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S03E10 - Isaac's Wedding
3.plot: Isaac's wedding day jitters are exacerbated by the arrival of a surprise guest.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E01 - Patience
4.plot: While Sam and the ghosts race to find him, Isaac comes face to face with Puritan ghost Patience for the first time since she was lost in the dirt.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E02 - Sam's Dad
4.plot: When Sam's dad comes to Woodstone for a visit, Patience puts their father-daughter relationship to the test. Also, Isaac must deal with the fallout from his breakup with Nigel, and Thor and Flower handle an awkward situation with Nancy.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E03 - Halloween 4: The Witch
4.plot: The Ghosts seeking some excitement during a low key Halloween join Patience in putting Sam on a witch trial.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E04 - The Work Retreat
4.plot: Trevor, who has catfished his way into a remote financial analyst job, is in hot water when he's summoned to a mandatory in-person work retreat. Also, Hetty and Sass start a rumor about Pete.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E05 - A Star Is Dead
4.plot: Alberta offers to help Sam prepare for an audition for a community theater production. Also, Sass finds a new reason to interfere in Jay's dreams.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E06 - The Primary Source
4.plot: When Sam's book publisher requires source material for her biography on Isaac, she and Jay take a field trip to find a diary he claims he hid when he was alive.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E07 - Sad Farnsby
4.plot: When Sam accidentally creates a rift between Sam and Jay's neighbors, the Farnsbys, Henry Farnsby moves into Woodstone B&B. Also, Isaac and Nigel battle over a belated wedding present.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E08 - A Very Arondekar Christmas (1)
4.plot: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E09 - A Very Arondekar Christmas (2)
4.plot: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E10 - The Not-So-Silent Partner
4.plot: Sam and Jay are forced to cover when Mark demands to meet the silent investor in Jay's restaurant who has been holding up construction.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E11 - Thorapy 2: Abandonment Issues
4.plot: Thor returns to therapy to work through his angst over being abandoned by his Viking shipmates. Also, Jay's sister, Bela, attempts to help him with the restaurant.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E12 - It's the End of the World as We Know It and What Were We Talking About?
4.plot: Flower interferes with the opening of Jay's restaurant based on a prophecy from her old cult leader.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E13 - Ghostfellas
4.plot: Jay angers a local restaurateur when he uses a recipe at his restaurant that was given to him by Pete.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E14 - Alexander Hamilton and the Ruffle Kerfuffle
4.plot: When Jay becomes obsessed with the success of a fellow chef, Isaac serves up a cautionary tale about his own rivalry with Alexander Hamilton; Elias Woodstone returns from hell with a limited-time offer for the ghosts.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E15 - The Bachelorette Party
4.plot: When Alberta's descendant hosts a bachelorette party at Woodstone Mansion, Alberta becomes suspicious of her fiancé; Jay is excited about a positive review on his restaurant.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E16 - St. Hetty's Day
4.plot: Hetty's ghost power is revealed when Jay's cousin Sunil visits Woodstone Mansion on St. Patrick's Day.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E17 - His Girl Shiki
4.plot: Pete makes good on his promise to find someone for Sasappis by bringing in a wisecracking 1940s screenwriter who also has the ability to roam.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E18 - Smooching and Smushing
4.plot: Jay, Sam and the ghosts attempt to fix the ghost trap in hopes of getting Sasappis across the ghost boundary to visit his longtime crush, Shiki.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E19 - Pinkus Returns
4.plot: When Trevor's former co-worker Pinkus and his daughter Abby show up at Woodstone Mansion, Trevor gets the surprise of his afterlife.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E20 - I Know What You Did Thirty-Seven Summers Ago
4.plot: When Sam and Jay host a fundraiser for the mayor to earn a favor for Jay's restaurant, they learn of his bizarre connection to one of Woodstone's ghosts.

4.title: FR - Ghosts : Fantômes à la maison - S04E21 - Kyle
4.plot: Sam and Jay's relationship is tested when Kyle, a handsome living who shares Sam's ability to see ghosts, arrives at Woodstone B&B.

meta.plot: Samantha et Jay rejettent la prudence lorsqu'ils transforment leur propriété de campagne récemment héritée en chambres d'hôtes. Appelez ça des plans égarés. Non seulement l'endroit s'effondre, mais il est également habité par les esprits d'anciens résidents - que seule Samantha peut voir et entendre.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E01 - Peace in the Valley
1.plot: The Eden Vale Police Chief coaxes his estranged son home to partner with his detective big sister.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E02 - The King's Assassin
1.plot: While the rest of the force is focused on Big Hank's annual charity fundraiser, Lou and Henry investigate the suspicious death of a visiting crypto bro who ate a poisonous mushroom.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E03 - Mr. Popular
1.plot: When the Eden Vale High star quarterback is attacked, disturbing secrets are uncovered that reveal just what extremes people will go to in order to win.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E04 - Found Footage
1.plot: When Lily goes into the woods with her friends to make a low-budget horror movie, their leading lady of questionable talent goes missing.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E05 - Family Trees
1.plot: When Lou and Henry go under cover for a case involving a high-stakes I.P. theft, Lou is forced to confront a painful truth about her past.

1.title: FR - Good Cop/Bad Cop - S01E06 - Explosions
1.plot: An explosive family secret sends shockwaves through the Hickmans, but they must put their tensions aside when Eden Vale becomes the target of a sabotage attack.

meta.plot: Un drôle de duo de détectives, frère et sœur, au sein d'une petite police du nord-ouest du Pacifique, doit faire face à des habitants hauts en couleur, à un sérieux manque de ressources et à une dynamique très compliquée entre eux, et avec le chef de la police, Big Hank, qui s'avère être leur père.

Yrehn, une jeune Osamodas, est la gardienne de l'Élante, une créature légendaire et dernière de son espèce. Mais tout bascule lorsque Karn, un Iop qui manie aussi bien l’arbalète que le hachoir, s'empare de l'animal.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E01 - Solitude
1.plot: June 1940. In London De Gaulle negotiates with Churchill to unify the two countries. But, an ultimate betrayal for the general, France asks for an armistice and Pétain takes power. 18 June, he broadcasts a radio appeal to continue the combat. 3 July, the Royal Navy attacks the French fleet.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E02 - Tous les combats du monde
1.plot: September 1940. In Dakar, Pétain's French fleet machine-guns the Free French Forces. Additional suffering for De Gaulle, beset by doubts. All the more so as he is increasingly opposed to Churchill and has to face the hostility of Roosevelt. Spring 1943, the general and his family move to Algiers

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E03 - Liberté, liberté chérie
1.plot: August 1944. Paris is liberated but the wounds are deep. On her return from deportation, Geneviève, the general's niece, recounts the Nazi horrors. A provisional government is established, led by De Gaulle. The time has come for reconstruction. January 1946. Refusing to play party politics, De Gaulle leaves power.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E04 - Premier des Français
1.plot: May 1958. The Algerian crisis risks dragging France into civil war. The President of the Republic René Coty appealed to de Gaulle. The constitution of the Fifth Republic was born, Charles de Gaulle entered the Elysee Palace in January 59. Putsch of the generals in 1961, multiple attempted attacks against de Gaulle… the question of Algeria remained burning. When the year 1965 opens, de Gaulle suggests that he might not stand for the presidential election in December. Yvonne, who has linked her fate to his, discreetly encourages a few relatives to dissuade the General from being a candidate. But how to abandon France?

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E05 - Le chagrin des hommes
1.plot: May 1968. With France in turmoil De Gaulle doesn't understand what is in play. Increasingly, those around Prime Minister Pompidou call for De Gaulle to go. With no sign of events calming down, a general strike and student rebellion are launched. De Gaulle secretly joins General Massu in Baden-Baden.

1.title: FR - De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret - S01E06 - Crépuscule
1.plot: Late 1968. Pompidou is no longer Prime Minister. De Gaulle launches a referendum, an ultimate battle he will lose. 25 April 1969. He records his televised speech and leaves the Élysée Palace, never to return. André Malraux visits him in the solitude of Colombey. The end of the road approaches.

meta.plot: Une série qui nous plonge dans l’intimité de Charles de Gaulle et nous fait revivre plusieurs épisodes de l’Histoire de France, de l’appel du 18 juin 1940 à son départ du pouvoir en 1969, ces grands moments que le général a incarnés et façonnés.

1.title: FR - Apocalypse : Hitler attaque à l'Ouest (1940) - S01E01 - The Trap
1.plot: Nine months after the onset of World War II, Hitler attacks the West - Belgium, the Netherlands, France and Great Britain - with intense violence.

1.title: FR - Apocalypse : Hitler attaque à l'Ouest (1940) - S01E02 - Last Battles
1.plot: France is in chaos. The French people take to the roads, trying to escape. The government signs an armistice as Germans take over half the country.

meta.plot: 1940. Neuf mois après le déclenchement de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, Hitler attaque à l’Ouest la Belgique, les Pays-Bas, la France et la Grande Bretagne, dans un déchaînement de violence. À Dunkerque, devenu un goulot d’étranglement, plus de 300 000 soldats fuient la France.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Gabriel and Riley must rescue the kidnapped member of CyberCom who invented the chip implanted in Gabriel's brain before the top-secret technology falls into the wrong hands. Meanwhile, Gabriel takes advantage of his chip to search for his wife who disappeared years ago.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E02 - Red X
1.plot: CyberCom investigates a terrorist suicide bombing at a U.S. Marine base and learns a new, chemically undetectable bomb material is being consumed. Meanwhile, Riley is forced to make a drastic decision when she finds Gabriel unable to complete a task

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E03 - Mei Chen Returns
1.plot: When Gabriel’s chip is hacked, he’s shocked to learn that Mei Chen is not only alive, but possesses an even more powerful chip than his own.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E04 - Secrets of the Secret Service
1.plot: Gabriel and Riley pose as Secret Service agents in Syria in order to rescue two American journalists being held hostage. While there, Riley must work with her former boyfriend, and the truth behind their past is revealed.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E05 - The Rescue
1.plot: Gabriel and Riley search for the kidnapped daughter of a senator in Mexico when a Mexican cartel demands he end the sale of U.S. spy satellite in exchange for her safety. Meanwhile, Lillian discovers a connection between the drug cartel and her father.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E06 - Patient Zero
1.plot: Gabriel and the Cybercom team head to Texas to help contain an outbreak of a deadly, rapidly spreading virus, but when Gabriel cyber-renders ground zero of the outbreak to isolate who Patient Zero might be, he and the team are shocked to see that the suspect is a criminal believed to have been executed a week earlier.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E07 - Size Matters
1.plot: When Gabriel and Cybercom learn microscopic robots are infecting and killing leading artificial intelligence scientists, they must find who's delivering boxes containing the malicious nanites before Cassidy is the next target.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E08 - Delta Force
1.plot: Gabriel and Riley are sent to Bolivia to protect Javier Leon, a presidential candidate whom they believe is the next target in a string of political assassinations in the country.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E09 - Athens
1.plot: When Gabriel’s memory is wiped clean after CyberCom is attacked by an aggressive virus, he believes Jin Cong is the good guy and helps him locate a top-secret document.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E10 - Cain and Gabriel
1.plot: Lillian, worried about her daughter's safety, accompanies Gabriel and Riley to San Francisco to investigate a plot to carry out a terrorist attack using blackmailed people in witness protection.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E11 - The Grey Hat
1.plot: As Riley and Gabriel track an infamous hacker, they learn the suspect may have been set up and a sinister group may be planning a nuclear attack.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E12 - The Event Horizon
1.plot: Gabriel and Riley must determine who is responsible for framing Gabriel when he is suspected of murder; Tetazoo leads a manhunt for Riley and Gabriel.

1.title: FR - Intelligence - S01E13 - Being Human
1.plot: Riley and Gabriel are shocked when the identities of sleeper agents embedded in the U.S. government are revealed.

meta.plot: A drama centered on a high-tech intelligence operative who is enhanced with a super-computer microchip in his brain, and the director of the elite government cyber-security agency who supports him.

1.title: FR - Standing up - S01E01 - Give Us a Laugh!
1.plot: While struggling comic Nezir weighs a tricky job offer, his friend Aïssa tries out racy new material, and club owner Bling has a wild night onstage.

1.title: FR - Standing up - S01E05 - A Streetcar Named Nezir
1.plot: A mishap brings Nezir and Bling closer. Aïssa grapples with unexpected news and an uncomfortable on-air moment. Apolline's deceptions begin to unravel.

1.title: FR - Standing up - S01E06 - Good Evening, Olympia...
1.plot: As Aïssa prepares for her biggest show yet, Nezir plots revenge on Tifflot, Apolline deals with a family crisis, and Bling starts to get his mojo back.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E01 - Too Hot to Handle
1.plot: Findley can't resist some freshly baked cookies that are too hot to eat so Lucas and his friends do whatever it takes to keep him from burning his mouth.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E02 - The Big Squeak
1.plot: Avocado's new toy is driving everyone crazy with its noisy squeaker. Lucas tells everyone that he's going to speak to her and realizes Avocado loves everything about her squeaky toy apart from the actual squeak itself! So, Dr. Lucas is in the house to operate and remove the squeak.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E03 - Big Jumping Spider
1.plot: When Findley comments to Lucas that his jump isn't very long or high Lucas ramps things up, jumping higher and longer in ever increasing death defying jumps.

1.plot: Lucas discovers that it's best to ask your friends permission before you give them a scare on Halloween. He adopts the guise of a ghost and the use of decorative masks and sneaky hiding places to give them all the jumps.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E09 - Don't Eat Me
1.plot: When Findley sees a documentary about spiders being the natural predator of the fly, he decides that maybe Lucas isn't the big friend he thought he was!

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E10 - Sliding

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E11 - Spinning Webs

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E12 - I'm Taking You In

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E13 - Something Up There

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E18 - Boingo
1.plot: Lucas, Findley and Bodhi become obsessed with a new toy called Boingo.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E19 - Findley's Bad Day

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E20 - You Rang

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E21 - Do You Speak Dance

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E22 - A New Spider in Town

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E23 - Dollhouse Mates
1.plot: Lucas and Findley move into the dollhouse together.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E24 - Lucas We Have a Problem
1.plot: Lucas helps Bodhi fulfill her dream of touching a star.

1.title: FR - Lucas the Spider - S01E25 - Egg-Scuse Me

Monk quickly concludes that the suicide note is a forgery: a highly respected English teacher wouldn't confuse ""its"" with ""it's.""  A few words with the teachers in the lounge lead him to suspect that the murderer is a science teacher, Derek Philby. Unfortunately for Monk, Philby was proctoring an SAT exam when Ms. Landow's body landed on Philby's car, setting off his car alarm and alerting the entire school to her death. Armed with a strong suspicion but no evidence, Monk becomes a substitute teacher in hopes of finding the information that will incriminate Philby, who arrogantly informs him that he's ""failing the class""--he has no evidence to support his hypothesis. 2.title: FR - Monk - S02E02 - Mr. Monk Goes to Mexico
2.plot: When a friend's college-age son dies mysteriously in Mexico, the mayor sends Monk to investigate. Doubting the coroner's report that the young man ""drowned"" in mid-air, Monk nevertheless has difficulty concentrating on the case. His eighteen suitcases carrying not only his clothes and ""back-up pillowcases"" but a year's supply of food and his favorite brand of bottled water are stolen, leaving him with nothing he considers safe to eat or drink. Even worse, someone is trying to kill him, first by running him down with a pick-up truck and then by planting an explosive device behind a picture that he compulsively straightens every time he enters his room. Neither the witnesses nor the police, a south-of-the-border caricature of Stottlemeyer and Disher, offer any helpful leads--except for the mention of another unsolved murder, this one a mauling by a ""wild lion,"" the previous year. Meanwhile, the Monk alienates Sharona by telling her that her fear of elephants is irrational and advising her to suck it up.

When Sharona's mother (who thinks that Sharona is Monk's partner, not his assistant) arrives for a visit and Sharona tells her the bad news, Monk and Sharona promise to ""do whatever it takes"" to discover what really happened. ""Whatever it takes"" turns out to be a bit more than Monk bargained for, however. After talking with the props manager, he begins to suspect that Jenna Ryan, Gail's understudy, somehow killed Duncan and framed Gail, even though she was at a party on the other side of town when Duncan died. In order to talk with and observe Jenna, he endures a painful half hour at a speed dating service and even agrees to take the dead man's part in the play for two days until a new actor arrives.
