meta.plot: Depuis son fief de la ville de Puteaux, "la Monaco des Hauts-de-Seine", Benoit Gênant est à la tête de BG immo, une petite agence immobilière. Multipliant les interventions maladroites sur les réseaux sociaux, Benoit est inébranlable dans sa positivité et sa réussite future. Mais les comptes sont dans le rouge. Il est donc décidé à réagir en suivant scrupuleusement une ligne de conduite très claire, que ce soit dans l'immobilier ou dans sa vie : "Faire n'importe quoi". Benoit n'est peut-être pas le plus grand agent immobilier des Hauts-de-Seine, mais c'est sûrement le plus gênant.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E01 - Goodbye Cruel World
1.plot: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E02 - Life in the Fast Lane
1.plot: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E03 - Long Way from Home
1.plot: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E04 - Don't Stop the Dance
1.plot: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E05 - Pretty Vacant
1.plot: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E06 - Heaven Is a Place on Earth
1.plot: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E07 - Almost Blue
1.plot: Coordinates from an AI lead to islands that Skinner bought just before they sunk under rising sea levels. The team visit them hoping to learn more.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E08 - Unforgettable Fire
1.plot: Chris is held captive on an arctic oil rig by Russian operatives. The team unites to save her, despite learning Chris was once a Russian spy herself.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E09 - Death on Two Legs
1.plot: An inquiry is held at the Pentagon to determine the future of Lazarus where information emerges that prompts Schneider of INSCOM to hire an assassin.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E10 - I Can't Tell You Why
1.plot: Skinner's medical history provides a lead but requires entry to a private clinic. Leland takes Axel and Doug to his home to secure them an invite.

1.title: FR - Lazarus - S01E11 - Runnin' with the Devil
1.plot: Doug and Eleina go to Islamabad seeking the elusive hacker but are pursued by INSCOM. Meanwhile, Axel gets into a chaotic fight with the assassin.

meta.plot: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapuna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E01 - You Don't Belong Here
1.plot: Davey and Jonesie stage a protest that ends in chaos and them fleeing from accountability.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E02 - Unjust Gems

1.plot: Tensions rise between the girls as Davey tries to hide a threatening secret from the past.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E06 - Orange Is the New Snack
1.plot: In an attempt to liberate a subjugated species, the girls lead Cheryl straight to them.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E07 - The Big Game
1.plot: In a universe that parallels Davey’s favorite teen drama, the girls play into the tropes.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E08 - Into the Schneiderverse
1.plot: Sick of the Schneiders’ bad attitude, the girls are happy to meet a much cooler version.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E09 - Bean and Nothingness
1.plot: Davey and Jonesie briefly enjoy the perks of being the only two people in a universe.

1.title: FR - Davey & Jonesie's Locker - S01E10 - There's No Place Like Homeostasis
1.plot: The girls enlist the help of their friends to save their universe from the mess they made.

meta.plot: Les meilleurs amis Davey et Jonesie échappent à leur vie fade au lycée grâce à leur casier, qui est en fait un portail vers d'autres univers.

meta.plot: Alea jacta est, le sort en est jeté ! Cette fameuse locution latine prononcée par Jules César avant de franchir le Rubicon est un parfait résumé de la vie mouvementée du plus célèbre des dirigeants romains. Car toute sa vie, César a joué à quitte ou double face à la mort. Cette série documentaire raconte à la première personne le destin stupéfiant de ce jeune patricien surmontant tous les défis.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Two Soaps and a Talc
1.plot: Kath is planning her anniversary celebrations, while Diane is worried she’s not got enough cheese for the soiree she’s organising for the ‘French exchange people’.  Meanwhile, Martin is under financial pressure and needs to make some big decisions - decisions that will end up impacting him and everyone close to him.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Miss Stockport
1.plot: Diane is worried that she didn’t impress the school governors, Kath is revealing more than she should, and Martin is desperately trying to get his hands on a chunk of cash.

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - No Words Are Spoken

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - White Goods
1.plot: Diane puts her trust in Kath and sends her on a covert mission while she reluctantly goes to dinner at Sandy Cooper’s house with Martin. But will Kath be discovered?

1.title: FR - The Power of Parker [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Dynamite
1.plot: It’s the big day for Kath and Diane as they attempt to finally exact their revenge on Martin. But whilst Diane has never felt more alive, is Kath having second thoughts?

meta.plot: It’s Stockport 1990 and Martin Parker, a man with the ambition of Alan Sugar and the looks of Robert Kilroy Silk is slowly waking up to the fact that things are changing. With a chain of electrical stores, a wife, kids and a flash car, he has the perfect life. But in reality he’s swimming in a sea of debt and lies, and it falls to the two women in his life, Kath and Diane to plot his downfall.

meta.plot: Au sein du Liars Club, 5 duos mythiques vont s’affronter dans un jeu dans lequel ils devront raconter des histoires folles qui leur sont arrivées… ou pas. Leur but : convaincre les autres qu’ils disent la vérité. Mais à chaque manche, seul l’un des binômes sera sincère, tandis que les autres navigueront en plein mensonge ! Les duos devront donc mettre leur talent de comédien à profit et faire preuve de mauvaise foi persuasion pour tenter de convaincre, mais aussi de malice pour retrouver qui dit vrai. Car à la fin, seul le duo qui aura trouvé la bonne combinaison d’histoires vraies remportera le jeu. Sauront-ils percer le mystère et dénicher les récits véritables parmi ce labyrinthe de fables ?

meta.plot: Une série de bombes sophistiquées sèment la terreur en ville. Un nouvel artificier est à l'œuvre : celui qu'on surnomme « Matriochka ». Véronique Valiquette, sergente et technicienne en explosifs de la police nationale, est d'abord confrontée professionnellement au travail de Matriochka, puis personnellement, lorsqu'une explosion la blesse grièvement et tue l'un de ses proches. Cette battante, blessée dans son être et dans son corps, doit reprendre confiance en elle, en ses moyens, en son jugement, en son instinct, en son savoir et en ses mains reconstruites, qui n'ont plus la dextérité de jadis.

Plus, Jeremy’s house explodes. That’s not a clip about engines, Richard and James just wanted to see it again.

meta.plot: Richard et James reviennent sur de grands moments de The Grand Tour, célébrant les gloires du moteur à combustion interne, notamment la sainte trinité des hypercars, les muscle cars de Detroit, un sprint urbain dans une Bugatti, le char d'assaut le plus fou du monde et une course entre le passé, le présent et le futur.

1.plot: In debt to Yannick, Cheyenne forces Lola to steal jewelry, and Yannick has Cheyenne smuggle a mysterious package onto a ferry to aid illegal migrants.

meta.plot: Sortie de prison il y a trois mois, Cheyenne fait des ménages sur les ferries en rêvant de partir en Amazonie. Lola est une ravissante parisienne, égoïste et sans scrupules, qui vient de débarquer dans le Nord pour s’installer avec son amant. Quand Lola tue l’épouse de son amant, Cheyenne, témoin involontaire, sait qu’elle va être accusée du meurtre à cause de son casier. Elle est obligée de demander au caïd de la région de faire disparaître le corps. Une faveur qui va les entrainer dans un très dangereux jeu de dupes tout en leur permettant de faire fortune à l’insu de tous…

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E01 - Episode 1

1.title: FR - Mr. Bates contre le Post Office - S01E04 - Episode 4

meta.plot: L’histoire de centaines de postiers accusés à tort d’avoir volé de l’argent à leur maison mère entre 1999 et 2015.

1.plot: Rafał is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafał a pendant before being whisked away.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - I... Believe in Heliocentrism
1.plot: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafał's heresy. Once arrested, Rafał is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
1.plot: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
1.plot: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Move... The World

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Matters of the Truth

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - We Must Become Icarus
1.plot: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
1.plot: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Truth
1.plot: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Terror
1.plot: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Heliocentrism Is My Faith
1.plot: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Freedom
1.plot: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Tonight's Sky...
1.plot: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E15 - Is It... My Turn?
1.plot: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E16 - It's Time to Begin the Operation
1.plot: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E17 - I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book… Maybe

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E18 - To Liberate Information
1.plot: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E19 - Wandering Is How You Find What's Right
1.plot: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E20 - I Love Heliocentrism
1.plot: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E21 - The Times Are Changing

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E23 - Comrades

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E24 - Thaumazein

1.title: FR - Orb: On the Movements of the Earth [VOSTFR] - S01E25 - 『?』

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E02 - Wronguay in Ronguay (2)
1.plot: After foiling the Beagle Boys, Scrooge and his nephews decipher the strange marking on the map, which leads to a sunken treasure ship in Ronguay. However, Flintheart Glomgold and El Capitán are out to stop them at every turn.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E03 - Three Ducks of the Condor (3)
1.plot: Upon finding out of the Valley of the Golden Suns, Scrooge begins an expedition to find the treasure therein, starting with finding the map that leads to it. First, he must get one half of the map from High Golden Sun Priest Joaquin Slowly.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E04 - Cold Duck (4)
1.plot: The nephews, Webby, and Mrs. Beakley find themselves joining Scrooge in his adventure as he looks for the second half of the treasure map in Antarctica.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E05 - Too Much of a Gold Thing (5)
1.plot: Scrooge develops gold fever as he and the gang make their way to the Valley of the Golden Suns, all the while pursued by El Capitán.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E06 - Send in the Clones
1.plot: Magica DeSpell gets the Beagle Boys to help her steal the Number One Dime, disguising them as the nephews.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E07 - Sphinx for the Memories
1.plot: An ancient Egyptian civilization abducts Donald so that he can host a spirit of a Pharaoh.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E08 - Where No Duck Has Gone Before
1.plot: Gyro's props for a science fiction television show accidentally launch the cast into space, and Launchpad becomes the hero when it is realized that he is the only real pilot on board.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E09 - Armstrong
1.plot: Gyro presents the McDuck household with a robot named Armstrong to do their work for them. However, the robot decides it would rather work for itself.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E09 - Armstrong
1.plot: Gyro presents the McDuck household with a robot named Armstrong to do their work for them. However, the robot decides it would rather work for itself.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E10 - Robot Robbers
1.plot: After the incident with Armstrong, Gyro builds giant human-operated robots for Glomgold, only to have them be stolen and operated by Ma Beagle and the Beagle Boys.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E11 - Magica's Shadow War
1.plot: Magica's plot to steal the Number One Dime using her own shadow goes awry when her shadow develops a mind of its own.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E12 - Master of the Djinni
1.plot: Scrooge and Glomgold race for mastership of Aladdin's genie.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E13 - Hotel Strangeduck
1.plot: Scrooge turns a castle once owned by mad scientist into a hotel, but he doesn't believe that the place is haunted.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E14 - Lost Crown of Genghis Khan
1.plot: Scrooge goes searching for a crown in the Himalayas, which is guarded by a snow beast. Loosely based on the Carl Barks story of the same name.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E15 - Duckman of Aquatraz
1.plot: Scrooge is framed for stealing a painting from Glomgold's art gallery and sent to Aquatraz.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E16 - The Money Vanishes
1.plot: The Beagle Boys steal Gyro's handheld teleporter and use it to steal Scrooge's fortune.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E17 - Sir Gyro de Gearloose
1.plot: Gyro, tired of being looked upon as a "gadget man", invents a time machine and uses it to go back in time to the Middle Ages.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E18 - Dinosaur Ducks
1.plot: Scrooge and Launchpad explore a land where dinosaurs still live, but the kids tag along against Scrooge's directions to the contrary.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E19 - Hero for Hire
1.plot: After being fired by Scrooge, Launchpad is tricked by the Beagle Boys into performing a series of bank robberies disguised as movie scenes.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E20 - Superdoo!
1.plot: Having a hard time at camp, Doofus accidentally finds a stolen alien crystal that grants him numerous super powers.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E21 - Maid of the Myth
1.plot: Mrs. Beakley is abducted by Vikings and it is up to Scrooge and the others to rescue her.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E22 - Down & Out in Duckburg
1.plot: A family debt causes Scrooge to lose his entire fortune, sending his entire family into the poorhouse.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E23 - Much Ado About Scrooge
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys track down a lost play by a famed playwright.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E24 - Top Duck
1.plot: Launchpad's family comes to visit while the Beagle Boys eye Scrooge's new jet so that they can use it to pilfer his Money Bin.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E25 - Pearl of Wisdom
1.plot: Scrooge learns that a pearl he bought will grant him infinite wisdom once he takes it back to its homeland.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E26 - The Curse of Castle McDuck
1.plot: Scrooge, the nephews, and Webby visit Scrooge's ancestral home in Scotland, only to be embroiled in a mystery surrounding Castle McDuck.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E27 - Launchpad's Civil War
1.plot: When going to Virginia for a Civil War reenactment, Launchpad encounters aged Confederate veterans who once served under his ancestor, who had lost a battle. Meanwhile, Doofus and the nephews learn that a businessman is exploiting the reenactments for financial gain. Launchpad works to avenge his family's honor by rallying the old veterans to a "rematch" of sorts against the reenactors.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E28 - Sweet Duck of Youth
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys head for Florida in search of the fabled Fountain of Youth.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E29 - Earth Quack
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys discover that the games of an underground civilization are causing earthquakes directly under the Money Bin.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E30 - Home Sweet Homer
1.plot: Circe, a sorceress from the past transports Scrooge and the boys back to time of Ancient Greece, where they meet up with Homer.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E31 - Bermuda Triangle Tangle
1.plot: Scrooge seeks to find out why his ships are disappearing in the Bermuda Triangle.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E32 - Micro Ducks from Outer Space
1.plot: Scrooge misuses an alien size-shifting device, and accidentally ends up shrinking himself, the boys, and Webby.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E33 - Back to the Klondike
1.plot: Scrooge takes the kids to the Klondike, where he met an old flame, Glittering Goldie.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E34 - Horse Scents
1.plot: Webby helps trains a horse for the Kenducky Derby so the owner will have the money to raise it.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E35 - Scrooge's Pet
1.plot: Scrooge loses the new combination for his vault to a lemming.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E36 - A Drain on the Economy (1)
1.plot: Scrooge and Glomgold compete in a contest where the winner, being the world's richest duck, becomes the sales broker for a new fruit from Macaroon that works like a flashlight. First, though, Scrooge must keep his fortune away from the Beagle Boys.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E37 - A Whale of a Bad Time (2)
1.plot: As Scrooge tries to deliver his fortune to Macaroon, he experiences an interference in the form of a rogue submarine working for Glomgold.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E38 - Aqua Ducks (3)
1.plot: After dumping his fortune under the sea, Scrooge, along with Launchpad, Gyro, and Doofus, submerges in order to get it out.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E39 - Working for Scales (4)
1.plot: Glomgold and the Beagle Boys attempt to make sure Scrooge doesn't win the contest on his way to Macaroon.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E40 - Merit-Time Adventure
1.plot: The Nephews, Webby, and Doofus attempt to earn a Junior Woodchuck badge in sailing while a sea monster is preying on Scrooge's shipping fleet.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E41 - The Golden Fleecing
1.plot: After hearing about Launchpad's encounter with several Harpies, Scrooge heads to the Black Sea to seek out the legendary Golden Fleece.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E42 - Ducks of the West
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys go to Scrooge's oil wells to find out why they ran dry.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E43 - Time Teasers
1.plot: Gyro invents a watch that allows anyone to move super fast. But the Beagle Boys want to use it so they can steal all of Scrooge's money.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E44 - Back Out in the Outback
1.plot: Something's attacking Scrooge's sheep and shearing off their wool, so Scrooge heads off for Australia to find out what's going on.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E45 - Raiders of the Lost Harp
1.plot: Scrooge acquires a magical harp that can determine if someone was lying or not. However, Magica de Spell wants the harp for herself, and so does the harp's guardian.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E46 - The Right Duck
1.plot: After being fired by Scrooge, Launchpad enters the space program, and accidentally gets sent to Mars.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E47 - Scroogerello
1.plot: While experiencing a fever, Scrooge has an extended dream sequence parodying the fairy tale of Cinderella, with himself in the titular role.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E48 - Double-O-Duck
1.plot: Launchpad finds himself masquerading as Bruno Von Beak, an agent for the Foreign Organization of World Larceny.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E49 - Luck o' the Ducks
1.plot: After finding a leprechaun, Scrooge is led to Ireland, where he believes that he'll find a vast fortune of gold.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E50 - Duckworth's Revolt
1.plot: After being fired by Scrooge, Duckworth and the boys are abducted by plant aliens and enslaved.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E51 - Magica's Magic Mirror
1.plot: Magica uses a pair of magic mirrors to try to get Scrooge's Number One Dime. First part of double episode: Take Me Out of the Ballgame.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E52 - Take Me Out of the Ballgame
1.plot: Duckworth coaches the Junior Woodchucks in a baseball game. Second part of double episode: Magica's Magic Mirror

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E53 - Duck to the Future
1.plot: Magica sends Scrooge into the future, where she has stolen his Number One Dime and taken over his company.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E54 - Jungle Duck
1.plot: While accompanying Scrooge in his search for silver, Mrs. Beakley encounters a Tarzan-like character who used to be a boy she helped raise as a nanny.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E55 - Launchpad's First Crash
1.plot: Scrooge and Launchpad reminisce on how they first met.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E56 - Dime Enough For Luck
1.plot: Magica tricks Gladstone Gander into stealing the Number One Dime for her, and as a result, he is then cursed with bad luck.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E57 - Duck in the Iron Mask
1.plot: Scrooge and the boys take a trip to visit an old friend of his, Count Roy. However, unknown to Scrooge, Roy's evil twin Ray rules Roy's kingdom with an iron fist.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E58 - The Uncrashable Hindentanic
1.plot: Scrooge makes a bet with Glomgold that he can make money off a blimp called the Hindentanic.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E60 - Nothing to Fear
1.plot: Scrooge, the nephews, Doofus, and Duckworth are intimidated by a cloud that generates their worst fears, conjured by Magica.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E61 - Dr. Jekyll & Mr. McDuck
1.plot: Scrooge becomes a victim of a potion that causes him to be obsessive with giving money away. It is up to his nephews to find an antidote before he stays a big spender forever.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E62 - Once Upon a Dime
1.plot: Scrooge tells the story of how his Number One Dime got his fortune started.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E63 - Spies In Their Eyes
1.plot: A hypnotist brainwashes Donald into giving her a remote control device for a submarine that's Scrooge's companies built for the navy.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E64 - All Ducks On Deck
1.plot: Donald makes up a story about being a hero to the nephews. They stow away in the Navy and try to make him a hero. Meanwhile, The Phantom Blot has a spy infiltrating the Navy while he has Scrooge McDuck and Launchpad McQuack as prisoners on Cat Island after they go to investigate Scrooge's fishing fleet there.

1.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S01E65 - Ducky Horror Picture Show
1.plot: Scrooge finances a meeting house, which is then used by a group of horror movie-based monsters.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E01 - Marking Time (1)
2.plot: Scrooge buys one of Glomgold's islands, wherein houses a diamond mine. Upon finding out, Glomgold has the diamond mine blown away from the island. Scrooge, Launchpad, and the nephews then go back in time to try to prevent the explosion, but end up going 1 million years back, where they meet Bubba the Caveduck and his pet Triceratops, Tootsie.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E02 - The Duck Who Would Be King (2)
2.plot: In their attempt to go back to the present, Scrooge, Launchpad, the nephews, and Bubba & Tootsie crash-land in an ancient kingdom terrorized by a tyrant.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E03 - Bubba Trubba (3)
2.plot: Upon their return to the present, Scrooge blames all his financial troubles on Bubba, all the while the Beagle Boys try to capture him.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E04 - Ducks on the Lam (4)
2.plot: After the Beagle Boys kick them out of the Money Bin, Scrooge and Bubba have a series of troubles that land them in jail.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E05 - Ali Bubba's Cave (5)
2.plot: As Scrooge, the nephews, and Launchpad try to find a way to pay Glomgold for the aforementioned island, Bubba & Tootsie, having now returned to the past, feel lonely and try to return to the present.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E06 - Liquid Assets (1)
2.plot: In order to move his Money Bin after the Beagle Boys change the new freeway route, Scrooge hires an accountant, and Fenton Crackshell gets the job.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E07 - Frozen Assets (2)
2.plot: After accidentally losing the Number One Dime to the Beagle Boys, Fenton makes several attempts to get it back, eventually becoming the cybernetic superhero GizmoDuck.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E08 - Full Metal Duck (3)
2.plot: GizmoDuck becomes a sensation with the people of Duckburg - that is, until Ma Beagle and her smartest son, Megabyte Beagle, make a remote control with which to make him work for them.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E09 - The Billionaire Beagle Boys Club (4)
2.plot: After the Beagles get GizmoDuck to steal Scrooge's fortune for them and land Scrooge in jail, the nephews work to save the day.

2.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S02E10 - Money to Burn (5)
2.plot: Alien robots invade and steal Scrooge's Money Bin so that it can be melted down to produce more metal.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E01 - The Land of Trala La
3.plot: When Scrooge develops an unnatural ailment, Fenton takes him to a place where money isn't used. But Fenton's plan backfires when he gets the locals to use bottlecaps as currency.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E02 - Allowance Day
3.plot: In order to receive their allowances ahead of time so they can buy a new scooter, the nephews trick Scrooge into believing it's Saturday instead of Friday, resulting in mass confusion worldwide.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E03 - Bubbeo & Juliet
3.plot: In this spoof of Romeo and Juliet, Bubba falls in love with the daughter of Scrooge's new neighbors, who have gotten in a feud with Scrooge.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E04 - The Good Muddahs
3.plot: The Beagle Babes, female cousins of the Beagle Boys, kidnap Webby in ransom for a set of crown jewels.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E05 - My Mother the Psychic
3.plot: Fenton's mother suffers a bad shock when trying to get better television reception. Her new-found psychic abilities are soon exploited by Scrooge, much to Fenton's chagrin.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E06 - Metal Attraction
3.plot: A robot maid built by Gyro falls in love with GizmoDuck.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E07 - Dough Ray Me
3.plot: Inflation shoots up the roof when duplicating coins spread through Duckburg.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E08 - Bubba's Big Brainstorm
3.plot: Bubba's grades are deplorable, so the nephews use one of Gyro's latest inventions to increase his IQ, but they all soon become annoyed with the new Bubba.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E09 - The Big Flub
3.plot: Fenton shoots a series of test commercials, but mistakingly creates demand for a nonexistant product. In desperation, he uses a new bubble gum invented by Gyro, who has not had time to test for side effects.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E10 - A Case of Mistaken Secret Identity
3.plot: Scrooge's nephews are trying to figure out just who Gizmoduck's secret identity is. So far, their predictions all point to Launchpad McQuack.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E11 - Blue Collar Scrooge
3.plot: Scrooge suffers a case of amnesia, during which he protests against himself and dates Fenton's mother.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E12 - Beaglemania
3.plot: The Beagle Boys become the latest music sensation in Duckburg, much to Scrooge's chagrin.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E13 - Yuppy Ducks
3.plot: The nephews makes business decisions in Scrooge's name while Scrooge is in the hospital.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E14 - The Bride Wore Stripes
3.plot: Ma Beagle pretends that she's married to Scrooge in order to inherit his fortune.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E15 - The Unbreakable Bin
3.plot: Scrooge acquires a special glass from Gyro that makes the Money Bin invulnerable to attack.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E16 - Attack of the Fifty-Foot Webby
3.plot: Webby, who has been feeling overlooked, ends up becoming a giantess after falling into a mysterious pool in the jungle. While she is now the center of attention, she does not like it very much. While Scrooge searches for a way to reverse the process, a corrupt circus owner seeks to kidnap Webby for his new sideshow.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E17 - The Masked Mallard
3.plot: Scrooge decides to become a vigilante after an unflattering report on him on television.

3.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S03E18 - A DuckTales Valentine (Amour or Less)
3.plot: Scrooge acquires magical love arrows that once belonged to a goddess.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E01 - Ducky Mountain High
4.plot: Scrooge meets up with Glittering Goldie again in order to acquire land filled with golden trees from her. However, Glomgold also wants that land.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E02 - Attack of the Metal Mites
4.plot: Glomgold intends to use metal-eating bugs to wipe out Scrooge's fortunes.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E03 - The Duck Who Knew Too Much
4.plot: Fenton uncovers an international conspiracy to steal Scrooge's gold overseas while supposedly on vacation.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E04 - New Gizmo-Kids on the Block
4.plot: Fenton's mother accidentally shrinks the Gizmoduck suit, and the child-size suit ends up in the hands of Scrooge's nephews.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E05 - Scrooge's Last Adventure
4.plot: When Scrooge loses his money due to a computer bug, he and Fenton travel through cyberspace to get it back.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E06 - The Golden Goose (1)
4.plot: Dijon ends up joining the Brotherhood of the Goose, a group dedicated to protecting the Golden Goose (a goose that can turn anything to gold), led by his brother Poupon. Dijon "borrows" it, but accidentally loses it to Scrooge, who soon discovers its secret but then loses it to the Beagle Boys, whom Glomgold has sent to get it.

4.title: FR - La bande à Picsou (1987) - S04E07 - The Golden Goose (2)
4.plot: Scrooge, Launchpad, Dijon, and Poupon try to retrieve the Golden Goose from Glomgold and the Beagles before it can set off its transformations that can bring forth the end of the world.

meta.plot: Les aventures de l'oncle Picsou et de ses trois neveux Riri, Fifi et Loulou. Lorsqu'ils ne sont pas en quête d'un trésor, les neveux de Donald sont à Canardville, entourés de Zaza, Mamie Baba et Flagada Jones et affrontent avec ruse les ennemis de leur oncle.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E01 - Don't Let Me Fall
1.plot: Reeling from loss, Staten fails to notice Quinn's growing feelings — while Davis sees an opening. The arrival of a mysterious drifter shakes up the town.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E02 - Sure as the Day Is Long
1.plot: Staten follows a key lead in his investigation. Quinn makes a deal with troubling implications. Lucas struggles to keep his brother in line.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E03 - Trouble Can Be Fun Sometimes
1.plot: Conflict ignites at the dance hall's grand reopening. A familiar face from Yancy's past makes an unwelcome appearance.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E04 - That Boy Is My Whole Heart
1.plot: A feud with his father gives Reid a chance to bond with Staten — even if it means working side-by-side with Lucas. Davis attempts to win over Quinn.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E05 - I Love a Good Secret
1.plot: Davis' growing bond with Quinn is threatened by his ex-wife, who has a devious plan to take down Staten and Cap. Yancy takes a risk at the rodeo.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E06 - We Need to Talk About Reid
1.plot: Paula Jo sows discord between Staten and Quinn. Ellie digs into Yancy's past. Lucas and Lauren make a shocking discovery.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E07 - By the Grace of God
1.plot: Staten and Quinn find themselves in close quarters when a tornado strikes. A confession sparks new revelations in the investigation into Randall's death.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E08 - The Bad Seed
1.plot: Despite a break in the case, Dan still has doubts. Ellie pressures Yancy to come clean to Cap. Lauren prepares for her big cheer tryout.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E09 - About Forever
1.plot: Torn between her passions, Quinn must make a choice. Staten and Davis' tenuous alliance is threatened. Cap comes face-to-face with his past regrets.

1.title: FR - Nouvelle vie à Ransom Canyon - S01E10 - Maybe It's Time Yancy Grey Dies Too
1.plot: Tensions between Staten and Davis come to a head. Ellie uncovers a bombshell. Dan must decide whether to reveal the truth — at enormous cost.

meta.plot: Les passions sont vives dans cette petite ville du Texas, où trois dynasties de ranchers se battent pour leurs terres, leur héritage et leurs proches.

FR - Anaon - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Anaon - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Anaon - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Anaon - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Anaon - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Un mois après la mort de sa femme, Max est chargé d’enquêter sur la disparition mystérieuse d’une adolescente. Sa fille, Wendie, comprend aux côtés de ses amis que quelque chose de surnaturel est à l’œuvre…

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E01 - Diary of a Perfect Murder
1.plot: Atlanta lawyer Ben Matlock takes on the high profile case of a television reporter accused of murdering his former wife. The case is complicated when his daughter Charlene develops feelings for the accused killer.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E02 - The Judge
1.plot: Ben Matlock accepts the pro bono case of Kevin Meredith, a young man accused of murdering his lover, whom Ben soon realises had a much more powerful lover.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E03 - The Stripper
1.plot: Years ago, Ben represented Jason Hardiman in his divorce proceedings, and upon his instructions, offered Carla a small fortune to relinquish custody of their son. She refused, and eventually won. Now Carla can only find work as a stripper. Jason goes to her work and again threatens to take their son Jimmy from her. When he is found at the edge of death, Carla is the immediate suspect. He is murdered while in the hospital, and Carla is the prime suspect. Ben's suspicions soon turn to a woman named Helen Shelly, but unfortunately, it's hard to find her. Doug Templitt seems to be the only one who knows where she is.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E04 - The Affair
1.plot: Matlock represents the a maid accused of killing her employer, at the request of the man's widow. The request is a little odd, but it seems Christina Ward wants people to know exactly what kind of man her husband was. Matlock is more than a little uncomfortable when it seems Charlene is developing a tendre for the woman's son Clark, an old college chum of Charlene's.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E05 - The Seduction
1.plot: Matlock is hired to defend Brad Bingham, an aging football star with a reputation as a womanizer who was about to be cut from the team. Charlene is resistant to Ben's choice, as she believes everything the tabloids have to say about Brad...not only that, but years earlier, he'd had a brief relationship with her friend Ellen Hawley, who had tried to kill herself after they broke up. As the case continues, Charlene realises that not everything that's printed in the papers is true and that maybe Ellen wasn't quite honest with her, even though a call girl (Caryn Nelson) hired to make Brad look guilty almost convinces her that he is.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E06 - The Don (1)
1.plot: When Nicholas Baron, a well known mobster, is accused of murdering one of his rivals, he asks Ben Matlock to represent him. Ben initially refuses, but agrees to represent Baron despite threats on his own life. He soon meets the entire family, and realises that despite what Baron has always done for a living, at heart he's a worried father who wants to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E07 - The Don (2)
1.plot: Even though they've lost a key witness, Matlock keeps defending Nicholas Baron. Daniel tries to convince Matlock that his father just can't handle any stress due to his heart condition, but Nicholas continues to beg Matlock to clear his name. While Matlock investigates a suspect closer to home than Baron would want, Charlene blows her chance at a relationship with Paul when she can't separate the man from the legend.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E08 - The Sisters
1.plot: Harold Scully is a boring man. But at least he knows that. When he begs old acquaintance Ben Matlock to defend him on charges of murdering his wealthy wife Esther, Matlock reluctantly agrees. The more investigating he does, the more he realises that there is something seriously wrong with Harold's two nieces, sisters Julia and Emily.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E09 - The Cop
1.plot: Detective Joe Peters has been accused of taking bribes and murdering a fence, and also suspected in the death of a fellow cop. When it comes right down to it, one of the other cops on the force was more involved than they should have been.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E10 - The Angel
1.plot: Matlock reluctantly agrees to hire free-spirited rock star Angel after Charlene reveals she's already taken the job for them. Angel has been accused of killing her manager, and due to an alcohol induced black-out, can't even offer herself an alibi for the night. Matlock gets more and more angry when Angel continues to ignore his suggestions at toning down her life-style, but luckily he's able to get through to her before her attitude gets her convicted of murder.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E11 - A Traitor in Thine Own House
1.plot: Tensions rise as Shae work with Olympia's team on a case for a tech startup that's had trade secrets stolen.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E13 - Pregame
1.plot: An important class-action lawsuit leads the team to investigate a sorority; Matty brings Alfie with her to Jacobson Moore on Family Day.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E14 - Game Day
1.plot: Olympia hires an outside party to select jurors rather than using Shae, putting the case at risk.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E15 - Game Face
1.plot: Olympia's partnership dream hangs in the balance as she and her team race against the clock to get a dangerous drink off the market.

1.title: FR - Matlock - S01E16 - The Johnson Case

meta.plot: Ancienne gloire du barreau, Madeline Matlock reprend du service dans un prestigieux cabinet où elle utilise son allure discrète et ses tactiques rusées pour gagner des affaires et dénoncer la corruption.

meta.plot: Les jeunes années de Gibbs au sein du NIS et au NCIS dans les années 90

1.title: FR - Zodiac : l'obsession - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Zodiac : l'obsession - S01E02 - Episode 2

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire offre un regard unique et contemporain sur l'une des affaires criminelles les plus célèbres de l'histoire. Fayçal Ziraoui, un jeune polytechnicien, découvre par hasard l'affaire du Zodiac, une affaire qui a émergé à la fin des années 60 à San Francisco. Un tueur en série terrifiait la population, mettant en scène ses crimes et inondant les journaux et la police de lettres énigmatiques contenant des cryptogrammes. Le tueur a disparu sans laisser de trace. 50 ans plus tard, Fayçal relève le défi de déchiffrer les deux derniers codes envoyés par le tueur.

Lorsque sa fille (Kat Dennings), avec qui il est en froid, et ses enfants emménagent dans sa maison, l'heure est à la réparation des liens familiaux.

Créée par les producteurs de "La Fabuleuse Madame Maisel", cette nouvelle série audacieuse célèbre la beauté, l'humour et le caractère imprévisible d'une vie dédiée aux arts, que ce soit sur scène ou en dehors.

2.title: FR - Tracker - S02E20 - Echo Ridge
2.plot: Colter returns to Echo Ridge to investigate a diner owner's disappearance, only to uncover a decades-old kidnapping and a shocking family secret.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E01 - The Process
3.plot: As Colter grapples with the shocking truth surrounding his father’s death, Russell joins forces with his brother to help track down the missing wife and daughter of one of Reenie’s clients. Their reunion finds them mixed up in a chain of events involving a sinister underground operation known as ‘The Process.’

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E02 - Leverage
3.plot: After discovering they've disrupted a sinister underground operation called "The Process," Colter and Russell must race to find the source behind these chained events and end it once and for all.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E03 - First Fire
3.plot: On Halloween night, when a nurse is murdered and arsonist Heston Koontz disappears from a psychiatric facility, Colter follows a trail of unsettling clues to uncover the truth with assistance from local officer Dundee.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E04 - No Man's Land
3.plot: When a man disappears in a lawless Arizona desert town, Colter's investigation uncovers a hidden relationship that draws him into a dangerous power struggle – and leaves him facing the hard conditions of the wilderness.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E05 - The Old Ways
3.plot: When four teens vanish during a hike in the Santa Cruz Mountains, Colter's search uncovers a hidden agenda behind their journey, leading him to an off-grid community where all their lives are put in danger.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E06 - Angel
3.plot: When a crime scene cleaner disappears, Colter discovers her fascination with true crime, which may have led her into dangerous territory. As he follows her trail, Colter uncovers a group of amateur sleuths whose hunt for a killer puts everyone at risk.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E07 - Eat the Rich
3.plot: When chasing down leads about his father’s past, Colter meets a man desperate to find his daughter who vanished while working a courier route. As Colter retraces his steps, he’s pulled into an orbit of a wealthy family and their ruthless fixer, who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E08 - Eurydice
3.plot: When a grieving mother becomes the prime suspect in her missing daughter's murder, Colter sets out to find the true culprit and prove her innocence.

3.title: FR - Tracker - S03E09 - Good Trouble
3.plot: When Colter's old friend Keaton asks for help finding his former partner, they uncover a trail of bodies and a conspiracy that runs deeper than they could've imagined.

meta.plot: Colter Shaw est un loup solitaire, qui parcourt le pays à bord de son camping-car, utilisant ses talents de pisteur pour aider les particuliers et les forces de l'ordre à résoudre toutes sortes de crimes ou à retrouver les personnes disparues.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E01 - Material Adverse Change
1.plot: Focused on making partner at her cutthroat New York City law firm, Ingrid finds her plans thrown off-kilter when a new colleague arrives from London.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E02 - Meta-Strategy
1.plot: The search for a missing document and a surprise lunch date crank up the tension between Ingrid and Murphy. Rachel hits it off with a sassy new client.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E03 - Change of Venue
1.plot: In an effort to salvage the SunCorp deal, Ingrid heads upstate with Murphy. Rachel helps a flighty heiress, and Tyler deals with major fashion drama.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E04 - Due Diligence
1.plot: As her new relationship moves at warp speed, Ingrid competes with Murphy to impress their boss. A reluctant Rachel organizes the firm's talent show.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E05 - Out of Office
1.plot: The firm's annual retreat at a swanky resort finds Ingrid and Murphy stuck untangling a thorny SunCorp issue and Rachel tapping into her creative side.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E06 - Client Relations
1.plot: With HR investigating the ugly incident at the retreat, Ingrid plays messenger for Marty, while Rachel receives an exciting offer on her 30th birthday.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E07 - Talking Points
1.plot: Amid big personal news, Ingrid takes over planning the firm's diversity gala. Rachel makes a bold move at work and Tyler feels under pressure at home.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E08 - Consequential Damages
1.plot: On Thanksgiving Day, Ingrid races to finalize the SunCorp deal with Murphy, Tyler faces questions about his future, and Rachel sees a new side of Justin.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E09 - Pro Forma
1.plot: With the firm's holiday party — and partner announcements — approaching, Ingrid grows closer to Murphy, Rachel suffers a setback and Tyler branches out.

1.title: FR - Partner Track - S01E10 - Dawn Raid
1.plot: In the aftermath of the partner news, Ingrid initiates an audacious plan to right her wrongs, both personally and professionally.

meta.plot: Gérant amours, amis et attentes familiales, Ingrid Yun fait tout pour devenir associée dans un prestigieux cabinet d'avocats de New York… sans trahir ses valeurs.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Living in the Mist
1.plot: An accidental date with Jeong Gu-won leaves Do Do-Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Everyone Has a Demon in Their Heart
1.plot: Gu-won inexplicably loses his power — and finds that Do-hee might be the key to regaining it. But his efforts to take back his abilities backfire.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Joining Hands with a Demon
1.plot: After another attack, Do-hee asks Gu-won to be her guard — even after his admission as a demon. Do-hee finds the loss of someone close suspicious.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Sweet but Dangerous
1.plot: Do-hee proposes to Gu-won, but he refuses. She later recruits him to investigate Ju Cheon-suk's death, but he faces an unexpected power blockage.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Only You
1.plot: After a dramatic rescue, Gu-won and Do-hee begin having complex feelings for each other. Do-hee later tries to find a man to marry — frustrating Gu-won.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Into the Wheel of Fortune
1.plot: After Gu-won saves Do-hee's life, she receives competing marriage proposals. She ends up choosing one, and finds an alarming face at her wedding.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Stained Relationships
1.plot: Do-hee and Gu-won go through newlywed pains as they move in together. Ju Seok-hoon begins to suspect Gu-won's non-human identity.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - The Fateful Choice
1.plot: After a sudden attack on Gu-won, Do-hee rushes to save his life — and as life around her becomes more dangerous, she makes a surprising career move.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - The Unmasked Truth
1.plot: As Do-hee and Gu-won's relationship finally blossoms, Gu-won begins to experience a strange change in his powers — all amidst a larger looming threat.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Breaking Through the Shell
1.plot: Upon discovering his fate, Gu-won tries to find another way to save himself. But just as he and Do-hee prepare their ritual, she becomes a target.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - A Paradise of the Ominous
1.plot: Gu-won finds his power restored after rescuing Do-hee from a sure death — but with side effects. With no time to waste, the two investigate the attack.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - The Savior of Destruction
1.plot: A dream of Gu-won's past life reveals his tragic connection to Do-hee. After the two hear of a death, their suspicions of the Noh family deepens.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - The Past, the Original Sin
1.plot: As Gu-won and Do-hee enjoy their bliss, he notices her unresolved trauma. The two later join Noh Suk-min for dinner, unaware of his true intentions.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Our Personal Hell
1.plot: Gu-won comes to Do-hee's rescue after a frightening confrontation with Suk-min. But Suk-min's revelation about Cheon-suk leaves Do-hee harrowed.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E15 - The End of Fate
1.plot: Police fails to find Suk-min's body, opening up a concerning possibility. Do-hee attempts to bury her feelings after Gu-won disappears without a trace.

1.title: FR - Mon démon [VOSTFR] - S01E16 - Our Personal Heaven
1.plot: Do-hee finds herself catatonic after her loss. Desperate for Gu-won's return, she makes a Christmas wish for her love — which Noh Suk-nyeo hears.

meta.plot: Un démon sans pitié perd ses pouvoirs après s'être lié avec une héritière hautaine qui semble détenir la clé de son malheur... mais aussi celle de son cœur.

1.title: FR - School Tales : La série - S01E01 - 7AM
1.plot: A student unwilingly arrives early to class to warn his classmate about different messages that appear on the blackboard every morning.

1.title: FR - School Tales : La série - S01E02 - Vengeful Spell
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E03 - Beautiful
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E04 - The Book of Corpses
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E05 - The Headless Teacher
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E06 - Lunch
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E07 - The Curse
FR - School Tales : La série - S01E08 - A Walk in School
1.plot: At night, a gutsy student livestreams his investigation of his high school to prove that ghost stories aren't real.

meta.plot: Dans cette série d'anthologie, de grands réalisateurs d'horreur thaïlandais racontent des histoires de fantômes terrifiantes se déroulant dans les couloirs d'un lycée.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A demonstration ends violently. Tensions rise with the arrival of the riot squad's new leader and the protest's fallout.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Nobili tries to lead the team amid Mazinga's resistance, resulting in another injured agent. Investigations continue as someone questions loyalty.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The unit faces interrogation. Marta fears for her daughter. Nobili earns respect by defending a family during a riot — while a crisis erupts at home.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Nobili opens up to Marta, Mazinga expresses his exhaustion with work. Salvatore's long-distance relationship triggers his insecurities.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Still unsure about what to do with the new evidence, Nobili takes the law into his own hands — and so does Salvatore. Pietro gets serious with Mazinga.

1.title: FR - Désordre public - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: At a Christmas dinner, Nobili makes a final move to fit in with the squad. A notification from the prosecution puts everyone at risk of suspension.

meta.plot: Après une nuit de violence catastrophique, la tension monte au sein d'une brigade antiémeute qui a du mal à faire la distinction entre travail et vie privée.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E01 - Contact
1.plot: Two years after the mysterious Burst that killed her family, Aiko has nearly learned to walk again.But a transfer student's arrival upends her life.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E02 - Target
1.plot: Kanzaki takes Aiko to the Town, where her father's old colleague Kurose tells her the unbelievable: Her brain was transplanted into an artificial body.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E03 - Decision
1.plot: The CAAC detains Aiko and Yuya, but the Divers manage to break them out. Though the Matter is active again, the group plans to head to Primary Point.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E04 - Encounter
1.plot: The group clears the Gate just as the government orders an evacuation. Their first target is the Guillotine Shutter at K1, but the Matter is active.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E05 - Memory
1.plot: Inside the Area, the group rests and resupplies at the camp. Nanbara gets a ride from Kurose, but she and Isazu appear to have their own plans.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E06 - Awakening
1.plot: Kaede's showing off delays the group's progress to point K2, which they must reach before sunrise to enter Area Three. Isazu tells Kurose what he did.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E07 - Breakthrough
1.plot: The CAAC Special Forces intercept the group to try to take Aiko back. Kurose realizes that Isazu's daughter Yuzuha is connected to the Matter.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E08 - Way
1.plot: The Divers confront Aiko and Kanzaki, but they agree to continue with the mission. Isazu becomes lab director and learns about Unit One.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E09 - Truth
1.plot: The team reaches the biotech research facility at Primary Point, but Isazu manages to patch in a video feed to confront Kanzaki about his intentions.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E10 - Volition
1.plot: Aiko has the chance to speak to her other self inside the Malignant Matter. Meanwhile, the human form Matter engulfs Yura, revealing Yuzuha.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E11 - Devotion
1.plot: Isazu establishes a link to the Matter so he can interrogate Yura. The JSDF prepares to incinerate the entire Area despite Nanbara's objections.

1.title: FR - A.I.C.O. Incarnation - S01E12 - Reincarnation
1.plot: At the surgical site, Yura admits his intentions changed with Aiko's decision. Kurose tries to sever the link between Yuzuha and her duplicates.

meta.plot: Quand Aiko apprend que son existence est fondée sur un terrible mensonge, elle fait équipe avec des Divers pour anéantir le Burst, et peut-être sauver sa famille.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E01 - Change
1.plot: After enduring years of abuse from his peers, Park Hyeong-seok moves to a different neighborhood to start a new life. Big changes are coming for him.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E02 - New Life
1.plot: Hyeong-seok attends school in his new body by day and works a part-time job as his true self by night – only to learn that nothing has really changed.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E03 - Friends
1.plot: A student by the nickname Basco helps the old Hyeong-seok fight off bullies, while the new Hyeong-seok hangs out with his first-ever group of friends.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E04 - Mom
1.plot: Hyeong-seok takes his mother out to a cafe as his transformed self. Basco seethes with righteous indignation when he spots the two together.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E05 - Kindness
1.plot: Hyeong-seok lends a hand to other struggling peers in school, while an enigmatic classmate offers him help and gifts when he needs it most.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E06 - Recommendation
1.plot: Pyeon Deok-hwa considers performing at the school festival, while others in his class relentlessly try to trample on his dream of becoming a rap artist.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E07 - Special Training
1.plot: Under Deok-hwa’s direction, Hyeong-seok unlocks his singing potential as their musical collaboration nurtures their blossoming friendship.

1.title: FR - Lookism - S01E08 - Wall
1.plot: Competition heats up backstage on the day of the festival. Hyeong-seok and Deok-hwa leave their past and fears behind to deliver a song from the heart.

meta.plot: Dans une société où la beauté est reine, un lycéen marginal mène une double vie en intervertissant constamment deux physiques aux antipodes l'un de l'autre.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E01 - The Sandkings
1.plot: Scientist Simon Kress finds himself the master of a colony of Sandkings -- creatures from Mars that look like insects, but have the intelligence of much higher beings.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E02 - Valerie 23
1.plot: Frank Hellner, a lonely paraplegic, takes part in a top-secret project -- allowing an "inorganic human," or robot named Valerie, to be his companion for a week. The experiment goes awry when Valerie, unable to control her programmed emotions, becomes jealous and threatens the life of Frank's physical therapist and close friend Rachel.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E03 - Blood Brothers
1.plot: Two diametrically opposed brothers, wrestle for control of a million-dollar pharmaceutical company. A vaccine that could hold the secret to eternal life, becomes the object of the brothers' bitter struggle.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E04 - The Second Soul
1.plot: Man's first encounter with beings from another planet -- the N'Tal -- appears to be a mutually rewarding arrangement. But a leery doctor/scientist must decide whether the N'Tal are friend or foe.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E05 - White Light Fever
1.plot: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens nature's order of existence, when billionaire Harlan Hawkes pays a brilliant cardiologist, Dr. "Mac" McEnerney to help him cheat death.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E06 - The Choice
1.plot: A young girl with strange, supernatural powers is shunned by her friends, but welcomed by a nanny with similar gifts, while her parents must decide what's ultimately best for their child.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E07 - Virtual Future
1.plot: A brilliant young scientist discovers a way to see the future, but gets caught up in a billionaire's ambitious political schemes, and must alter the future to save his own life.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E08 - Living Hell
1.plot: Ben Kohler's life is saved after having an experimental chip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing and experiencing violent images, it becomes clear something is desperately wrong.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E09 - Corner of the Eye
1.plot: A disillusioned priest is given healing power by aliens who use him as they attempt to save their own planet by destroying all human life.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E10 - Under the Bed
1.plot: When a little boy is abducted the only witness, his sister, claims that someone or something under the bed took him.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E11 - Dark Matters
1.plot: Dropped out of hyperspace by a mysterious chunk of dark matter, Pilot Paul Stein must save the transport vessel by facing his past and ultimately trusting his own decisions.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E12 - The Conversion
1.plot: Henry Marshall is a greedy man who has paid for his greed with a prison sentence but has yet to learn his lesson. His life abruptly changes when he encounters visitors from another planet who instill new sense of compassion for others.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E13 - Quality of Mercy
1.plot: Major John Skokes is taken prisoner by the enemy during a savage galactic war and a seemingly undefeatable alien race. The tension increases when his cellmate, a cadet named Pri, is being transformed into one of them. Skokes must find an escape to save his cellmate and to avoid a disturbing revelation of the course of this war.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E14 - The New Breed
1.plot: The discovery of a gifted scientist falls into the wrong hands, bringing what at first appears to be a lifesaving miracle, but ultimately the untimely death of his closest friend.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E15 - The Voyage Home
1.plot: When an astronaut returning from Mars discovers an alien aboard ship, he must face the loss of his shipmates, and make the ultimate sacrifice in order to prevent the alien from reaching Earth.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E16 - Caught in the Act
1.plot: A chaste co-ed is enveloped by a strange power that gives her an insatiable sexual appetite, which is perpetuated by encounters with consenting men who, after making physical contact, morph into her body and disappear.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E17 - The Message
1.plot: A deaf woman with a transplanted device, which is supposed to enable her to hear, turns into a transmitter for aliens, who are crying for help.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E18 - I, Robot
1.plot: Adam, a powerful robot, kills his creator when the scientist attempts to convert him into a military killing machine by destroying his more human qualities.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E19 - If These Walls Could Talk
1.plot: Levi Mitchell, a physicist and skeptic, meets Lynda Tillman, a woman whose strength and faith help him unravel the mystery of a haunted house.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E20 - Birthright
1.plot: An environmentally-friendly U.S. Senator's life changes drastically after a freak accident, when he realizes he's actually an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the earth's atmosphere.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E21 - The Voice of Reason
1.plot: A civilian with strong ties to the military tries desperately to use concrete evidence to convince a high level committee that alien forces are trying to overcome the human race.

1.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S01E22 -

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E01 - A Stitch in Time
2.plot: FBI agent Jamie Perrin has investigated some pretty strange cases in her time but this one may be the strangest of all. During the last fifty years, seventeen men throughout the country were all murdered with the same gun. This gun is traced to Dr. Theresa Givens, a scientist who recently left a top-secret government agency. This discovery deepens the mystery because Givens was only five years old at the time of the first murder. The gun itself hadn't even been made. While investigating further, Perrin discovers a secret that lies behind the locked door in Dr. Givens' office and learns first-hand of the temptations and dangers of undoing the evils of the past.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E02 - Resurrection
2.plot: Life on planet Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, leaving behind only androids. Two of those androids, Martin and Alicia, have a secret project: Cain, a human being grown from the DNA of a single human hair. Martin and Alicia must keep Cain's existence hidden from the military androids, led by Moloch, a power-mad machine who is determined to stamp out any trace of the human race before it rises again.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E03 - Unnatural Selection
2.plot: Howard and Joanne Sharp are going to have a baby. Like many people in the near future, they are mulling over the possibility of black-market genetic enhancement. The upside is a perfect baby, able to compete with all those other perfect babies created by the popular, but illegal process. The downside is GRS - Genetic Rejection Syndrome - which turns one in every 10,000 genetically enhanced babies into a monster. The Sharps are willing to take the risk and go ahead with the procedure. Then they learn of the dark secret that their neighbors and best friends, Tony and Fran Blake, keep in the basement.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E04 - I Hear You Calling
2.plot: Reporter Carter Jones is on her way to work when her cellular phone picks up a suspicious conversation about the ""removal"" of a controversial author. Her journalistic curiosity piqued, Carter investigates, despite the objections of her boss and the police. As a result, she finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse, involving a strange man with violet eyes, an ill-fated cruise and people who disappear leaving behind only a pile of purple ash. Can Carter get to the bottom of these mysterious disappearances? Or will she be the next to vanish?

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E05 - Mind Over Matter
2.plot: Dr. Sam Stein has always lived for his work. His dedication has paid off with the development of the Computer Aided Visual Environment system of CAVE, which allows doctors to jack-in directly to the brain of patients. When an accident puts his colleague Rachael Carter in a coma, Stein decides to use CAVE for his own purposes, reaching into Rachael's brain to tell her what he couldn't while she was conscious: that he loves her. Stein discovers, however, that love takes strange turns when it enters CAVE's virtual world and that the complexities of the human heart are not easily translated into bits and bytes.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E06 - Beyond the Veil
2.plot: After flashbacks of an alien abduction drives him to the brink of suicide, Eddie Wexler finds himself at a mental institute, where Dr. Sherrick is using a controversial technique to treat those who believe they have been abducted by extraterrestrials. Eddie and some of the other patients are suspicious of Sherrick and his methods, which forces patients to re-live their abductions in the memory chamber. Some even think that their abductors have infiltrated the institute. Is this just a paranoid delusion or is there an alien face behind the doctor's mask?

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E07 - First Anniversary
2.plot: As he celebrates his first wedding anniversary, Norman Glass thinks he's the luckiest man alive. His wife Ady, whom he met after the tragic death of her first husband, is stunningly beautiful and talented. She loves him more than anyone alive. They have two great friends, Dennis and Barbara, who were arried on the same day and are just as madly in love as Norman and Ady. But suddenly things start to change. First, Dennis leaves Barbara. Then, Norman must struggle with the strange, growing revulsion he feels when he touches, smells, tastes or sees his lovely wife. Norman thinks he's going crazy, but Barbara and Ady know better. Is love blind? Is beauty only skin-deep? Guess again.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E08 - Straight and Narrow
2.plot: Rusty Dobson has always been a problem child. His single mom decides to send him to the Milgram Academy, an ultra-strict private school that has produced some of the nation's top business and political leaders. What Rusty's mom doesn't know -  and what Rusty finds out the hard way - is that Milgram doesn't just build the leaders of tomorrow, it controls them. The academy installs small computer chips in the  student's brains, turning them into blindly loyal servants of the academy and The Committee, a shadowy body that controls the project. Thanks to a malfunctioning chip, Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E09 - Trial by Fire
2.plot: On the day of Charles Halsey's inauguration as President of the United States, scientists detect a large object heading towards Earth at half the speed of light. Halsey, a peace-loving liberal, is rushed to an underground bunker by the Presidential transition team, a group of aides and military men that share the hawkish bent of the previous administration. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes clear that the object came from an armada of alien ships, which are fast approaching Earth. Contact is made, but the aliens' message is unclear. As the U.S. and the other nuclear powers gear up to defend themselves, Halsey must decide: Are these invaders bent on conquering earth or benevolent explorers reaching out to another civilization?

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E10 - Worlds Apart
2.plot: Space agency director Nancy MacDonald gets a lesson in the meaning of time and distance with an unexpected signal from astronaut Christopher Lindy. Lindy, the man MacDonald once loved, disappeared on a routine space mission 20 years ago. Oblivious to the time that has passed, Lindy must deal with his present situation; being alone on an unknown planet. MacDonald turns to her husband, marine biologist Greg Tilman, to help Lindy survive attacks by an alien lifeform while she and her staff look for a way to save Lindy before the window of opportunity to save him once again disappears.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E11 - The Refuge
2.plot: ""What is reality?"" is the question before Raymond Bava after he collapses during a blizzard and awakens in a private refuge run by Sanford Valle. Valle's companions include his son and daughter-in-law, Thomas and Justine, and Gina Beaumont. Ray, drawn to the gentle Gina, recoils from the callous corruption displayed by the all-controlling Valle and the other inhabitants. Then, following a moment of violence, Ray begins to doubt reality when all the characters, including Gina, reverse roles and personalities. When he is suddenly freed from Valle's control, Ray finds he has been locked in a cryogenic-induced nightmare, but one he must return to fulfill his love for Gina.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E12 - Inconstant Moon
2.plot: When a lonely physics professor realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years. He courts and proposes to Leslie, a woman he has known for two years but never dated. Leslie, although puzzled, finds herself more and more entranced by Stan until she finds out the reason for Stan's sudden attention. Based on a short story by famed sci-fi writer Larry Niven, this episode brings its characters face to face with both death and their own visions of life - with surprising results.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E13 - From Within
2.plot: A mentally challenged boy named Howie is the last unaffected person in a small town overrun by a strange madness. Miners unearth ancient parasites, in the shape of worms, that attack the brains of their hosts. While the infected townsfolk lose all their inhibitions, Howie must save his sister Sheila, the only person who truly cares for him. Deprived of Sheila's guidance for the first time in his life, Howie struggles to evade his maddened neighbors and destroy the parasites. In the process, he becomes a hero to the whole town.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E14 - The Heist
2.plot: Embittered after a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor helps a self-styled militia major hijack an Army shipment. He reaps a deadly reward. The militia, which includes Lee's brother Calvin, expected a missile shipment. Instead, they find a mysterious, sealed cargo and a lone Army Guard. Under threat of death, Captain Teri Washington refuses to reveal the nature of the cargo but warns it is deadly. The major thinks she is lying until an alien lifeform begins a chilling series of attacks. Discipline crumbles and loyalties are tested as the creature stalks its prey with impersonal efficiency.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E15 - Afterlife
2.plot: Linden Stiles struggles to retain his humanity after heis convicted of a murder he didn't commit. When asked to make a frightful choice: accept execution or become the subject of a secret military experiment -- he chooses to live. As the experiment progresses, Stiles fights the dehumanizing influence of injected DNA from an alien lifeform. The attending doctor is troubled by a growing awareness of the inhumanity of the experiment itself, of the men in charge and of her own role.   Using his super-human strength, Stiles escapes. Then, hunted by his former compatriots, he faces a decision even more difficult than the one that set him on such a tragic course.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E16 - The Deprogrammers
2.plot: With Earth under alien rule and millions dead, the human race has been programmed to slavery. A small band of rebels kidnaps Evan, alien leader Koltok's personal slave. Trent Davis, leader of the rebels, tries to return Evan to his former self through arduous deprogramming sessions. To aid in the process, Evan is reintroduced to his wife Jill. As his sessions progress, Evan learns of the death of his daughter. He agrees to join the rebels and assassinate his former master - with devastating results.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E17 - Paradise
2.plot: Dr. Christina Markham and Sheriff Grady Markham live in small town America. Alzheimer's disease is slowly robbing Christina of her mother Helen, who lives in a nursing home along with her long time friend Gerry. When three apparently healthy young women age and die within hours, the Markhams are baffled and frightened. Grady interviews stunned witnesses and Christina seeks medical explanations, hoping to prevent another tragedy. Only after Helen and Gerry vanish is the astonishing answer to the puzzle finally revealed.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E18 - The Light Brigade
2.plot: Actor Robert Patrick returns for this first-ever THE OUTER LIMITS sequel, a follow-up to last year's 'Quality of Mercy.' On a desperate mission, a young Cadet learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war. The only survivors on a crippled battle cruiser - Earth's last hope for victory and survivors - are the Cadet, the weapons Chief and Major John Skokes, a repatriated prisoner of war. Exposed to fatal doses of radiation when their fleet was wiped out by the aliens, they fight illness and death to launch a preemptive strike. As the awesome responsibility for success descends on him, the Cadet learns that fear is not his only enemy.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E19 - Falling Star
2.plot: Pop singer Melissa McCammon is about to commit suicide. With her once meteoric career at a standstill and her husband cheating on her, she sees no hope. Then she encounters Rachael, an ardent fan from the future. Rachael is a time traveler -- and an uninvited tourist in Melissa's body. She persuades Melissa to give life a second chance, but in the process, she changes history. Now, authorities from the future want Melissa dead and will resort to anything -- including murder -- to preserve their version of the past.

2.title: FR - Au-delà du réel : L'aventure continue - S02E20 - Out of Body
2.plot: What really happens during an out-of body experience? Husband and wife scientists Rebecca Warfield and Ben McCormick are trying to find out by subjecting monkeys to electric impulses.
